1	# NVIDIA AI Factory 数字孪生与学习闭环计划
2	
3	## 1. 目标与验收标准
4	
5	在现有 LLM Infra Studio 中新增独立一级模块 `/factory`，首版用四周完成一个“结构拓扑准确、外观为高质量示意”的 NVIDIA AI Factory 三维展厅。
6	
7	首版验收标准：
8	
9	- 从“多机架集群 → GB300 NVL72 机架 → Compute Tray → 板卡 → GPU/HBM/NIC/DPU”连续下钻。
10	- 任意部件可点击，查看作用、规格、物理位置、上下级、相邻连接、实物参考和来源。
11	- 可切换 NVLink、Scale-Out、业务网络、管理、供电、液冷六类连接平面。
12	- 可播放推理过程：请求进入 → Prefill → KV Cache 写入 → Decode → MoE All-to-All → Token 返回。
13	- 同屏比较：
14	  - GB300 NVL72：实线、`shipping/verified`。
15	  - Vera Rubin NVL72：蓝色、`announced`。
16	  - Rubin Ultra NVL576：琥珀色线框、`forecast`。
17	- 生成一页可打印汇报：需求背景、当前架构、推理数据流、代际变化、证据边界、下一阶段。
18	- 桌面端提供完整三维交互；手机端提供自动导览、热点列表和详情，不要求复杂旋转拆解。
19	- 不在首版输出正式报价、采购 BOM 或伪精确 Token 产能。
20	
21	GB300 的母版以 NVIDIA 官方 NVL72 AI Factory 资料为准，包括 18 个 Compute Tray、9 个 NVSwitch Tray、供电、液冷及多机架参考拓扑。[NVIDIA NVL72 AI Factory](https://docs.nvidia.com/enterprise-reference-architectures/nvl72-ai-factory/latest/components.html)  
22	Rubin 只录入 NVIDIA 已正式发布的 NVL72、NVLink 6、Rubin GPU、Vera CPU、ConnectX-9 和 BlueField-4 信息。[NVIDIA Rubin 官方发布](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/_gallery/download_pdf/695c39b23d633240d175d8e6/)

24	## 2. 产品与技术实现
25	
26	### 三维工作台
27	
28	- 使用 `three`、`@react-three/fiber`、`@react-three/drei` 构建程序化三维模型；不依赖不存在的厂商 CAD。
29	- `/factory` 懒加载，避免 Three.js 进入其他页面首屏包。
30	- 采用语义 LOD：
31	  - 集群层只渲染机柜外形与 Scale-Out 网络。
32	  - 机架层渲染托盘、交换、供电、液冷和管理设备。
33	  - 托盘/板级才渲染 CPU、GPU、HBM、NIC/DPU、NVMe 等内部组件。
34	- 重复部件使用实例化渲染；动画运行时才开启连续帧，静止时按需渲染。
35	- WebGL 不可用时降级为 2D Rack Elevation、组件树和连接列表，不出现空白页。
36	
37	页面由四个区域组成：
38	
39	- 顶部：物理层级面包屑、产品状态和当前/未来切换。
40	- 中央：主三维场景。
41	- 左侧：场景导览与网络平面开关。
42	- 右侧：组件详情、邻居、参数、来源与“售前怎么解释”。
43	- 底部：推理数据流步骤条与播放控制。
44	
45	比较模式在同一 Canvas 中放置两个同步视角的系统，按组件稳定 ID 对齐差异，显示“新增、移除、数量变化、连接变化、规格变化”，避免两个 WebGL 场景重复消耗资源。
46	
47	### 推理数据流
48	
49	动画明确区分逻辑层和物理层，避免形成“每次请求都会重新加载权重”等错误认识：
50	
51	1. 请求从逻辑 Gateway 进入业务网络，经 DPU/NIC 到达计算托盘。
52	2. 模型权重已经驻留 HBM；Prefill 读取权重并写入 KV Cache。
53	3. Decode 循环读取权重和 KV，逐步生成 Token。
54	4. MoE 场景展示 Router、Dispatch、NVLink/NVSwitch All-to-All、Expert、Combine。
55	5. 跨机架默认演示 DP/副本扩展；不暗示每个 Token 必须跨机架通信。
56	6. 动画时间仅作教学节奏，不冒充真实时延。
57	
58	### 版本化内容包
59	
60	在 `src/data/factory/` 建立 JSON 内容包，由 Zod 在加载和测试时校验；三维组件只识别通用视觉类型，不写死产品型号。
61	
62	核心公开类型：
63	
64	- `FactoryContentPack`：版本、来源、组件、装配、连接、场景、数据流、比较定义。
65	- `Claim`：值、单位、证据类型、产品状态、来源定位、日期、置信度。
66	- `HardwareComponent`：GPU、CPU、HBM、Tray、Rack、Switch、NIC/DPU、Storage、Power、Cooling、Facility 的判别联合。
67	- `AssemblyNode`：父子关系、数量、Rack U/位置、可见层级和通用三维外形。
68	- `Connection`：端点、端口、网络平面、介质、协议、带宽方向和拓扑。
69	- `FlowEpisode`：推理阶段、经过的连接 ID、说明、动画节奏。
70	- `ComparisonDefinition`：代际间组件匹配和差异规则。
71	
72	证据类型固定为：
73	
74	`verified_spec | vendor_claim | benchmark | management_guidance | analyst_estimate | forecast | author_opinion`
75	
76	官方规格才能进入未来配置规则；券商和供应链材料只能进入背景与路线图。Rubin Ultra 资料明确按预测处理：:codex-file-citation{path="/Users/caoruixin/projects/aifactory/Rubin Ultra NVL576 架构：快速概览.pdf" purpose="source"}。Marvell 管理层摘要 :codex-file-citation{path="/Users/caoruixin/projects/aifactory/Marvell 2027 Q1 业绩电话会.pdf" purpose="source"} 与 Goldman Sachs 预测 :codex-file-citation{path="/Users/caoruixin/projects/aifactory/Goldman Sachs-Marvell Technology Inc. （MRVL.US）：Uptick to medium_term guidance， with signif.pdf" purpose="source"} 只作为未来供应链层输入，不能反推部件数量。

81	
82	每周个人投入 5 小时：官方资料 1.5 小时、内容包与模拟器实践 2 小时、脱稿讲解 1 小时、一页方案更新 0.5 小时。

84	### 第 1 周：建立唯一主线
85	
86	- 完成 `/factory` 路由、内容包 Schema、来源登记和 GB300 装配树。
87	- 把所有术语挂到以下主线上：
88	
89	  `业务负载 → 模型/SLA → 推理软件 → 并行与副本 → Scale-Up/Out → 服务器/托盘/机架 → 供电液冷 → 产能/TCO → POC`
90	
91	- 学习产出：一张 AI Factory 总图和 30 个核心术语卡；每个术语只要求回答“在哪里、做什么、影响哪个指标”。
92	
93	### 第 2 周：看懂物理系统
94	
95	- 完成集群、机架、托盘、板卡四级三维下钻与详情面板。
96	- 补齐计算、互联、存储、管理、供电、液冷六类组件。
97	- 学习产出：能在 5 分钟内从 GPU 讲到 NVSwitch、ConnectX、BlueField、Spectrum-X、Power Shelf 和 CDU。
98	
99	### 第 3 周：看懂推理如何落在硬件上
100	
101	- 完成 Prefill、KV Cache、Decode、MoE All-to-All 五段动画。
102	- 完成网络平面切换和物理/逻辑视图映射。
103	- 加入 GB300、Rubin、Rubin Ultra 的代际比较。
104	- 学习产出：能解释“容量、算力、带宽、通信、尾延迟、功率”分别怎样限制 Token 生产。
105	
106	### 第 4 周：汇报与质量收口
107	
108	- 完成移动导览、降级视图、视觉打磨、测试和性能优化。
109	- 加入打印友好的一页方案与 15 分钟老板演示脚本：
110	  - 2 分钟：AI Factory 要解决什么业务问题。
111	  - 4 分钟：硬件从集群下钻到板卡。
112	  - 4 分钟：一次推理如何使用这些部件。
113	  - 3 分钟：GB300 到 Rubin 的变化。
114	  - 2 分钟：哪些是事实、哪些是预测、下一阶段如何做容量规划。
115	- 学习验收：脱稿完成演示，并能回答“为什么不能只看卡数、FLOPS 和原始 tokens/s”。

117	## 4. 测试与验收
118	
119	- 内容包测试：Schema、唯一 ID、父子引用、连接端点、来源定位、状态与证据类型完整。
120	- 结构测试：装配数量、Rack U 占位、部件边界、相机预设和比较映射确定性。
121	- 数据流测试：路径连续、阶段顺序正确、暂停/重播正确；减少动态效果设置下不播放粒子动画。
122	- 交互测试：集群→机架→托盘→板卡下钻，热点选择、邻居跳转、网络平面切换、未来态比较。
123	- Playwright 固定相机截图回归：桌面 1440×900、移动端 390×844、WebGL 降级模式。
124	- 性能验收：重复组件实例化；8 机架总览不展开板级细节；页面隐藏时暂停动画；限制设备像素比。
125	- 工程门禁：现有 `typecheck`、Vitest、生产构建全部通过，其他页面行为和初始包大小不回退。
126	
127	## 5. 后续闭环与边界
128	
129	### 第二里程碑：可行配置与 Token 产能
130	
131	在首版三维数据模型上增加：
132	
133	- `SolutionBlueprint`、兼容矩阵、必选数量、端口/倍数、NVLink 域、功率和液冷规则。
134	- `WorkloadProfile`：模型、精度、输入/输出长度分布、并发、QPS、P95/P99 SLA、可用性和增长。
135	- `ParallelPlan`：TP、PP、EP、DP、Prefill/Decode 分离与 HA 副本。
136	- 输出 `ResolvedBOM`、配置错误说明和容量区间。
137	- Token 产能分为 Prefill、Decode、raw tokens/s、满足质量与 SLA 的 goodput、tokens/W、tokens/成本。
138	- 有实测 Profile 时优先校准；否则才使用带低/中/高区间的 roofline 估算，不把峰值 FLOPS 直接换算成 tokens/s。
139	- 当前引擎对未知 KV 参数输出偏乐观吞吐的问题必须先修正，再允许进入方案计算。
140	
141	“Token 数量不等于业务价值”的业务层独立建模，不混入硬件公式；其指标框架参考 :codex-file-citation{path="/Users/caoruixin/projects/aifactory/AI Dark Output- The Visible Cost of Invisible Output 中英.pdf" purpose="source"}。
142	
143	### 第三里程碑：多方案和供应链
144	
145	- 增加 HGX H200/B200/B300 参考方案。
146	- 增加 Google TPU7x 内容包和 3D Torus 拓扑，依据 [Google Cloud TPU7x 官方文档](https://docs.cloud.google.com/tpu/docs/tpu7x)。
147	- 国产超节点仅在获得官方规格后升级为可配置模板；二手材料先保留为 `reported_claim`。
148	- 增加供应商、交期、替代件、生命周期和路线图差异，但券商收入预测不自动转换为供应量。
149	- 提供场景 JSON 导入/导出和内容包版本迁移；应用内拖拽编辑器不在当前范围。
150	
151	默认约束：
152	
153	- “支持任何硬件”指任何已经注册到内容包且通过兼容规则校验的硬件，不承诺未知设备任意拼装。
154	- “数字孪生”指结构、层级、数量、连接和系统语义准确，不代表制造级尺寸或 CAD 精度。
155	- 官方实物图片以外链和来源标注展示；未明确许可的图片不复制进发布包。
156	- TPU、国产方案、正式 BOM、报价、TCO 和可承诺产能不属于四周首版。
157	- 当前附件中没有独立的技术分享会议程截图；PPT 第 18 页为无关噪声，不纳入内容包。

### 3. The throughput / capacity engine

**`/Users/caoruixin/projects/llms-study/src/lib/simEngine.ts`** (6.4 KB, pure functions, unit-tested in `simEngine.test.ts`). Header comment states all perf numbers are simplified roofline estimates: prefill = compute-bound, decode = bandwidth-bound.

Exports:

- Memory: `weightMemoryGB`, `kvBytesPerToken(kv: KVSpec): number | null`, `kvCacheGB`, `memoryBreakdown(...) : MemoryBreakdown`, `minGpus(totalGB, gpuMemoryGB, usable=0.9)`
- Perf: `tflopsForQuant(gpu, quantId)`, `estTTFTms(activeParamsB, promptTokens, gpuTflops, gpuCount, mfu=0.4)`, `estStepMs(activeParamsB, bytesPerParam, kvPerTokenBytes, contextTokens, batch, bandwidthTBs, gpuCount, mbu=0.6)`, `tokensPerSecond(stepMs, batch)`
- Economics: `selfHostCostPerMTok`, `apiRequestCost`, `apiBlendedPerMTok`, `breakEvenDailyMTok`, `estimateTokens`
- Consts/types: `QUANTS` (`fp16`/`fp8`/`int4`), `QuantOption`, `DEFAULT_MFU=0.4`, `DEFAULT_MBU=0.6`, `MemoryBreakdown`

Inputs come from typed data: `ModelSpec` (`totalParamsB`, `activeParamsB`, `moe`, `attentionType`, `kvSpec`, `contextK`) and `GpuChip` / `RackSystem` (`memoryGB`, `bandwidthTBs`, `fp8Tflops`, `fp4Tflops`, `nvlinkGBs`, `tdpW`) — both in `src/data/types.ts`, data in `src/data/models.ts` and `src/data/hardware.ts` (H100/H200/… + `RACKS` + `CLOUD_PRICES` + `INTERCONNECT_NOTES`).

**KV discriminated union** (`src/data/types.ts`):
```ts
export type KVSpec =
  | { kind: 'mha-gqa'; numLayers: number; kvHeads: number; headDim: number }
  | { kind: 'mla'; numLayers: number; kvLatentDim: number }
  | { kind: 'unsupported'; note: string }
```
Six models in `src/data/models.ts` carry `kind: 'unsupported'` (lines ~114, 189, 257, 304, 328, 361 — DSA/KDA/GDN-class architectures with unpublished layer/head params).

**The "optimistic throughput" bug PLAN.md line 139 refers to** — `simEngine.ts:98-112`:
```ts
const kvBytes = kvPerTokenBytes === null ? 0 : kvPerTokenBytes * contextTokens * batch
```
`kvBytesPerToken()` returns `null` for `kind: 'unsupported'`, and `estStepMs` silently coerces that to **0 KV bytes read per decode step**. Step time then counts only weight reads → `tokensPerSecond` is inflated, and it grows unboundedly optimistic as context/batch rise. Contrast with the memory path, which correctly propagates `null` (`kvCacheGB`/`memoryBreakdown.totalGB` → `null`).

Blast radius:
- `src/components/MemoryCalculator.tsx:37-46` — the `unsupported` branch only guards the *memory* section (shows a warn banner + weight-only lower bound). The three metric cards below it (TTFT / **TPOT `{r.stepMs}`ms** / **集群吞吐 `{r.tps}` tok/s**, lines ~157-170) render unconditionally with the KV=0 numbers, and the caption still claims "带宽瓶颈：(激活权重 + batch×KV)".
- `src/components/LifecycleSim.tsx:21` sidesteps it entirely: `const SIM_MODELS = MODELS.filter((m) => m.kvSpec.kind !== 'unsupported')`.
- `simEngine.test.ts:70-90` passes `null` KV deliberately (batch-linearity assertions) — so a fix that makes `estStepMs` return `null` will break those two tests.

```text
# NVIDIA AI Factory 数字孪生与学习闭环计划

## 1. 目标与验收标准

在现有 LLM Infra Studio 中新增独立一级模块 `/factory`，首版用四周完成一个“结构拓扑准确、外观为高质量示意”的 NVIDIA AI Factory 三维展厅。

首版验收标准：

- 从“多机架集群 → GB300 NVL72 机架 → Compute Tray → 板卡 → GPU/HBM/NIC/DPU”连续下钻。
- 任意部件可点击，查看作用、规格、物理位置、上下级、相邻连接、实物参考和来源。
- 可切换 NVLink、Scale-Out、业务网络、管理、供电、液冷六类连接平面。
- 可播放推理过程：请求进入 → Prefill → KV Cache 写入 → Decode → MoE All-to-All → Token 返回。
- 同屏比较：
  - GB300 NVL72：实线、`shipping/verified`。
  - Vera Rubin NVL72：蓝色、`announced`。
  - Rubin Ultra NVL576：琥珀色线框、`forecast`。
- 生成一页可打印汇报：需求背景、当前架构、推理数据流、代际变化、证据边界、下一阶段。
- 桌面端提供完整三维交互；手机端提供自动导览、热点列表和详情，不要求复杂旋转拆解。
- 不在首版输出正式报价、采购 BOM 或伪精确 Token 产能。

GB300 的母版以 NVIDIA 官方 NVL72 AI Factory 资料为准，包括 18 个 Compute Tray、9 个 NVSwitch Tray、供电、液冷及多机架参考拓扑。[NVIDIA NVL72 AI Factory](https://docs.nvidia.com/enterprise-reference-architectures/nvl72-ai-factory/latest/components.html)  
Rubin 只录入 NVIDIA 已正式发布的 NVL72、NVLink 6、Rubin GPU、Vera CPU、ConnectX-9 和 BlueField-4 信息。[NVIDIA Rubin 官方发布](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/_gallery/download_pdf/695c39b23d633240d175d8e6/)

## 2. 产品与技术实现

### 三维工作台

- 使用 `three`、`@react-three/fiber`、`@react-three/drei` 构建程序化三维模型；不依赖不存在的厂商 CAD。
- `/factory` 懒加载，避免 Three.js 进入其他页面首屏包。
- 采用语义 LOD：
  - 集群层只渲染机柜外形与 Scale-Out 网络。
  - 机架层渲染托盘、交换、供电、液冷和管理设备。
  - 托盘/板级才渲染 CPU、GPU、HBM、NIC/DPU、NVMe 等内部组件。
- 重复部件使用实例化渲染；动画运行时才开启连续帧，静止时按需渲染。
- WebGL 不可用时降级为 2D Rack Elevation、组件树和连接列表，不出现空白页。

页面由四个区域组成：

- 顶部：物理层级面包屑、产品状态和当前/未来切换。
- 中央：主三维场景。
- 左侧：场景导览与网络平面开关。
- 右侧：组件详情、邻居、参数、来源与“售前怎么解释”。
- 底部：推理数据流步骤条与播放控制。

比较模式在同一 Canvas 中放置两个同步视角的系统，按组件稳定 ID 对齐差异，显示“新增、移除、数量变化、连接变化、规格变化”，避免两个 WebGL 场景重复消耗资源。

### 推理数据流

动画明确区分逻辑层和物理层，避免形成“每次请求都会重新加载权重”等错误认识：

1. 请求从逻辑 Gateway 进入业务网络，经 DPU/NIC 到达计算托盘。
2. 模型权重已经驻留 HBM；Prefill 读取权重并写入 KV Cache。
3. Decode 循环读取权重和 KV，逐步生成 Token。
4. MoE 场景展示 Router、Dispatch、NVLink/NVSwitch All-to-All、Expert、Combine。
5. 跨机架默认演示 DP/副本扩展；不暗示每个 Token 必须跨机架通信。
6. 动画时间仅作教学节奏，不冒充真实时延。

### 版本化内容包

在 `src/data/factory/` 建立 JSON 内容包，由 Zod 在加载和测试时校验；三维组件只识别通用视觉类型，不写死产品型号。

核心公开类型：

- `FactoryContentPack`：版本、来源、组件、装配、连接、场景、数据流、比较定义。
- `Claim`：值、单位、证据类型、产品状态、来源定位、日期、置信度。
- `HardwareComponent`：GPU、CPU、HBM、Tray、Rack、Switch、NIC/DPU、Storage、Power、Cooling、Facility 的判别联合。
- `AssemblyNode`：父子关系、数量、Rack U/位置、可见层级和通用三维外形。
- `Connection`：端点、端口、网络平面、介质、协议、带宽方向和拓扑。
- `FlowEpisode`：推理阶段、经过的连接 ID、说明、动画节奏。
- `ComparisonDefinition`：代际间组件匹配和差异规则。

证据类型固定为：

`verified_spec | vendor_claim | benchmark | management_guidance | analyst_estimate | forecast | author_opinion`

官方规格才能进入未来配置规则；券商和供应链材料只能进入背景与路线图。Rubin Ultra 资料明确按预测处理：:codex-file-citation{path="/Users/caoruixin/projects/aifactory/Rubin Ultra NVL576 架构：快速概览.pdf" purpose="source"}。Marvell 管理层摘要 :codex-file-citation{path="/Users/caoruixin/projects/aifactory/Marvell 2027 Q1 业绩电话会.pdf" purpose="source"} 与 Goldman Sachs 预测 :codex-file-citation{path="/Users/caoruixin/projects/aifactory/Goldman Sachs-Marvell Technology Inc. （MRVL.US）：Uptick to medium_term guidance， with signif.pdf" purpose="source"} 只作为未来供应链层输入，不能反推部件数量。

PPT 的超节点定义、MoE 流程和“能跑→跑对→跑快→跑稳→跑省”分别转化为导览、动画和售前检查框架：:codex-file-citation{path="/Users/caoruixin/projects/aifactory/超节点-WAIC2026.pptx" purpose="source" artifact_kind="presentation" slide_number="3"} :codex-file-citation{path="/Users/caoruixin/projects/aifactory/超节点-WAIC2026.pptx" purpose="source" artifact_kind="presentation" slide_number="5"} :codex-file-citation{path="/Users/caoruixin/projects/aifactory/超节点-WAIC2026.pptx" purpose="source" artifact_kind="presentation" slide_number="17"}。

## 3. 四周实施与个人学习计划

每周个人投入 5 小时：官方资料 1.5 小时、内容包与模拟器实践 2 小时、脱稿讲解 1 小时、一页方案更新 0.5 小时。

### 第 1 周：建立唯一主线

- 完成 `/factory` 路由、内容包 Schema、来源登记和 GB300 装配树。
- 把所有术语挂到以下主线上：

  `业务负载 → 模型/SLA → 推理软件 → 并行与副本 → Scale-Up/Out → 服务器/托盘/机架 → 供电液冷 → 产能/TCO → POC`

- 学习产出：一张 AI Factory 总图和 30 个核心术语卡；每个术语只要求回答“在哪里、做什么、影响哪个指标”。

### 第 2 周：看懂物理系统

- 完成集群、机架、托盘、板卡四级三维下钻与详情面板。
- 补齐计算、互联、存储、管理、供电、液冷六类组件。
- 学习产出：能在 5 分钟内从 GPU 讲到 NVSwitch、ConnectX、BlueField、Spectrum-X、Power Shelf 和 CDU。

### 第 3 周：看懂推理如何落在硬件上

=== README ===
# LLM Infra Studio

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

An interactive, visual **AI learning & coaching companion** for LLM infrastructure — model architecture evolution, the inference serving pipeline, agent architecture, graded pre-sales practice drills, and an AI paper-reading copilot. Built for people selling, operating, or just seriously learning large-model infrastructure.

**Live site: [llm-pro.cn](https://llm-pro.cn)**

Everything runs local-first: your notes, papers, and practice history stay in your browser (IndexedDB) unless you sign in, in which case they sync to your account across devices.

## Modules

| Module | Route | What you get |
|---|---|---|
| **Architecture Evolution** | `/architecture` | Classic Transformer interactive diagram (QKV animation, encoder-decoder view) → modern frontier models (DeepSeek V3/V4, Kimi K3, GLM-5/5.2, Qwen3); attention mechanism evolution (MHA → GQA → MLA → DSA / KDA / CSA-HCA); model API pricing comparison |
| **KDA Deep-dive** | `/kda` | Interactive step-by-step derivation of Kimi Delta Attention with live numeric scenarios (linked from the attention evolution table) |
| **Inference Pipeline** | `/inference` | Four panels: full serving stack (4 layers), prompt lifecycle simulation, **VRAM-wall calculator** (weights + KV cache with per-attention-type formulas), token economics |
| **Agent Architecture** | `/agent` | Annotated agent architecture diagram — where the base model sits, where the harness boundary is |
| **Pre-sales Trainer** | `/interview` | Rubric-based question bank (must-cover points + red flags per question), answers graded live by an LLM, voice input, mastery dashboard, attempt history |
| **Paper Copilot** | `/papers` | Import PDF/DOCX papers, read in original PDF or semantic text view, select-to-ask, streaming AI copilot with citations, reading progress; guest-local by default, account sync when signed in |

## Engineering highlights

- **Data-driven extensibility.** All content — models, hardware, attention stages, questions, pricing — is typed data under `src/data/`; components only render. Adding a model or question means appending one object, no component changes. See [EXTENDING.md](EXTENDING.md).
- **No fake precision.** The sim engine (`src/lib/simEngine.ts`) is pure functions with unit tests against known worked examples. Architectures without public formula parameters (DSA, KDA, …) are explicitly marked "no numeric estimate" and show official relative metrics only. Volatile facts (prices, specs) carry `sourceUrl` + `asOf`.
- **Keys never reach the client bundle.** LLM calls go through an allowlisted proxy (`/api/moonshot`, `/api/zhipu`, `/api/deepseek`, `/api/openai-compat`) to a backend gateway that injects credentials, with multi-key ordered failover (invalid keys evicted, quota/rate-limited keys cooled down — `src/lib/keyRotation.ts`).
- **iOS WebKit PDF compatibility layer.** pdf.js v6 depends on three JS features WebKit hasn't shipped (ReadableStream async iteration, `Map.getOrInsertComputed`, `Uint8Array.toHex/toBase64`). `src/lib/paper/pdfCompat.ts` shims them on both the main thread and — via a wrapper worker entry — inside the pdf.js worker. Regressions are guarded by a Playwright dual-engine harness: `node scripts/webkit-pdf-repro.mjs` (WebKit + Chromium, self-hosting dev server, seeds a fixture paper, asserts rendered canvas pixels and the 390 px mobile layout).
- **Build-time feature flag with zero leakage.** `VITE_ENABLE_PAPER_COPILOT` gates the whole paper subtree; flag-off builds virtualize those modules so not a single paper chunk or pdf.js asset ships.
- **Mobile-adapted.** Responsive layouts with 44 px touch targets; desktop/tablet (`md+`) rendering kept byte-identical when mobile classes are added.

```text
// 纯函数模拟引擎：显存 / 性能 / 经济估算
// ⚠️ 所有性能数字为 roofline 简化示意估算（非实测 benchmark）：
//   - prefill 视为算力瓶颈：FLOPs ≈ 2 × 激活参数 × prompt tokens，除以 (算力 × MFU)
//   - decode 视为带宽瓶颈：每步读一遍激活权重（batch 共享）+ 各请求 KV，除以 (带宽 × MBU)
//   - MFU/MBU 取保守经验值，真实系统受 kernel/并行/调度影响上下浮动
import type { KVSpec } from '../data/types'

export interface QuantOption {
  id: 'fp16' | 'fp8' | 'int4'
  label: string
  bytesPerParam: number
}

export const QUANTS: QuantOption[] = [
  { id: 'fp16', label: 'FP16/BF16', bytesPerParam: 2 },
  { id: 'fp8', label: 'FP8', bytesPerParam: 1 },
  { id: 'int4', label: 'INT4/FP4', bytesPerParam: 0.5 },
]

export const DEFAULT_MFU = 0.4 // prefill 算力利用率（经验值）
export const DEFAULT_MBU = 0.6 // decode 带宽利用率（经验值）
const KV_BYTES = 2 // KV 按 FP16 存储

// 权重显存：参数量(B) × 每参数字节 = GB（1e9 × bytes / 1e9）
export function weightMemoryGB(totalParamsB: number, bytesPerParam: number): number {
  return totalParamsB * bytesPerParam
}

// 每 token 每层之和的 KV 字节数；新型稀疏/线性注意力无公开参数时返回 null（不做伪精确估算）
export function kvBytesPerToken(kv: KVSpec): number | null {
  switch (kv.kind) {
    case 'mha-gqa':
      return 2 * kv.kvHeads * kv.headDim * kv.numLayers * KV_BYTES
    case 'mla':
      // MLA 只缓存压缩 latent（如 DeepSeek 512+64=576 维），无 K/V 两份
      return kv.kvLatentDim * kv.numLayers * KV_BYTES
    case 'unsupported':
      return null
  }
}

export function kvCacheGB(kv: KVSpec, contextTokens: number, batch: number): number | null {
  const per = kvBytesPerToken(kv)
  if (per === null) return null
  return (per * contextTokens * batch) / 1e9
}

export interface MemoryBreakdown {
  weightsGB: number
  kvGB: number | null
  overheadGB: number
  totalGB: number | null
}

// 开销：激活/运行时/碎片，简化为权重 10% + 2GB
export function memoryBreakdown(
  totalParamsB: number,
  bytesPerParam: number,
  kv: KVSpec,
  contextTokens: number,
  batch: number,
): MemoryBreakdown {
  const weightsGB = weightMemoryGB(totalParamsB, bytesPerParam)
  const kvGB = kvCacheGB(kv, contextTokens, batch)
  const overheadGB = weightsGB * 0.1 + 2
  return { weightsGB, kvGB, overheadGB, totalGB: kvGB === null ? null : weightsGB + kvGB + overheadGB }
}

// 最少 GPU 数（默认可用显存 90%，留服务余量）
export function minGpus(totalGB: number, gpuMemoryGB: number, usable = 0.9): number {
  return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalGB / (gpuMemoryGB * usable)))
}

// 按所选量化取 GPU 算力口径：仅在官方公布对应精度算力时切换（INT4/FP4 → fp4Tflops），
// 其余（含 FP16——数据层无官方 FP16 字段）回退 FP8 口径，basis 供 UI 标注「按 FP8 算力口径」；不编造硬件数字
export function tflopsForQuant(
  gpu: { fp8Tflops: number | null; fp4Tflops: number | null },
  quantId: QuantOption['id'],
): { tflops: number | null; basis: 'fp8' | 'fp4' } {
  if (quantId === 'int4' && gpu.fp4Tflops !== null) return { tflops: gpu.fp4Tflops, basis: 'fp4' }
  return { tflops: gpu.fp8Tflops, basis: 'fp8' }
}

// TTFT 估算（ms）：prefill FLOPs ≈ 2 × 激活参数 × prompt tokens
export function estTTFTms(
  activeParamsB: number,
  promptTokens: number,
  gpuTflops: number | null,
  gpuCount: number,
  mfu = DEFAULT_MFU,
): number | null {
  if (gpuTflops === null) return null
  const flops = 2 * activeParamsB * 1e9 * promptTokens
  return (flops / (gpuTflops * 1e12 * gpuCount * mfu)) * 1000
}

// 每 decode 步时长（ms）：读一遍激活权重（batch 共享）+ batch 份 KV
export function estStepMs(
  activeParamsB: number,
  bytesPerParam: number,
  kvPerTokenBytes: number | null,
  contextTokens: number,
  batch: number,
  bandwidthTBs: number,
  gpuCount: number,
  mbu = DEFAULT_MBU,
): number {
  const weightBytes = activeParamsB * 1e9 * bytesPerParam
  const kvBytes = kvPerTokenBytes === null ? 0 : kvPerTokenBytes * contextTokens * batch
  return ((weightBytes + kvBytes) / (bandwidthTBs * 1e12 * gpuCount * mbu)) * 1000
}

// 集群总吞吐 tokens/s：每步出 batch 个 token
export function tokensPerSecond(stepMs: number, batch: number): number {
  return (batch / stepMs) * 1000
}

// ─────────── 经济模型 ───────────

// 自建成本 $/MTok = 集群每小时总成本 ÷ (吞吐 tokens/s × 3600 × 利用率) × 1e6
// 利用率在分母：利用率越低单位成本越高
export function selfHostCostPerMTok(clusterHourlyUSD: number, tokensPerSec: number, utilization: number): number {
  return (clusterHourlyUSD / (tokensPerSec * 3600 * utilization)) * 1e6
}

// 一次请求的 API 成本（$）：未命中输入 + 命中输入 + 输出 分段计价
export function apiRequestCost(
  inputTokens: number,
  outputTokens: number,
  cacheHitTokens: number,
  inputPerMTok: number,
  outputPerMTok: number,
  cachedPerMTok: number | null,
): number {
  const uncached = Math.max(0, inputTokens - cacheHitTokens)
  const cachedPrice = cachedPerMTok ?? inputPerMTok
  return (uncached * inputPerMTok + cacheHitTokens * cachedPrice + outputTokens * outputPerMTok) / 1e6
}

// 按流量结构混合出的 API 均价 $/MTok（输入/输出/缓存占比加权）
export function apiBlendedPerMTok(
  inputShare: number,
  outputShare: number,
  cacheHitRateOnInput: number,
  inputPerMTok: number,
  outputPerMTok: number,
  cachedPerMTok: number | null,
): number {
  const cachedPrice = cachedPerMTok ?? inputPerMTok
  const inputPrice = inputPerMTok * (1 - cacheHitRateOnInput) + cachedPrice * cacheHitRateOnInput
  return inputShare * inputPrice + outputShare * outputPerMTok
}

// 盈亏平衡日均 MTok：自建每日固定成本 ÷ API 均价
export function breakEvenDailyMTok(clusterHourlyUSD: number, apiPerMTok: number): number {
  return (clusterHourlyUSD * 24) / apiPerMTok
}

// token 数估算（无 tokenizer 的经验近似，UI 需标注"估算"并允许手动修改）：
// 中文 ≈ 1 字 / 0.6 token 即 chars/1.6；英文与代码 ≈ 4 字符 / token
export function estimateTokens(text: string): number {
  let cjk = 0
  let other = 0
  for (const ch of text) {
    if (/[一-鿿　-〿＀-￯]/.test(ch)) cjk++
    else other++
  }
  return Math.max(1, Math.round(cjk / 1.6 + other / 4))
}
```

/// <reference types="vitest/config" />
import { defineConfig, loadEnv, type Connect, type Plugin, type ProxyOptions } from 'vite'
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'
import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite'
import { classifyKeyFailure, createKeyRotator, parseKeyList } from './src/lib/keyRotation'

const PAPER_VIRTUAL_ID = '\0paper-copilot-disabled'

/**
 * flag-off 生产构建时，把 `src/pages/papers/**` 与 `src/lib/paper/**` 解析成空模块，
 * 让整棵论文陪读子树根本不进构建图。
 *
 * 为什么只靠 `PAPER_ENABLED ? lazy(() => import(...)) : null` 不够：Rollup 的 tree-shaking
 * 确实会剪掉死分支（JS chunk 里零 paper 代码），但 Vite 的 `vite:asset-import-meta-url` 是在
 * **transform 阶段** 就为 `new URL('pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs', import.meta.url)`
 * 调用 emitFile 的——那时候还没开始 tree-shaking，于是 1.2MB 的 worker 资产会留在 dist 里，
 * 尽管没有任何代码引用它。只有让这些模块压根不被 load，才能做到 flag-off 产物零 paper 痕迹。
 *
 * `apply: 'build'` 保证它只在 `vite build` 生效：dev server 与 vitest（走 serve 管线）不受影响。
 */
function paperCopilotOffPlugin(): Plugin {
  return {
    name: 'paper-copilot-disabled',
    apply: 'build',
    enforce: 'pre',
    resolveId(source) {
      return source.includes('/pages/papers/') ||
        source.includes('/lib/paper/') ||
        source.includes('/components/papers/')
        ? PAPER_VIRTUAL_ID
        : null
    },
    load(id) {
      return id === PAPER_VIRTUAL_ID ? 'export default {}' : null
    },
  }
}

// base URL 规范化：去尾斜杠，避免与上游路径拼出 //（jinaFailoverPlugin 用）
const normalizeBase = (u: string) => u.replace(/\/+$/, '')

/**
 * /api/jina 专用代理：支持 JINA_API_KEYS 多 key 按序故障转移。
 * 同一请求内逐 key 尝试——invalid(401/403) 本进程内永久剔除、quota/限流(402/429)
 * 冷却 60s——直到成功或全部不可用(此时透出最后一次上游错误)。
 * Jina 的 embeddings/rerank 均为小 JSON 非流式，可安全缓冲请求体重放；
 * 流式的 LLM chat 路由做不到请求内重试，仍走上面的 http-proxy(后端网关落地后统一收口)。
 * X-User-Key 仍最优先且不参与轮换(保持既有代理语义)。
 */
function jinaFailoverPlugin(env: Record<string, string>): Plugin {
  const target = normalizeBase(env.JINA_BASE_URL || 'https://api.jina.ai')
  const rotator = createKeyRotator(parseKeyList(env.JINA_API_KEYS || env.JINA_API_KEY))

  const handler: Connect.NextHandleFunction = (req, res) => {
    void (async () => {
      // connect 挂载在 /api/jina 下，req.url 已被去掉该前缀
      const chunks: Buffer[] = []
      for await (const chunk of req) chunks.push(chunk as Buffer)
      const body = Buffer.concat(chunks)
      const method = req.method ?? 'POST'
      const contentType = req.headers['content-type']

      const userKey = req.headers['x-user-key']
      const rotating = !(typeof userKey === 'string' && userKey)
      const attempt = rotating ? rotator.candidates() : [userKey as string]

      if (attempt.length === 0) {
        res.statusCode = 502
        res.setHeader('content-type', 'application/json')
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'no-usable-jina-key', detail: 'JINA_API_KEYS 全部 invalid 或冷却中' }))
        return
      }

      let last: { status: number; contentType: string | null; body: Buffer } | null = null
      for (const key of attempt) {
        const upstream = await fetch(target + (req.url ?? ''), {
          method,
          headers: {
            ...(typeof contentType === 'string' ? { 'content-type': contentType } : {}),
            authorization: `Bearer ${key}`,
          },
          body: method === 'GET' || method === 'HEAD' ? undefined : body,
        })
        const buf = Buffer.from(await upstream.arrayBuffer())
        const failure = classifyKeyFailure(upstream.status)
        if (failure && rotating) {
          rotator.reportFailure(key, failure)
          last = { status: upstream.status, contentType: upstream.headers.get('content-type'), body: buf }
          continue
        }
        res.statusCode = upstream.status
        const ct = upstream.headers.get('content-type')
        if (ct) res.setHeader('content-type', ct)
        res.end(buf)
        return
      }
      // 全部 key 均 invalid/quota：透出最后一次上游错误，前端据此报错
      res.statusCode = last!.status
      if (last!.contentType) res.setHeader('content-type', last!.contentType)
      res.end(last!.body)
    })().catch((e: unknown) => {
      if (!res.headersSent) {
        res.statusCode = 502
        res.setHeader('content-type', 'application/json')
      }
      res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'jina-proxy-error', detail: String(e) }))
    })
  }

  return {
    name: 'jina-key-failover',
    configureServer(server) {
      server.middlewares.use('/api/jina', handler)
    },
    configurePreviewServer(server) {
      server.middlewares.use('/api/jina', handler)
    },
  }
}

export default defineConfig(({ mode }) => {
  const env = loadEnv(mode, process.cwd(), '')

  // dev 拓扑 = 生产：/api/app（账号域）与 4 条 LLM 前缀全部原样转发本地后端（nginx 在
  // 生产做同一件事）。原「直连上游 + .env.local key 注入」已删——鉴权与 key 注入统一
  // 收口在后端网关（P2），浏览器侧不再存在任何 key 通路。
  // /api/jina 例外：仍走 jinaFailoverPlugin（rerank 未实弹，dev 先保留本地多 key 轮换）。
  const BACKEND = 'http://localhost:8787'
  const proxy: Record<string, ProxyOptions> = {}
  for (const prefix of ['/api/app', '/api/moonshot', '/api/zhipu', '/api/deepseek', '/api/openai-compat']) {
    // 不 rewrite：后端网关按完整 /api/{provider}/* 路径路由（URL 形状前后端一致）
    proxy[prefix] = { target: BACKEND }
  }

  // 与 src/nav.ts / src/App.tsx 同一个开关：三处一起决定论文陪读是否存在于产物中
  const paperEnabled = env.VITE_ENABLE_PAPER_COPILOT === '1'

  return {
    plugins: [react(), tailwindcss(), jinaFailoverPlugin(env), ...(paperEnabled ? [] : [paperCopilotOffPlugin()])],
    server: { proxy },
    preview: { proxy },
    test: {
      environment: 'node',
      include: ['src/**/*.test.ts'],
    },
  }
})

  | 'GQA'
  | 'MLA'
  | 'DSA'
  | 'KDA'
  | 'GDN'
  | 'CSA-HCA'

  | { kind: 'mla'; numLayers: number; kvLatentDim: number }
  | { kind: 'unsupported'; note: string }

  why: string // 为什么重要 / 售前一句话
}

  vendor: string

  totalParamsB: number // 十亿（B）
  activeParamsB: number // MoE 激活参数；dense 与 total 相同

}

}

  fp4Tflops: number | null
  nvlinkGBs: number | null
  tdpW: number | null

}

export interface RackSystem extends Sourced {

  fp4Pflops: number | null

}

  | 'inference-deploy'
  | 'presales'

}

}

export interface AttemptRecord {
  id: string
  questionId: string
  answer: string
  score: ScoreResult | null
  grade: Grade | null
  createdAt: number
}

## 5. 后续闭环与边界

### 第二里程碑：可行配置与 Token 产能

在首版三维数据模型上增加：

- `SolutionBlueprint`、兼容矩阵、必选数量、端口/倍数、NVLink 域、功率和液冷规则。
- `WorkloadProfile`：模型、精度、输入/输出长度分布、并发、QPS、P95/P99 SLA、可用性和增长。
- `ParallelPlan`：TP、PP、EP、DP、Prefill/Decode 分离与 HA 副本。
- 输出 `ResolvedBOM`、配置错误说明和容量区间。
- Token 产能分为 Prefill、Decode、raw tokens/s、满足质量与 SLA 的 goodput、tokens/W、tokens/成本。
- 有实测 Profile 时优先校准；否则才使用带低/中/高区间的 roofline 估算，不把峰值 FLOPS 直接换算成 tokens/s。
- 当前引擎对未知 KV 参数输出偏乐观吞吐的问题必须先修正，再允许进入方案计算。

“Token 数量不等于业务价值”的业务层独立建模，不混入硬件公式；其指标框架参考 :codex-file-citation{path="/Users/caoruixin/projects/aifactory/AI Dark Output- The Visible Cost of Invisible Output 中英.pdf" purpose="source"}。

```text
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { MODELS } from '../data/models'
import { GPUS, RACKS } from '../data/hardware'
import {
  QUANTS,
  estStepMs,
  estTTFTms,
  kvBytesPerToken,
  memoryBreakdown,
  minGpus,
  tflopsForQuant,
  tokensPerSecond,
} from '../lib/simEngine'
import { useInferenceParams, type QuantId } from '../store'

const CTX_STEPS = [4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1000] // K tokens

export default function MemoryCalculator() {
  // 模型/GPU/量化/batch 与 /inference 其他面板共享（src/store.ts useInferenceParams）；上下文长度为本面板专属
  const { modelId, gpuId, quantId, batch, setModelId, setGpuId, setQuantId, setBatch } = useInferenceParams()
  const [ctxIdx, setCtxIdx] = useState(2) // 16K

  const model = MODELS.find((m) => m.id === modelId)!
  const gpu = GPUS.find((g) => g.id === gpuId)!
  const quant = QUANTS.find((q) => q.id === quantId)!
  const contextTokens = CTX_STEPS[ctxIdx] * 1000

  const r = useMemo(() => {
    const bd = memoryBreakdown(model.totalParamsB, quant.bytesPerParam, model.kvSpec, contextTokens, batch)
    const unsupported = model.kvSpec.kind === 'unsupported'
    // 无 KV 公式时给「权重下限」估卡数，并明确标注
    const baseGB = bd.totalGB ?? bd.weightsGB + bd.overheadGB
    const gpus = minGpus(baseGB, gpu.memoryGB)
    // 量化对应算力口径：仅 INT4/FP4 且该卡有官方 FP4 值时切换，否则回退 FP8 并在下方标注
    const cap = tflopsForQuant(gpu, quant.id)
    const ttft = estTTFTms(model.activeParamsB, contextTokens, cap.tflops, gpus)
    const stepMs = estStepMs(
      model.activeParamsB,
      quant.bytesPerParam,
      kvBytesPerToken(model.kvSpec),
      contextTokens,
      batch,
      gpu.bandwidthTBs,
      gpus,
    )
    return { bd, unsupported, baseGB, gpus, ttft, ttftBasis: cap.basis, stepMs, tps: tokensPerSecond(stepMs, batch) }
  }, [model, gpu, quant, contextTokens, batch])

  // 分段先给 2% 可见性下限，再整体归一化——三段之和恒为 100%，不会溢出
  const segs = (defs: { gb: number; color: string; label: string }[]) => {
    const floored = defs.map((d) => Math.max(2, (d.gb / r.baseGB) * 100))
    const sum = floored.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)
    return defs.map((d, i) => (
      <div
        key={d.label}
        className={`${d.color} flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded px-1 text-[11px] font-medium whitespace-nowrap text-white`}
        style={{ width: `${(floored[i] / sum) * 100}%` }}
        title={`${d.label} ${d.gb.toFixed(1)} GB`}
      >
        {d.label} {d.gb.toFixed(0)}G
      </div>
    ))
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="grid gap-3 rounded-xl border border-line bg-panel shadow-sm p-4 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5">
        <label className="block text-xs text-dim">
          模型
          <select value={modelId} onChange={(e) => setModelId(e.target.value)} className="mt-1 w-full rounded-md border border-line bg-panel-2 px-2 py-1.5 text-sm text-fg">
            {MODELS.map((m) => (
              <option key={m.id} value={m.id}>
                {m.name}{m.kvSpec.kind === 'unsupported' ? '（KV 不可估）' : ''}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <label className="block text-xs text-dim">
          GPU
          <select value={gpuId} onChange={(e) => setGpuId(e.target.value)} className="mt-1 w-full rounded-md border border-line bg-panel-2 px-2 py-1.5 text-sm text-fg">
            {GPUS.map((g) => (
              <option key={g.id} value={g.id}>
                {g.name}（{g.memoryGB}GB / {g.bandwidthTBs}TB/s）
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <label className="block text-xs text-dim">
          量化
          <select value={quantId} onChange={(e) => setQuantId(e.target.value as QuantId)} className="mt-1 w-full rounded-md border border-line bg-panel-2 px-2 py-1.5 text-sm text-fg">
            {QUANTS.map((q) => (
              <option key={q.id} value={q.id}>
                {q.label}（{q.bytesPerParam} B/参数）
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <label className="block text-xs text-dim">
          上下文：{CTX_STEPS[ctxIdx] >= 1000 ? '1M' : `${CTX_STEPS[ctxIdx]}K`}
          <input type="range" min={0} max={CTX_STEPS.length - 1} value={ctxIdx} onChange={(e) => setCtxIdx(+e.target.value)} className="mt-2 w-full" />
        </label>
        <label className="block text-xs text-dim">
          并发 batch：{batch}
          <input type="range" min={1} max={64} value={batch} onChange={(e) => setBatch(+e.target.value)} className="mt-2 w-full" />
        </label>
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-xl border border-line bg-panel shadow-sm p-5">
        <h4 className="mb-1 text-sm font-semibold">
          显存构成 <span className="font-normal text-dim">（公式：权重 = 总参数×字节 + KV = 每token字节×上下文×并发 + ~10% 开销）</span>
        </h4>
        {r.unsupported ? (
          <div className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-warn/40 bg-warn/10 p-4 text-sm leading-relaxed">
            <span className="font-semibold text-warn">该架构不支持 KV 数值估算：</span>

import { create } from 'zustand'
import { persist } from 'zustand/middleware'
import type { AttemptRecord } from './data/types'

export type ProviderId = 'moonshot' | 'zhipu' | 'deepseek' | 'openai-compat'

export interface ProviderPreset {
  id: ProviderId
  label: string
  proxyPrefix: string
  chatPath: string // 代理前缀后的上游路径
  defaultModel: string
  supportsJsonMode: boolean
}

export const PROVIDERS: ProviderPreset[] = [
  {
    id: 'moonshot',
    label: 'Kimi (Moonshot)',
    proxyPrefix: '/api/moonshot',
    chatPath: '/v1/chat/completions',
    defaultModel: 'kimi-k3',
    supportsJsonMode: true,
  },
  {
    id: 'zhipu',
    label: '智谱 GLM',
    proxyPrefix: '/api/zhipu',
    chatPath: '/api/paas/v4/chat/completions',
    defaultModel: 'glm-5.2',
    supportsJsonMode: false,
  },
  {
    id: 'deepseek',
    label: 'DeepSeek',
    proxyPrefix: '/api/deepseek',
    chatPath: '/chat/completions',
    defaultModel: 'deepseek-v4-flash',
    supportsJsonMode: true,
  },
  {
    id: 'openai-compat',
    label: 'OpenAI 兼容端点',
    proxyPrefix: '/api/openai-compat',
    chatPath: '/v1/chat/completions',
    defaultModel: 'gpt-5.6-terra', // 与 src/data/pricing.ts 现有条目对齐
    supportsJsonMode: true,
  },
]

// 旧版残留清理：自带 key 已迁移到账号体系（加密存服务端、按登录态注入），
// 浏览器端不再保存任何 LLM key；老会话的 sessionStorage 残留在启动时抹掉
if (typeof sessionStorage !== 'undefined') sessionStorage.removeItem('llm-user-key')

interface SettingsState {
  provider: ProviderId
  model: string
  setProvider: (p: ProviderId) => void
  setModel: (m: string) => void
}

export const useSettings = create<SettingsState>()(
  persist(
    (set) => ({
      provider: 'deepseek',
      model: 'deepseek-v4-flash',
      setProvider: (provider) =>
        set({ provider, model: PROVIDERS.find((p) => p.id === provider)?.defaultModel ?? '' }),
      setModel: (model) => set({ model }),
    }),
    {
      name: 'llm-infra-settings',
      partialize: (s) => ({ provider: s.provider, model: s.model }),
    },
  ),
)

// /inference 三个面板（生命周期模拟 / 显存计算器 / Token 经济）共享的推理参数：
// 同一份 模型/GPU/量化/batch/缓存命中率，切 tab 结论不打架；会话内共享、不持久化。
// 面板专属参数（上下文长度、价目、时租、利用率等）仍留在各组件本地。
export type QuantId = 'fp16' | 'fp8' | 'int4'

interface InferenceParamsState {
  modelId: string
  gpuId: string
  quantId: QuantId
  batch: number
  cacheRate: number // 前缀缓存命中率 0~0.95
  setModelId: (modelId: string) => void
  setGpuId: (gpuId: string) => void
  setQuantId: (quantId: QuantId) => void
  setBatch: (batch: number) => void
  setCacheRate: (cacheRate: number) => void
}

export const useInferenceParams = create<InferenceParamsState>()((set) => ({
  modelId: 'deepseek-v3',
  gpuId: 'h100',
  quantId: 'fp8',
  batch: 16,
  cacheRate: 0.7,
  setModelId: (modelId) => set({ modelId }),
  setGpuId: (gpuId) => set({ gpuId }),
  setQuantId: (quantId) => set({ quantId }),
  setBatch: (batch) => set({ batch }),
  setCacheRate: (cacheRate) => set({ cacheRate }),
}))

interface HistoryState {
  attempts: AttemptRecord[]
  addAttempt: (a: AttemptRecord) => void
  removeAttempt: (id: string) => void
  clearQuestion: (questionId: string) => void
  clear: () => void
}

// 每题只保留最近 N 次作答：attempts 持久化在 localStorage（含完整回答文本），不设上限会无界膨胀
const HISTORY_CAP_PER_QUESTION = 20

// 记录 id：优先 crypto.randomUUID，降级为时间戳+随机后缀（与 paperRepo 的 newId 同一惯例）。
// 纯毫秒时间戳同毫秒会撞车——既是按 id 删除的正确性隐患，也是 React key 冲突隐患。
export const newAttemptId = () =>
  typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function'
    ? crypto.randomUUID()
    : `a-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`

export const useHistory = create<HistoryState>()(
  persist(
    (set) => ({
      attempts: [],
      addAttempt: (a) =>
        set((s) => {
          const next = [a, ...s.attempts] // 新的在前
          let kept = 0
          return {
            attempts: next.filter((x) => x.questionId !== a.questionId || ++kept <= HISTORY_CAP_PER_QUESTION),
          }
        }),
      removeAttempt: (id) => set((s) => ({ attempts: s.attempts.filter((x) => x.id !== id) })),
      clearQuestion: (questionId) =>
        set((s) => ({ attempts: s.attempts.filter((x) => x.questionId !== questionId) })),
      clear: () => set({ attempts: [] }),
    }),
    {
      name: 'llm-infra-history',
      version: 1, // v1：旧记录 id 为纯毫秒时间戳可能重复，迁移时对重复/缺失 id 重新生成
      migrate: (persisted: unknown) => {
        const s = persisted as { attempts?: AttemptRecord[] } | undefined
        const seen = new Set<string>()
        const attempts = (s?.attempts ?? []).map((a) => {
          if (!a.id || seen.has(a.id)) return { ...a, id: newAttemptId() }
          seen.add(a.id)
          return a
        })
        return { attempts } as HistoryState
      },
    },
  ),
)

# 扩展指南（EXTENDING）

本应用的扩展性来自一个核心设计：**所有内容都是 `src/data/` 下的类型化数据，组件只负责渲染**。
新增一个模型/硬件/引擎/题目，绝大多数情况只是往数组里加一个对象，不用碰任何组件代码。

## 扩展点速查表

| 想扩展什么 | 改哪个文件 | 类型约束 | 要碰组件吗 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 新增开源模型 | `src/data/models.ts` | `ModelSpec` | 否（卡片/diff/计算器自动出现） |
| 新增注意力机制 | `src/data/types.ts` 的 `AttentionType` + `src/data/attention.ts` | union 字面量 + `AttentionStage` | 否 |
| 新增 GPU / 机架 | `src/data/hardware.ts` | `GpuChip` / `RackSystem`（分层实体，禁跨层对比） | 否 |
| 新增推理引擎/算子/组件 | `src/data/stack.ts` 对应层的 `components` | `StackComponent`（what + interview 两段） | 否 |
| 新增生命周期阶段 | `src/components/LifecycleSim.tsx` 的 `STAGES` | — | 是（该数组就在组件内） |
| 新增模拟公式 | `src/lib/simEngine.ts` + `simEngine.test.ts` | 纯函数 + 必配已知算例单测 | 否 |
| 新增 KDA 推导步骤 / 演示场景 | `src/data/kda.ts` 的 `KDA_DERIV_STEPS`（场景数值改 `src/lib/kdaEngine.ts` 的 `DEFAULT_SCENARIO`） | `DerivStep`（`body` 必须是 `(step, fmt) => string` 取数函数，**禁写死数字**）+ `ScenarioSpec` | 否（四个 tab 组件全部按 `views` 声明渲染） |
| 新增面试题 | `src/data/questions.ts` | `Question`（mustCover/redFlags 必填） | 否 |
| 新增 ROI/POC 案例 | `src/data/cases.ts` | `WorkedCase` | 否 |
| 新增 API 价格行 | `src/data/pricing.ts` | `PriceRow`（sourceUrl+asOf 必填） | 否 |
| 新增评分 Provider | `src/store.ts` 的 `PROVIDERS` + `vite.config.ts` 的 `routes` + `.env.example` | `ProviderPreset` + 代理 allowlist | 否 |

### 3. The throughput / capacity engine

**`/Users/caoruixin/projects/llms-study/src/lib/simEngine.ts`** (6.4 KB, pure functions, unit-tested in `simEngine.test.ts`). Header comment states all perf numbers are simplified roofline estimates: prefill = compute-bound, decode = bandwidth-bound.

Exports:

- Memory: `weightMemoryGB`, `kvBytesPerToken(kv: KVSpec): number | null`, `kvCacheGB`, `memoryBreakdown(...) : MemoryBreakdown`, `minGpus(totalGB, gpuMemoryGB, usable=0.9)`
- Perf: `tflopsForQuant(gpu, quantId)`, `estTTFTms(activeParamsB, promptTokens, gpuTflops, gpuCount, mfu=0.4)`, `estStepMs(activeParamsB, bytesPerParam, kvPerTokenBytes, contextTokens, batch, bandwidthTBs, gpuCount, mbu=0.6)`, `tokensPerSecond(stepMs, batch)`
- Economics: `selfHostCostPerMTok`, `apiRequestCost`, `apiBlendedPerMTok`, `breakEvenDailyMTok`, `estimateTokens`
- Consts/types: `QUANTS` (`fp16`/`fp8`/`int4`), `QuantOption`, `DEFAULT_MFU=0.4`, `DEFAULT_MBU=0.6`, `MemoryBreakdown`

Inputs come from typed data: `ModelSpec` (`totalParamsB`, `activeParamsB`, `moe`, `attentionType`, `kvSpec`, `contextK`) and `GpuChip` / `RackSystem` (`memoryGB`, `bandwidthTBs`, `fp8Tflops`, `fp4Tflops`, `nvlinkGBs`, `tdpW`) — both in `src/data/types.ts`, data in `src/data/models.ts` and `src/data/hardware.ts` (H100/H200/… + `RACKS` + `CLOUD_PRICES` + `INTERCONNECT_NOTES`).

**KV discriminated union** (`src/data/types.ts`):
```ts
export type KVSpec =
  | { kind: 'mha-gqa'; numLayers: number; kvHeads: number; headDim: number }
  | { kind: 'mla'; numLayers: number; kvLatentDim: number }
  | { kind: 'unsupported'; note: string }
```
Six models in `src/data/models.ts` carry `kind: 'unsupported'` (lines ~114, 189, 257, 304, 328, 361 — DSA/KDA/GDN-class architectures with unpublished layer/head params).

**The "optimistic throughput" bug PLAN.md line 139 refers to** — `simEngine.ts:98-112`:
```ts
const kvBytes = kvPerTokenBytes === null ? 0 : kvPerTokenBytes * contextTokens * batch
```
`kvBytesPerToken()` returns `null` for `kind: 'unsupported'`, and `estStepMs` silently coerces that to **0 KV bytes read per decode step**. Step time then counts only weight reads → `tokensPerSecond` is inflated, and it grows unboundedly optimistic as context/batch rise. Contrast with the memory path, which correctly propagates `null` (`kvCacheGB`/`memoryBreakdown.totalGB` → `null`).

Blast radius:
- `src/components/MemoryCalculator.tsx:37-46` — the `unsupported` branch only guards the *memory* section (shows a warn banner + weight-only lower bound). The three metric cards below it (TTFT / **TPOT `{r.stepMs}`ms** / **集群吞吐 `{r.tps}` tok/s**, lines ~157-170) render unconditionally with the KV=0 numbers, and the caption still claims "带宽瓶颈：(激活权重 + batch×KV)".
- `src/components/LifecycleSim.tsx:21` sidesteps it entirely: `const SIM_MODELS = MODELS.filter((m) => m.kvSpec.kind !== 'unsupported')`.
- `simEngine.test.ts:70-90` passes `null` KV deliberately (batch-linearity assertions) — so a fix that makes `estStepMs` return `null` will break those two tests.

**首版的视觉形态选哪种？PLAN.md 草稿定的是完整 three.js 三维展厅（4周），但现有代码库没有任何 3D 基础，而 2D 交互下钻（SVG + framer-motion）与现有 StackExplorer/QKVFlow/LifecycleSim 模式完全同构，能快得多出可用版本。**

Options:
- **2D 先行，3D 后置（推荐）** - 第一里程碑用 2D 交互式下钻（集群→机架→托盘→板卡，SVG 机架立面图 + 数据流动画），复用现有组件模式，最快拿到学习价值；3D 展厅作为第二里程碑。2D 版本天然就是 PLAN.md 里要求的 WebGL 降级视图，不浪费。
- **直接上 3D（按草稿）** - 按 PLAN.md 原案：three + @react-three/fiber + drei，语义 LOD，四周完成三维展厅，2D 仅作降级。视觉冲击强（利于给老板/客户演示），但新依赖多、打磨成本高、风险大。
- **2.5D 等轴测** - 折中：用 SVG 等轴测（isometric）画机架和托盘，有立体感但不引入 WebGL/three.js。视觉比纯 2D 好，成本比真 3D 低，但下钻旋转等交互受限。

**Token 产能动态评估放在哪个阶段？你的目标里明确要「硬件方案调整后 token 产能有什么变化」，但 PLAN.md 草稿把它推迟到第二里程碑。现有 simEngine.ts 已有 roofline 估算（先修 KV bug 即可复用）。**

Options:
- **首版就带粗估（推荐）** - 先修 simEngine 的 KV=null 静默置 0 bug，首版在方案对比里给出明确标注为「粗估区间」的 tokens/s、tokens/W 对比（低/中/高区间），满足你的核心诉求。精细化的 WorkloadProfile/ParallelPlan/goodput 仍留到里程碑二。
- **按草稿推迟到里程碑二** - 首版只做结构、连接、数据流动画和代际比较，不输出任何产能数字，避免不成熟数字误导；产能评估在里程碑二完整建模后再上。

**实施节奏怎么定？PLAN.md 的四周计划假设你每周只投 5 小时且自己写码。但实际是 Claude Code 承担实现，你的时间主要花在学习、验收和讲解练习上，实现本身可以大幅压缩。**

Options:
- **压缩实现，保留4周学习节奏（推荐）** - 实现按功能分 3-4 个批次由 Claude Code 完成（每批次一两次会话），你的四周 5小时/周 主要用于：用做好的模拟器学习、脱稿讲解练习、更新一页方案。工具尽早可用，学习节奏不变。
- **严格按周对齐** - 实现进度与四周学习计划逐周对齐，每周只做当周学习需要的功能，边学边建。
- **一次性做完首版** - 集中把首版全部功能一次做完再开始学习循环。风险是中途缺少反馈、返工成本高。


**Answer:** 直接上 3D（按草稿）, 首版就带粗估（推荐）, 压缩实现，保留4周学习节奏（推荐）

# `/factory` 3D Workbench — Implementation Plan (scene architecture, rendering, interaction, layout, bundle isolation)

Scope note: data model / content pack (`src/data/factory/`, Zod schemas, claims, comparison matcher, capacity engine) is owned by the other agent. This plan treats `FactoryContentPack`, `HardwareComponent`, `AssemblyNode`, `Connection`, `FlowEpisode`, `ComparisonDefinition`, `Claim` as given inputs and defines everything from the content pack outward: scene graph, LOD, interaction, layout, fallback, comparison, report, tests, and batching.

---

## 1. Dependencies & bundle isolation

### 1.1 Version pinning (critical — React 18 constraint)

The app is React 18.3 with `StrictMode` on. **`@react-three/fiber` v9 and `@react-three/drei` v10 require React 19 — they must not be used.** Pin the last React-18 line:

```
dependencies:
  three                 0.170.0        (exact pin, do not float)
  @react-three/fiber    8.18.0         (last v8 — React 18 reconciler)
  @react-three/drei     9.122.0        (last drei major for fiber v8)
devDependencies:
  @types/three          0.170.0        (three does not ship types)
```

Do NOT add `@react-three/postprocessing` (selection glow via emissive/edges instead), `leva`, or `troika-three-text` (drei `<Text>` would need CJK font loading — all labels go through DOM/`<Html>` where the site's PingFang/Noto CJK stack is free).

Allowed drei imports (tight allowlist, all tree-shakeable ESM, none fetch CDN assets): `Instances`/`Instance`, `Line`, `Html`, `CameraControls`, `View`, `Edges`, `Grid` (optional floor). Explicitly banned: `Environment`/`Sky` (HDR/CDN), `Text`, `useGLTF` (no external models in v1 — everything procedural).

Upgrade path note (put in a comment in `FactoryCanvas.tsx`): when the app moves to React 19, bump to fiber 9 / drei 10 / latest three in one dedicated PR.

### 1.2 Bundle isolation — mirror the paper-copilot mechanism exactly

Three-part gate, same as `VITE_ENABLE_PAPER_COPILOT` (this is the codebase's proven pattern; the App.tsx comment at lines 19–25 explains why `lazy()` must live inside the ternary):

**`src/nav.ts`** — add:
```ts
const FACTORY_ENABLED = import.meta.env.VITE_ENABLE_FACTORY === '1'
// in NAV: ...(FACTORY_ENABLED ? [{ to: '/factory', label: 'AI 工厂', short: '工厂' }] : []),
```

**`src/App.tsx`** — add:
```ts
const FACTORY_ENABLED = import.meta.env.VITE_ENABLE_FACTORY === '1'
const FactoryPage = FACTORY_ENABLED ? lazy(() => import('./pages/factory/FactoryPage')) : null
const FactoryReportPage = FACTORY_ENABLED ? lazy(() => import('./pages/factory/FactoryReportPage')) : null
```
Routes `/factory` and `/factory/report` wrapped in `ErrorBoundary > Suspense fallback={<PageLoading/>}` exactly like the `/papers` routes. Extend the immersive regex: `const hideTabBar = /^\/papers\/.|^\/factory(\/|$)/.test(pathname)` — `/factory` needs the bottom edge for the flow step bar, and gets the `h-dvh flex-col` mobile shell for free. Also add `print:hidden` to the `<header>` className (one word) so the report prints without chrome.

**`vite.config.ts`** — add `factoryOffPlugin()` cloned from `paperCopilotOffPlugin()` (same `apply: 'build'`, `enforce: 'pre'`, virtual empty module), matching:
```
/pages/factory/  /components/factory/  /lib/factory/  /data/factory/
```
Registered as `...(factoryEnabled ? [] : [factoryOffPlugin()])`. Coordinate with the data agent: **all content-pack code must stay under `src/data/factory/` and must never be imported from `src/store.ts`, `src/nav.ts`, or any shared module** (same rule as the paperUiStore comment: one import from an eagerly-loaded module drags the whole subtree plus three.js into the main chunk).

**`.env.production`** — `VITE_ENABLE_FACTORY=1` (default on, like paper). **`.env.example`** — document it.

### 1.3 Tree-shaking facts & verification

- `three` sets `"sideEffects": false`; fiber/drei import `* as THREE` internally, so ~most of three core lands in the factory chunk regardless — that's fine, the goal is *isolation*, not minimizing the factory chunk. Expected factory chunk: ~250–330 KB gz (three core ~150 KB gz + fiber ~15 KB + used drei/stdlib + scene code) — loaded only on `/factory`.
- Unlike pdfjs, three/fiber/drei (with the allowlist above) have **no `new URL(..., import.meta.url)` asset emission**, so the transform-phase `emitFile` problem that motivated the paper plugin doesn't recur — but keep the plugin anyway for flag-off parity and as a kill switch.
- **Batch-1 acceptance check**: build with flag on and off; assert (a) flag-off `dist/` contains zero factory/three chunks, (b) the entry chunk hash of other pages is unchanged versus `main` (zero KB regression). Optional later: `rollupOptions.output.manualChunks` splitting `vendor-three` for long-term caching — not required for v1, skip to minimize vite.config churn.

## 2. File structure, scene graph, LOD, drill-down state machine

Follows the papers convention: routes in `src/pages/factory/`, components in `src/components/factory/`, pure logic in `src/lib/factory/`, data in `src/data/factory/` (other agent).

```
src/pages/factory/
  FactoryPage.tsx            route shell: breadcrumb bar / left tour+planes / center canvas-or-fallback / right detail / bottom flow bar
  FactoryReportPage.tsx      /factory/report — DOM-only, MUST NOT import three (see §6)
  factoryStore.ts            zustand UI store (see shape below) — pages-local like paperUiStore.ts
  factoryStore.test.ts
  useShotParams.ts           reads URL search params once → seeds store (deep links + Playwright determinism; HashRouter → params live inside the hash, useSearchParams handles it)

src/components/factory/
  FactoryCanvas.tsx          <Canvas> setup: dpr clamp, frameloop policy, onCreated/context-lost hooks, palette bridge, Suspense-less (no async assets)
  scene/SceneRoot.tsx        per-level content switch (semantic LOD)
  scene/ClusterScene.tsx     rack shells (Instances) + scale-out spine + floor grid
  scene/RackScene.tsx        focused rack full detail + ghosted neighbor racks
  scene/TrayScene.tsx        opened tray chassis + board(s); board level = same component with explode offsets
  scene/GenericShapes.tsx    visualType → procedural mesh (chassis-box / pcb / chip / hbm-stack / heatsink / switch / power-shelf / cdu / manifold), all BoxGeometry/ExtrudeGeometry + Edges, shared materials
  scene/Hotspot.tsx          pointer-events wrapper: hover/select/drill wiring, cursor, emissive highlight
  scene/CameraRig.tsx        drei <CameraControls>, preset flights (setLookAt with transition), per-level distance/angle clamps
  scene/ConnectionLayer.tsx  six plane overlays (drei <Line> per merged plane path)  — §3
  scene/FlowLayer.tsx        pulse InstancedMesh driven by flowTimeline               — §3
  scene/ComparisonView.tsx   drei <View> split + camera pose sync                     — §4
  panels/BreadcrumbBar.tsx   physical hierarchy path + product-status chip + 当前/未来 generation toggle
  panels/TourPanel.tsx       scene tour list (from pack scenes) — left column
  panels/PlaneToggles.tsx    six checkboxes + color legend — left column
  panels/DetailPanel.tsx     right column: role / claims table (status+evidence chips) / position / parent-children / neighbors (click = jump) / photo links / sources / 售前怎么解释 (reuse StackExplorer's warn-card pattern)
  panels/FlowBar.tsx         bottom: episode step bar + play/pause/step/speed (direct port of LifecycleSim's STAGES bar pattern, incl. 逻辑/物理 badges)
  panels/CapacityBands.tsx   props-driven cards for the data agent's capacity engine output (compare mode slot)
  fallback/Fallback2D.tsx    center-area swap when no WebGL — §5
  fallback/RackElevationSvg.tsx   SVG front elevation from AssemblyNode rack-U data (also used by report)
  fallback/ComponentTree.tsx      nested assembly list (StackExplorer visual language)
  fallback/ConnectionListTable.tsx plane-filterable connection table
  mobile/MobileFactoryView.tsx    auto tour + hotspot list + Drawer details — §5

src/lib/factory/
  layout.ts        PURE, no three import: content pack → ResolvedLayout (Map<nodeId, {pos:[x,y,z], size:[w,h,d]}>), 1 unit = 1 m; rack row pitch, rack-U → y (1U = 44.45 mm), tray internal slot grid
  layout.test.ts
  routing.ts       PURE: connection endpoints → orthogonal polylines with per-plane lane offsets + arc-length LUT
  routing.test.ts
  drill.ts         PURE: state-machine transitions + breadcrumb derivation
  drill.test.ts
  cameraPresets.ts PURE: (level, focus, ResolvedLayout) → {position, target, minDist, maxDist}; fits bounding box at level-specific azimuth/elevation
  cameraPresets.test.ts
  flowTimeline.ts  PURE: FlowEpisode[] + routed paths → TimelineSegment[] {t0,t1, pathLUT, narration, logical|physical}
  flowTimeline.test.ts
  webgl.ts         detectWebGL(): 'webgl2'|'webgl'|'none', honors ?gl=off override
  palette.ts       reads --color-* CSS vars via getComputedStyle once (fallback constants) + PLANE_COLORS + STATUS_MATERIALS constants

playwright.config.ts        (new, root)
tests/e2e/factory.spec.ts   (new)
```

**Hard rule for `src/lib/factory/`: zero `three` imports.** All math on plain `[number,number,number]` tuples with tiny local helpers. This is what makes the whole geometry layer unit-testable in the existing `environment: 'node'` Vitest setup (include pattern is `src/**/*.test.ts` — `.ts` only, which these are).

### Zustand store shape (`factoryStore.ts`)

```ts
export type DrillLevel = 'cluster' | 'rack' | 'tray' | 'board'
export type ViewMode  = 'explore' | 'compare' | 'tour'

interface FactoryUiState {
  generation: GenerationId                // 'gb300-nvl72' | 'vr-nvl72' | 'rubin-ultra-nvl576'
  level: DrillLevel
  focusPath: string[]                     // assembly node ids root→focus; breadcrumb & camera preset derive from this
  selectedId: string | null               // detail panel target (component OR assembly node)
  hoveredId: string | null
  planes: Record<PlaneId, boolean>        // six toggles (persisted)
  mode: ViewMode
  compare: { right: GenerationId; showDiffOnly: boolean }
  flow: { episodeIdx: number; playing: boolean; speed: 0.5|1|2 }   // NO per-frame t here
  tourStopIdx: number
  reducedMotion: boolean                  // seeded from prefers-reduced-motion, user-overridable (persisted)
  glStatus: 'unknown' | 'ok' | 'failed'   // failed → Fallback2D
  ready: boolean                          // set after first rendered frame → data-ready attr for Playwright
  // actions: drillTo(nodeId), drillUp(), select(id), setPlane(id,on), play/pause/step, setMode, setGeneration, ...
}
```

- `drillTo/drillUp` delegate to pure `drill.ts` (`nextState(state, action, pack)`) so transitions are node-testable; the store is a thin binding.
- **Per-frame flow progress `t` lives in a mutable ref inside `FlowLayer`**, never in zustand — the DOM `FlowBar` only needs episode-granularity updates (`episodeIdx`), which `FlowLayer` pushes when crossing segment boundaries. This avoids React re-render per frame (the classic R3F + store mistake).
- Persist (like `paperUiStore`'s LayoutPrefs, with a `sanitize` on rehydrate): `planes`, `reducedMotion`, `generation` only. Everything else is session state.

### Semantic LOD = React mount/unmount, not `THREE.LOD`

`SceneRoot` switches subtree by `level`:

- **cluster**: rack shells only via one `<Instances>` per generation visual type (8–64 instances), scale-out spine switches as boxes, floor `<Grid>`. Tray children never mounted → the "8-rack overview never expands board detail" perf requirement is structural, not an optimization.
- **rack**: focused rack fully detailed — 18 compute trays + 9 NVSwitch trays as `<Instances>` of tray-front shapes placed by rack-U from `layout.ts`, power shelves, CDU/manifolds; neighbor racks stay as shared ghost-material shells for context. Tray internals not mounted.
- **tray**: focused tray with lid off — board plane + major components as chip shapes; rack ghosted around it.
- **board**: same `TrayScene` with explode offsets applied (lerp positions along +y, precomputed in `layout.ts` as `explodedPos`), full GPU/HBM/NIC/DPU detail with `<Edges>`.

Drill interaction: click selects (detail panel), the panel's 「进入 →」 button or double-click drills. On drill: store updates `focusPath` → `CameraRig` runs `controls.setLookAt(...preset, true)` (camera-controls' built-in smooth transition); content swaps immediately (v1 accepts the pop — a cross-fade is a polish item, noted in code).

### Instancing decision: drei `<Instances>`, not manual `InstancedMesh`

Counts are small (≤64 racks, 27 trays, 72 GPU packages): drei `<Instances>/<Instance>` gives declarative per-instance color (diff/status tint) and **per-instance raycast events** (hover/select on individual trays/racks) for free. Manual `InstancedMesh` only in `FlowLayer` (~64 pulses, matrices written imperatively in `useFrame`). Document the threshold in `GenericShapes.tsx`: >~5k instances → switch to manual.

### Selection/hover raycasting

R3F's built-in pointer events (raycast happens on the DOM event, so it works fine under `frameloop="demand"`). `Hotspot.tsx` wires `onPointerOver/Out/Click`, sets `document.body.style.cursor`, stops propagation so nested hotspots (tray inside rack) resolve to the deepest hit. Decorative meshes (floor, cables, ghosts) get `raycast={() => null}`. Highlight = emissive/color bump on state change + `invalidate()` — no postprocessing outline pass.

### Rendering look (light theme)

Scene background = `--color-ink` (#f4f1e8) via `palette.ts` bridge (Tailwind is inert inside the canvas — every color goes through this module). One ambient + one directional light, `MeshStandardMaterial` flat studio look, `<Edges>` for the schematic "高质量示意" language. Product-status materials: GB300 solid; Vera Rubin blue-tinted solid; Rubin Ultra amber `wireframe: true` + amber edges. No shadows in v1 (demand-mode friendly; `ContactShadows frames={1}` is an optional polish).

## 3. Connection planes & flow animation

### Plane overlays (`ConnectionLayer.tsx`)

- `routing.ts` resolves each `Connection`'s endpoints to port anchor points on the component boxes (per-plane face convention: NVLink → rear backplane, scale-out/business/mgmt → rear top cage, power → rear bus bar, cooling → side manifolds) and emits deterministic orthogonal polylines with a **per-plane lane offset** so six planes never overlap; also emits the cumulative arc-length LUT used by the flow layer.
- Rendering: per enabled plane, one drei `<Line>` (Line2 fat lines, `linewidth` 1.5–2.5) per connection at rack/tray level; at cluster level, scale-out only, merged into few polylines. Six plane colors defined in `palette.ts` (NVLink NVIDIA-green #76b900, scale-out violet `--color-accent-2`, business blue, management gray `--color-dim`, power `--color-amber`, cooling cyan) — mirrored 1:1 in the `PlaneToggles` DOM legend and the fallback table.
- Toggling a plane just mounts/unmounts its `<Line>` group + `invalidate()`.

### Flow animation (`flowTimeline.ts` + `FlowLayer.tsx` + `FlowBar.tsx`)

- `flowTimeline.ts` (pure): `FlowEpisode[]` → `TimelineSegment[]` with normalized `t0/t1` per pacing weights, each segment referencing a routed path LUT. Unit tests assert path continuity across consecutive connections and monotonic timing.
- `FlowLayer`: one `InstancedMesh` of small emissive quads/spheres; `useFrame((_, delta))` advances `tRef += delta * speed`, samples LUTs, writes instance matrices, marks `instanceMatrix.needsUpdate`. On segment-boundary crossing it calls `store.setEpisodeIdx()` so the DOM `FlowBar` step bar tracks (LifecycleSim's active/done/pending visual states, ported verbatim).
- **Logical vs physical**: episodes carry a `logical|physical` tag. Physical episodes animate pulses along connections; logical stages (Gateway auth, router decision, KV-cache semantics) render as 「逻辑层」-badged steps in the FlowBar with narration text — no fake 3D node. Resident weights: HBM gets a steady glow (not moving particles) annotated 「权重常驻 HBM，不随请求加载」.
- **Frameloop policy** (the whole policy, in one place in `FactoryCanvas.tsx`):
  ```tsx
  <Canvas frameloop={flow.playing ? 'always' : 'demand'} dpr={[1, isMobile ? 1.5 : 1.75]} ...>
  ```
  Everything else runs on demand: drei `CameraControls` auto-invalidates during orbit and `setLookAt` transitions, and hover/toggle/select handlers call `invalidate()`. `visibilitychange` → hidden pauses `flow.playing` explicitly (rAF stops anyway on hidden tabs, but pausing the store keeps the step bar honest on return). `reducedMotion` → playback becomes discrete stepping: no particles, current episode's connections statically highlighted instead (matches the PLAN.md test requirement "减少动态效果设置下不播放粒子动画").

## 4. Comparison mode — one Canvas, two synced viewports

`ComparisonView.tsx`:

```tsx
<div ref={container} className="grid h-full grid-cols-2 gap-px">
  <div ref={leftRef} className="relative" /> <div ref={rightRef} className="relative" />
  <Canvas frameloop="demand" eventSource={container} className="!absolute inset-0">
    <View track={leftRef}> <SceneRoot generation={generation} diffRole="left" /> <CameraRig master /> </View>
    <View track={rightRef}><SceneRoot generation={compare.right} diffRole="right" /><SlaveCamera poseRef={poseRef} /></View>
  </Canvas>
</div>
```

- **drei `<View>`** = one WebGL context, per-view `gl.setScissor` — exactly the "same-Canvas, no duplicate context" requirement. Camera sync: master `CameraControls` (left) writes position/target into a shared `poseRef` on its update event; `SlaveCamera` copies the pose in a `useFrame` and the shared demand loop re-renders both views on the same invalidation. Plan B (documented in a comment, ~40 lines): if `<View>` + demand mode misbehaves in drei 9.122, replace with a manual `useFrame(priority=1)` doing two scissored `gl.render(scene, cam)` passes — same architecture, no dependency change.
- Comparison depth: cluster + rack levels in v1 (tray/board compare only if the pack provides matched internals).
- **Diff highlighting** (consumes the data agent's `ComparisonDefinition` matcher output, keyed by stable component IDs): unchanged = default status material; spec-changed = accent outline (`<Edges color>`); qty-changed = outline + count delta in the DOM diff list; added = ok-green edges (right only); removed = bad-red edges (left only). `showDiffOnly` drops unchanged parts to ~8% opacity (shared ghost material). Detailed diff text lives in a DOM list in the right panel — not 3D labels (cheap, CJK-safe, screen-reader-visible).
- **Capacity band cards**: `CapacityBands.tsx` is a dumb props component rendered under the canvas in compare mode; it takes whatever the data agent's engine returns (low/mid/high bands + assumptions + evidence status) and renders theme-token cards. UI slot only — zero engine logic here.

## 5. 2D fallback & mobile tour

**Shared-by-construction**: breadcrumb, tour panel, plane toggles, detail panel, flow bar are all plain DOM in `FactoryPage` — the *only* thing that swaps is the center cell: `FactoryCanvas` vs `Fallback2D`.

- `webgl.ts` runs once on mount (`canvas.getContext('webgl2') || getContext('webgl')`, wrapped in try/catch; `?gl=off` search param forces `'none'` for tests/demos). Additionally: `Canvas onCreated` failure and a `webglcontextlost` listener flip `glStatus='failed'` → swap to `Fallback2D` with a toast 「3D 初始化失败，已切换 2D 结构视图」. Never a blank page: `ErrorBoundary` on the route is the last net.
- `Fallback2D` center = `SegmentedTabs`(结构图 | 组件树 | 连接列表): `RackElevationSvg` (SVG front elevation computed from the same `layout.ts` rack-U data; rects colored by component kind; click = same `select()` action), `ComponentTree`, `ConnectionListTable` (filtered by the same plane toggles). Flow playback in fallback highlights table rows/elevation slots per episode instead of particles — `FlowBar` works unchanged.
- **Mobile** (`useMediaQuery(MQ.md)` false): `MobileFactoryView` — condensed breadcrumb, 3D canvas with `CameraControls enabled={false}` (no orbit/explode), auto tour stepping through `TOUR_STOPS` (content-pack scenes → `cameraPresets.ts` — the *same* preset functions the desktop drill-down and Playwright shots use), hotspot list below the canvas (tap = fly + select), details in the existing `components/ui/Drawer`. dpr capped `[1, 1.5]`. No WebGL on the phone → same `Fallback2D` stack, which is fully touch-usable.

## 6. Printable report

- Separate lazy route `/factory/report` (`FactoryReportPage.tsx`), **DOM-only — importing anything from `components/factory/scene/` or three is forbidden** (enforce by review + a comment; it may import `data/factory`, `lib/factory/layout|flowTimeline`, and `fallback/RackElevationSvg` + diff table + `CapacityBands`). This means printing works even where WebGL doesn't, and the report chunk stays ~tens of KB.
- Sections per requirement: 需求背景 / 当前架构 (RackElevationSvg + key claims) / 推理数据流 (episode list + narration) / 代际变化 (diff table + capacity bands) / 证据边界 (claims grouped by evidence type with status chips) / 下一阶段.
- Print styling: Tailwind v4 `print:` variants on the page (`print:break-inside-avoid`, grayscale-safe borders); add `print:hidden` to the App `<header>` and `MobileTabBar` `<nav>` (one class each — harmless globally, desirable everywhere). 「打印 / 导出 PDF」 button = `window.print()`. Entry link in the factory breadcrumb bar.

## 7. Test strategy

### Node-env Vitest (fits existing `src/**/*.test.ts` include, zero config change)

| File | Asserts |
|---|---|
| `lib/factory/layout.test.ts` | rack-U → y math, 18+9 tray placement non-overlap, cluster pitch, deterministic output for same pack |
| `lib/factory/routing.test.ts` | polyline continuity (segment endpoints join), per-plane lane separation, endpoints anchor on component boxes, LUT monotonic |
| `lib/factory/drill.test.ts` | legal/illegal transitions per level, focusPath/breadcrumb derivation, drillUp inverse |
| `lib/factory/cameraPresets.test.ts` | preset frustum-fits focus bounding box (pure math: distance ≥ fit distance), per-level clamps |
| `lib/factory/flowTimeline.test.ts` | episode path continuity across connections, t0/t1 monotonic and normalized, logical episodes carry no path |
| `pages/factory/factoryStore.test.ts` | plane toggles persist-sanitize round-trip, play/pause/step transitions, reducedMotion forces discrete stepping, glStatus fallback flip |

The "no three imports in `lib/factory/`" rule is what makes all of this run in plain node. `webgl.ts` detection gets a `// @vitest-environment happy-dom` test (happy-dom returns null contexts → `'none'` path).

### Playwright screenshot harness (new, minimal)

The installed `playwright@1.52` package already bundles the test runner (`playwright/test` entry) — **no new dependency**, just scaffolding:

- `playwright.config.ts`: `testDir: 'tests/e2e'`, `webServer: { command: 'npm run build && npm run preview -- --port 4173', url: 'http://localhost:4173' }`, projects: `desktop` (chromium 1440×900, `deviceScaleFactor: 1`), `mobile` (chromium 390×844). Headless Chromium renders WebGL via SwiftShader → deterministic on a given machine/CI image; use `toHaveScreenshot({ maxDiffPixelRatio: 0.02 })`.
- Determinism plumbing = `useShotParams.ts`: HashRouter URLs like `/#/factory?level=rack&focus=rack-1&planes=nvlink,power&motion=off&gl=off&mode=compare` seed the store once on mount (doubles as a shareable-deep-link feature). Page sets `data-ready="1"` on the canvas container after the first rendered frame (`ready` flag set from a one-shot `useFrame`); specs `await locator('[data-ready="1"]')` before shooting.
- Shots (v1 set): desktop cluster, desktop rack + all six planes, desktop board, desktop compare, mobile tour stop 1, fallback (`gl=off`) desktop + mobile. Script `"test:e2e": "playwright test"` — intentionally **not** part of `npm test` (existing typecheck/test/build gate stays untouched); snapshots committed; doc note to run `npx playwright install chromium` once.

- Acceptance: all screenshot shots recorded at 1440×900 / 390×844 / `gl=off`; mobile tour navigable one-handed.

## 9. Risks & mitigations (R3F into this codebase)

1. **React-18 / R3F version wall** (highest): fiber 9 & drei 10 need React 19. Mitigation: exact pins (§1.1), a loud comment in `FactoryCanvas.tsx`, and no `^`-floating on `three` (drei 9.x + three ≥0.17x combos can break silently).
2. **StrictMode double-mount** (`main.tsx` has `<StrictMode>`): all Three resource creation must be idempotent — geometry/material as module-level shared constants or `useMemo`, dispose in cleanup; never create resources in effect bodies with side effects outside React.
3. **Per-frame state → React re-render storms**: flow `t` and camera pose stay in refs; zustand receives only coarse events (episode index, level). Enforced by the store-shape rule in §2.

45	 * 冷却 60s——直到成功或全部不可用(此时透出最后一次上游错误)。
46	 * Jina 的 embeddings/rerank 均为小 JSON 非流式，可安全缓冲请求体重放；
47	 * 流式的 LLM chat 路由做不到请求内重试，仍走上面的 http-proxy(后端网关落地后统一收口)。
48	 * X-User-Key 仍最优先且不参与轮换(保持既有代理语义)。
49	 */
50	function jinaFailoverPlugin(env: Record<string, string>): Plugin {
51	  const target = normalizeBase(env.JINA_BASE_URL || 'https://api.jina.ai')
52	  const rotator = createKeyRotator(parseKeyList(env.JINA_API_KEYS || env.JINA_API_KEY))
53	
54	  const handler: Connect.NextHandleFunction = (req, res) => {
55	    void (async () => {
56	      // connect 挂载在 /api/jina 下，req.url 已被去掉该前缀
57	      const chunks: Buffer[] = []
58	      for await (const chunk of req) chunks.push(chunk as Buffer)
59	      const body = Buffer.concat(chunks)
60	      const method = req.method ?? 'POST'
61	      const contentType = req.headers['content-type']
62	
63	      const userKey = req.headers['x-user-key']
64	      const rotating = !(typeof userKey === 'string' && userKey)
65	      const attempt = rotating ? rotator.candidates() : [userKey as string]
66	
67	      if (attempt.length === 0) {
68	        res.statusCode = 502
69	        res.setHeader('content-type', 'application/json')
70	        res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'no-usable-jina-key', detail: 'JINA_API_KEYS 全部 invalid 或冷却中' }))
71	        return
72	      }
73	
74	      let last: { status: number; contentType: string | null; body: Buffer } | null = null
75	      for (const key of attempt) {
76	        const upstream = await fetch(target + (req.url ?? ''), {
77	          method,
78	          headers: {
79	            ...(typeof contentType === 'string' ? { 'content-type': contentType } : {}),
80	            authorization: `Bearer ${key}`,
81	          },
82	          body: method === 'GET' || method === 'HEAD' ? undefined : body,
83	        })
84	        const buf = Buffer.from(await upstream.arrayBuffer())
85	        const failure = classifyKeyFailure(upstream.status)
86	        if (failure && rotating) {
87	          rotator.reportFailure(key, failure)
88	          last = { status: upstream.status, contentType: upstream.headers.get('content-type'), body: buf }
89	          continue
90	        }
91	        res.statusCode = upstream.status
92	        const ct = upstream.headers.get('content-type')
93	        if (ct) res.setHeader('content-type', ct)
94	        res.end(buf)
95	        return
96	      }
97	      // 全部 key 均 invalid/quota：透出最后一次上游错误，前端据此报错
98	      res.statusCode = last!.status
99	      if (last!.contentType) res.setHeader('content-type', last!.contentType)
100	      res.end(last!.body)
101	    })().catch((e: unknown) => {
102	      if (!res.headersSent) {
103	        res.statusCode = 502
104	        res.setHeader('content-type', 'application/json')
105	      }
106	      res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'jina-proxy-error', detail: String(e) }))
107	    })
108	  }
109	
110	  return {
111	    name: 'jina-key-failover',
112	    configureServer(server) {

114	    },
115	    configurePreviewServer(server) {

interface SegmentedTabsProps<T extends string> {
  tabs: readonly { readonly id: T; readonly label: string }[]
  value: T
  onChange: (id: T) => void
}

export default function SegmentedTabs<T extends string>({
  tabs,
  value,
  onChange,
}: SegmentedTabsProps<T>) {
  return (
    <div className="flex max-w-full gap-1 overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-line bg-panel p-1 shadow-sm md:inline-flex md:w-auto md:flex-wrap md:overflow-visible">
      {tabs.map((t) => (
        <button
          key={t.id}
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onChange(t.id)}
          className={`shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md px-4 py-2 md:py-1.5 text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
            value === t.id ? 'bg-accent text-white' : 'text-dim hover:bg-panel-2 hover:text-fg'
          }`}
        >
          {t.label}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

/** 断点约定：沿用 Tailwind 默认；语义 base=手机、md=平板、lg=桌面双栏、xl=宽桌面 */
export const MQ = {
  md: '(min-width: 768px)',
  lg: '(min-width: 1024px)',
  xl: '(min-width: 1280px)',
} as const

export function useMediaQuery(query: string): boolean {
  const [matches, setMatches] = useState(() =>
    typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.matchMedia === 'function' ? window.matchMedia(query).matches : false,
  )
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof window.matchMedia !== 'function') return
    const mq = window.matchMedia(query)
    const sync = () => setMatches(mq.matches)
    sync()
    mq.addEventListener('change', sync)
    return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', sync)
  }, [query])
  return matches
}
import { Component } from 'react'
import type { ReactNode } from 'react'

interface Props {
  children: ReactNode
}

interface State {
  error: Error | null
}

/**
 * 路由级错误边界（必须是 class 组件：函数组件无法捕获 render 期错误）。
 * 每个 Route 各包一层：数据漂移触发的 render 期 throw（如 kda.ts 的 fail-loud 校验）
 * 只废掉当前页面，导航与其余页面照常可用。
 */
export default class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
  state: State = { error: null }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {
    return { error }
  }

  render() {
    if (this.state.error) {
      return (
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-xl rounded-xl border border-bad/40 bg-panel shadow-sm p-6">
          <h2 className="mb-2 font-semibold text-bad">该模块加载失败</h2>
          <p className="mb-4 break-all text-sm leading-relaxed text-dim">
            {this.state.error.message || String(this.state.error)}
          </p>
          <button
            onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
            className="rounded-lg border border-line bg-panel-2 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors hover:bg-panel"
          >
            刷新
          </button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    return this.props.children
  }
}

# Implementation Plan: `/factory` Data Model, Content Pack, Evidence System, Capacity Engine, and Content Tests

All paths below are in `/Users/caoruixin/projects/llms-study` unless noted.

## 0. Decision: TS modules + unit tests, NOT Zod (with a JSON-ready escape hatch)

**Recommendation: follow the codebase convention — typed TS modules validated by Vitest. Do not add zod to the frontend in v1.** Rationale:

1. **Consistency**: `EXTENDING.md` documents the extension model explicitly: "所有内容都是 `src/data/` 下的类型化数据"; every existing dataset (`models.ts`, `pricing.ts`, `hardware.ts`, `kda.ts`) is a typed TS array with hand-written invariant tests (`models.test.ts`, `pricing.test.ts`, `kda.test.ts`). The frontend has no zod dependency (only `server/` does). Introducing zod creates a second validation idiom for the same repo.
2. **TS discriminated unions are strictly better at authoring time**: the `KVSpec` pattern already proves this — exhaustiveness is enforced by the compiler in the editor, before any test runs. Zod errors would only surface at test/run time.
3. **Zod can't do the hard part anyway**: referential integrity (assembly parent IDs, connection endpoints, source IDs, quantity invariants like "18 compute trays") requires custom test code regardless. Zod would only duplicate what `tsc --noEmit` already guarantees for shape.
4. **M3 JSON import/export is preserved by design, not by zod**: keep `src/data/factory/types.ts` dependency-free and make `FactoryContentPack` a **strictly JSON-serializable plain-data shape** (no functions, no `Date`, no class instances; optional fields only, never `undefined`-as-value). Add a trivial batch-1 test `'内容包可 JSON 往返（结构化克隆等价）'` — `JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(pack))` deep-equals the pack — which locks in serializability. When M3 adds runtime JSON import (a real trust boundary), add zod **only in the import path**, generated from or checked against these types. Zod belongs at trust boundaries; in-repo content has none.

Pack versioning: `packVersion: string` (semver) on the pack root; M3 migration keys off it.

## 1. Type design and file layout

### File layout under `src/data/factory/`

src/lib/factory/

  capacity.test.ts
