Vitest's `src/**/*.test.ts` include picks these up with no config change.

### Core type sketches (`src/data/factory/types.ts`)

```ts
export type EvidenceType =
  | 'verified_spec' | 'vendor_claim' | 'benchmark'
  | 'management_guidance' | 'analyst_estimate' | 'forecast' | 'author_opinion'
export type ProductStatus = 'shipping' | 'announced' | 'forecast'
export type NetworkPlane = 'nvlink' | 'scaleout' | 'business' | 'mgmt' | 'power' | 'cooling'

export interface SourceRef {
  id: string                        // 'src.nvidia-nvl72-ra'
  title: string
  publisher: string
  kind: 'official_doc' | 'official_press' | 'analyst_report' | 'earnings_call' | 'internal_deck'
  url: string | null                // null for local-only files
  localFile?: string                // repo-external path for provenance notes
  asOf: string                      // YYYY-MM
}

// 与既有 Sourced 约定同源：value=null 表示「官方未公布，不编数」
export interface Claim {
  value: number | string | null
  unit?: string                     // 'GB', 'TB/s', 'kW', 'count', 'U'...
  evidence: EvidenceType
  status: ProductStatus
  sourceId: string                  // must exist in SOURCES
  locator?: string                  // 'page 4' / 'slide 5' / '#components'
  asOf: string                      // YYYY-MM
  confidence?: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low'
  note?: string
}

export type VisualShape =
  | 'rack' | 'tray-1u' | 'tray-sub-u' | 'shelf' | 'board' | 'chip-large'
  | 'chip-small' | 'stack' | 'cable-bundle' | 'pipe' | 'cabinet' | 'room'
export interface VisualHint { shape: VisualShape; wireframe?: boolean } // 3D agent 只认通用外形

interface ComponentBase {
  id: string                        // 'cmp.gpu.b300'
  name: string
  vendor: string
  generation: 'blackwell-ultra' | 'rubin' | 'rubin-ultra' | 'generic'
  status: ProductStatus
  summary: string                   // 作用一句话
  presalesNote?: string             // 「售前怎么解释」
  visual: VisualHint
  sourceIds: string[]               // existence-level sources
  imageUrl?: string                 // 实物参考外链（不复制图片进包）
}

export type HardwareComponent =
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'gpu'; simGpuChipId?: string   // ← bridge to src/data/hardware.ts GPUS
      specs: { fp4TflopsDense?: Claim; hbmCapacityGB?: Claim; hbmBandwidthTBs?: Claim
               nvlinkGBsPerGpu?: Claim; tdpW?: Claim } })
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'cpu'; specs: { cores?: Claim; lpddrGB?: Claim } })
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'hbm'; specs: { gen: 'HBM3e' | 'HBM4' | 'HBM4e'
               stacks?: Claim; capacityPerStackGB?: Claim } })
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'tray'; trayRole: 'compute' | 'nvswitch'; heightU: number })
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'rack'; heightU: number; simRackId?: string  // ← bridge to RACKS
      specs: { totalPowerKW?: Claim } })
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'switch'; plane: Exclude<NetworkPlane, 'power' | 'cooling'>
      specs: { ports?: Claim; aggregateBWTBs?: Claim; portSpeedGbs?: Claim } })
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'nic';  specs: { portSpeedGbs?: Claim; ports?: Claim } })
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'dpu';  specs: { portSpeedGbs?: Claim } })
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'storage'; specs: { capacityTB?: Claim } })
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'power'; powerRole: 'power-shelf' | 'busbar' | 'pdu'
      specs: { outputKW?: Claim } })
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'cooling'; coolingRole: 'cdu' | 'manifold' | 'cold-plate' | 'drip-tray'
      specs: { capacityKW?: Claim } })
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'facility'; facilityRole: 'room' | 'row' | 'pod' })

export interface FactorySystem {
  id: string                        // 'sys.gb300-nvl72'
  name: string
  status: ProductStatus
  generation: HardwareComponent['generation']
  referenceUrl: string | null
  keySpecs: Record<string, Claim>   // e.g. gpuCount, totalHbmTB, rackPowerKW
  simBridge?: { gpuChipId: string; gpuCount: number }  // capacity engine 入口（见 §3）
}

export interface AssemblyNode {
  id: string                        // 'asm.gb300.rack.compute-tray'
  systemId: string
  componentId: string
  parentId: string | null           // null = 该 system 装配树根（facility 级）
  roleKey: string                   // 跨代比较的稳定语义角色：'compute-tray' | 'nvswitch-tray' | ...
  count: number                     // 相对父节点的数量
  countClaim?: Claim                // 数量本身的证据（18 trays 等关键数量必带）
  position?: { uStart?: number; uHeight?: number; note?: string }
  lodLevel: 'cluster' | 'rack' | 'tray' | 'board'
}

export interface Connection {
  id: string                        // 'con.gb300.nvlink.gpu-nvswitch'
  systemId: string
  plane: NetworkPlane
  from: string; to: string          // AssemblyNode ids（同 system）
  fromPort?: string; toPort?: string
  medium: 'copper-backplane' | 'pcb' | 'dac' | 'optical' | 'busbar' | 'liquid' | 'cable'
  protocol?: string                 // 'NVLink 5' | 'Spectrum-X 800GbE' | 'PCIe Gen6' | ...
  bandwidth?: Claim
  direction: 'bidir' | 'uni' | 'supply' | 'return'
  topology?: 'all-to-all' | 'rail-optimized' | 'fat-tree' | 'star' | 'bus' | 'loop'
  note?: string
}

export interface FlowStep {
  id: string
  phase: 'ingress' | 'prefill' | 'kv-write' | 'decode' | 'moe-dispatch' | 'moe-combine' | 'egress'
  title: string
  narration: string                 // 明确区分逻辑/物理层，防「每次请求重载权重」误解
  presalesNote?: string             // WAIC PPT「能跑→跑对→跑快→跑稳→跑省」框架挂点
  connectionIds: string[]
  highlightAssemblyIds: string[]
  durationHint: number              // 教学节奏 ms，非真实时延（注释强制声明）
  logicalOnly?: boolean             // Gateway/Router 等纯逻辑步，无物理连接要求
}
export interface FlowEpisode { id: string; systemId: string; name: string
  description: string; steps: FlowStep[] }

export interface ComparisonDefinition {
  id: string
  leftSystemId: string; rightSystemId: string
  // 匹配主机制 = AssemblyNode.roleKey 自动配对；此处仅放 narrative 与显式覆盖
  overrides?: { roleKey: string; verdict: 'added' | 'removed' | 'changed'; narrative: string }[]
  summary: string[]                 // 汇报页「代际变化」要点
}

export interface ScenePreset {                 // 数据侧只存语义，相机数字归 3D agent
  id: string; systemId: string; name: string; description: string
  focusAssemblyId?: string; visiblePlanes: NetworkPlane[]
  lodLevel: AssemblyNode['lodLevel']
}

export interface FactoryContentPack {
  packVersion: string               // semver
  sources: SourceRef[]
  components: HardwareComponent[]
  systems: FactorySystem[]
  assemblies: AssemblyNode[]
  connections: Connection[]
  flows: FlowEpisode[]
  comparisons: ComparisonDefinition[]
  scenes: ScenePreset[]
}
```

Key design points:

- **`Claim` extends (not replaces) the existing `Sourced` idea**: same `asOf: 'YYYY-MM'` format, same "null = no official data" contract, but adds evidence type, status, and locator, which `/factory` needs and `Sourced` lacks. Existing `src/data/types.ts` is untouched.
- **`roleKey` on `AssemblyNode` is the cross-generation comparison spine.** Component IDs change per generation (`cmp.gpu.b300` vs `cmp.gpu.rubin`), but `roleKey: 'compute-tray'` is stable, so comparison matching is deterministic and testable without hand-maintaining ID pair tables. `ComparisonDefinition` only carries narratives and explicit `added/removed` overrides (e.g. NVL576's doubled NVSwitch trays get a `changed` narrative).
- **`simGpuChipId` / `simRackId` / `simBridge` are the only couplings to existing data** — they let the capacity engine reuse `GPUS`/`RACKS` numbers instead of duplicating them into Claims (single source of truth for roofline inputs; Claims carry evidence/UI provenance, `GpuChip` carries math inputs).
- **Connections are per-type between assembly nodes, not per-instance** (one `gpu→nvswitch-tray` edge with `topology: 'all-to-all'`, not 72×18 edges). Counts live on assemblies; the 3D agent fans out instances.

### ID naming scheme

- Prefix by collection: `src.`, `cmp.`, `sys.`, `asm.`, `con.`, `flow.`, `cmpdef.`, `scene.`
- Components: `cmp.<kind>.<product>` → `cmp.gpu.b300`, `cmp.gpu.rubin`, `cmp.gpu.rubin-ultra`, `cmp.switch.nvlink5-asic`, `cmp.nic.connectx8`, `cmp.dpu.bluefield3`
- Assemblies: `asm.<system-short>.<parent-path>.<role>` → `asm.gb300.rack.compute-tray`, `asm.gb300.compute-tray.gpu`
- Enforced by a regex test (see §5). Cross-generation matching never parses IDs — it uses `roleKey`.

## 2. simEngine bug fix (must land first, batch 1)

**Bug**: `simEngine.ts:109` — `const kvBytes = kvPerTokenBytes === null ? 0 : ...` silently treats unknown KV as zero, producing inflated TPOT/tokens/s that get *more* wrong as context×batch grows. The memory path (`kvCacheGB`, `memoryBreakdown`) already propagates null correctly; decode must match.

### Signature change: overloaded `estStepMs`

```ts
// src/lib/simEngine.ts
export function estStepMs(activeParamsB: number, bytesPerParam: number,
  kvPerTokenBytes: number, contextTokens: number, batch: number,
  bandwidthTBs: number, gpuCount: number, mbu?: number): number
export function estStepMs(activeParamsB: number, bytesPerParam: number,
  kvPerTokenBytes: number | null, contextTokens: number, batch: number,
  bandwidthTBs: number, gpuCount: number, mbu?: number): number | null
export function estStepMs(/* impl */ ..., kvPerTokenBytes: number | null, ...): number | null {
  if (kvPerTokenBytes === null) return null   // 未知 KV → 不估算（即使 ctx=0 也返回 null，语义统一）
  const weightBytes = activeParamsB * 1e9 * bytesPerParam
  const kvBytes = kvPerTokenBytes * contextTokens * batch
  return ((weightBytes + kvBytes) / (bandwidthTBs * 1e12 * gpuCount * mbu ?? DEFAULT_MBU)) * 1000
}
```

Strict propagation (null in → null out, unconditionally, even at `contextTokens = 0`): mirrors `kvBytesPerToken`/`kvCacheGB` semantics exactly and prevents callers "escaping" via zero context. The overload means callers that have already narrowed KV to `number` (LifecycleSim) keep a `number` return with zero runtime cost — same pattern quality bar as `tflopsForQuant`'s basis-tagged return.

`tokensPerSecond(stepMs: number, batch)` stays unchanged; callers guard before calling it (consistent with how `estTTFTms`'s null is handled today).

## 3. Capacity module (`src/lib/factory/capacity.ts`, batch 4)

Pure functions, no React, imports only from `src/lib/simEngine.ts`, `src/data/hardware.ts`, `src/data/models.ts` types, and `src/data/factory/`.

### API

```ts
import type { ModelSpec } from '../../data/types'
import type { QuantOption } from '../simEngine'

export interface Band { low: number; mid: number; high: number }
export const MFU_BAND = { low: 0.3, mid: 0.4, high: 0.5 }   // mid = DEFAULT_MFU
export const MBU_BAND = { low: 0.5, mid: 0.6, high: 0.7 }   // mid = DEFAULT_MBU

export interface CapacityInput {
  systemId: string                    // FactorySystem id，须带 simBridge
  rackCount?: number                  // 默认 1；>1 仅做 DP 副本线性外推（caveat 声明）
  model: ModelSpec
  quantId: QuantOption['id']
  workload: { promptTokens: number; avgContextTokens: number; batchPerReplica: number }
}

export interface CapacityEstimate {
  kind: 'estimate' | 'refused'
  reason?: string                     // refused 时：'forecast 系统不输出产能' | '关键硬件参数无官方数据' | ...
  feasible?: boolean                  // 显存能否放下（memoryBreakdown + minGpus）
  gpusPerReplica?: number
  replicas?: number                   // floor(72 × rackCount / gpusPerReplica)
  ttftMs?: Band | null                // null: 该精度无官方算力口径
  ttftBasis?: 'fp8' | 'fp4'
  tpotMs?: Band | null                // null: KV unsupported
  tokensPerSec?: Band | null          // 全系统聚合 = 单副本 band × replicas
  tokensPerWatt?: Band | null         // null: 无官方整机功率 claim
  caveats: string[]                   // 恒非空；首条固定「粗估区间（roofline 示意），非实测/可承诺产能」
  evidence: { evidenceType: 'author_opinion'; inputClaims: { label: string; sourceId: string; asOf: string }[] }
}

export function estimateSystemCapacity(input: CapacityInput): CapacityEstimate
```

### Methodology

1. **Resolve hardware via `simBridge`, not Claims**: `FACTORY_PACK.systems` → `simBridge.gpuChipId` → `GPUS` row (`b300`: 278GB, 8TB/s, fp4 15000). Roofline math single-sources from `GpuChip`; Claims supply only the rack power figure (for tokens/W) and provenance labels. This avoids two copies of bandwidth/FLOPS numbers drifting apart.
2. **Refusal gates, checked in order**:
   - `system.status === 'forecast'` → `kind: 'refused'` (Rubin Ultra NVL576 never produces numbers — PLAN.md hard rule: analyst material can't drive capacity).
   - Missing `simBridge` or `GpuChip` fields null (e.g. Vera Rubin bandwidth unpublished) → refuse or partial-null with caveat naming the missing official datum.
3. **Memory/replicas**: `memoryBreakdown(model.totalParamsB, quant.bytesPerParam, model.kvSpec, avgContextTokens, batchPerReplica)` → `minGpus(totalGB, gpu.memoryGB)` → `gpusPerReplica`; `replicas = floor(gpuCount × rackCount / gpusPerReplica)`; `feasible = replicas >= 1`. Unsupported-KV models: fall back to weights+overhead lower bound for `gpusPerReplica` (as MemoryCalculator does) but `tpotMs`/`tokensPerSec` are null.
4. **Bands**: TTFT via `estTTFTms` evaluated at MFU {0.5, 0.4, 0.3} → {low, mid, high} ms (note inversion: high utilization = low latency); TPOT via `estStepMs` at MBU {0.7, 0.6, 0.5}; `tokensPerSec` band from TPOT band via `tokensPerSecond` × replicas. **Never** `fp4Pflops × constant → tokens/s`; the peak-FLOPS path simply does not exist in this module.
5. **tokens/W**: `tokensPerSec / (rackPowerKW × 1000 × rackCount)` where `rackPowerKW` comes from the GB300 system's `keySpecs.rackPowerKW` Claim (vendor_claim, exact locator recorded). Claim value null → `tokensPerWatt: null` + caveat.
6. **Explicit non-goals, documented in the module header and asserted by tests**: no goodput, no SLA/P95, no cost/TCO, no cross-rack TP/EP, no interconnect contention, no training. Cross-rack `rackCount > 1` is DP-replica linear extrapolation with a caveat string saying exactly that. Output labeled 粗估区间; result evidence is `author_opinion` (the methodology is ours) with `inputClaims` referencing the vendor claims consumed.

**Prerequisite content work in batch 4**: add `simBridge: { gpuChipId: 'b300', gpuCount: 72 }` to the GB300 system. For Vera Rubin, optionally add a `rubin` row to `GPUS` in `src/data/hardware.ts` containing **only** officially published values (nulls elsewhere, per the `h20` precedent) — capacity then degrades gracefully via the null gates. Needs user confirmation (see §7).

### `capacity.test.ts` cases

- `'band 有序：low ≤ mid ≤ high（tokens/s 与 tokens/W）'`
- `'GB300 + DeepSeek-V3 FP8 已知算例：mid 档与手算 roofline 一致（±ε）'`
- `'MFU/MBU band 端点与常量一致（mid=DEFAULT_MFU/MBU）'`
- `'KV unsupported 模型 → tpot/tokensPerSec 为 null 且 caveat 说明'`
- `'forecast 系统（NVL576）→ kind=refused，不产生任何数字'`
- `'GpuChip 关键字段 null（如 rubin 带宽未公布）→ 拒绝并点名缺失项'`
- `'无整机功率 claim → tokensPerWatt null'`
- `'replicas 计算：显存装不下 → feasible=false；rackCount=2 → tokens/s 恰好 2×（DP 线性外推）'`
- `'caveats 恒非空且首条为粗估声明'`

## 7. Risks and mitigations

**Data-accuracy traps (things commonly gotten wrong):**
- **NVSwitch tray/ASIC counts**: NVL72 = 9 trays × 2 NVLink-5 ASICs = 18 chips — frequently misquoted as 18 trays or 9 chips. NVL576 doubles *trays* to 18 (0.75U) but keeps 36 ASICs/rack — and that is *analyst forecast*, not official. Mitigated by `countClaim` + the explicit quantity tests.
- **ConnectX/BlueField generation per platform**: GB300 → CX-8/BF-3; Rubin → CX-9/BF-4; easy to slip a generation. Dedicated content tests pin these.
- **Compute-tray composition**: GB300 tray = 2 Grace + 4 Blackwell Ultra (72/18); GB200-era "Bianca board" descriptions (1 Grace : 2 GPU superchips) get pasted into GB300 write-ups. The multiplication invariants (18×4=72, 18×2=36, cross-checked against `RACKS`) catch this.
- **Rack power figure** for tokens/W varies ~120–142kW across sources/configs → record exactly one vendor_claim with locator; capacity caveat names it. **Needs boss/user confirmation of which official figure to adopt.**
- **Official/analyst contamination**: the NVL576 PDF *looks* authoritative but is SemiAnalysis; the `verified_spec→official-source-only` test and the forecast-refusal gate in capacity make contamination structurally impossible rather than a review-time hope.

**Stale-source risk**: every Claim carries `asOf` + locator; the evidence system surfaces age in UI (other agent), and re-verification is a grep for `sourceId`. Rubin specs are "announced" and will churn — sparse-claim design (null until published) means updates are additive.

**Other confirmations to flag to user/boss**: (a) whether Vera Rubin gets a partial capacity estimate (requires adding a `rubin` GpuChip row) or is refused like NVL576 in v1; (b) default reference model for capacity (`deepseek-v3` vs `qwen3-235b`); (c) GB300 rack power figure; (d) how much of the RA's storage/mgmt detail to model vs simplify at board LOD.

```text
1	// 纯函数模拟引擎：显存 / 性能 / 经济估算
2	// ⚠️ 所有性能数字为 roofline 简化示意估算（非实测 benchmark）：
3	//   - prefill 视为算力瓶颈：FLOPs ≈ 2 × 激活参数 × prompt tokens，除以 (算力 × MFU)
4	//   - decode 视为带宽瓶颈：每步读一遍激活权重（batch 共享）+ 各请求 KV，除以 (带宽 × MBU)
5	//   - MFU/MBU 取保守经验值，真实系统受 kernel/并行/调度影响上下浮动
6	import type { KVSpec } from '../data/types'
7	
8	export interface QuantOption {
9	  id: 'fp16' | 'fp8' | 'int4'
10	  label: string
11	  bytesPerParam: number
12	}
13	
14	export const QUANTS: QuantOption[] = [
15	  { id: 'fp16', label: 'FP16/BF16', bytesPerParam: 2 },
16	  { id: 'fp8', label: 'FP8', bytesPerParam: 1 },
17	  { id: 'int4', label: 'INT4/FP4', bytesPerParam: 0.5 },
18	]
19	
20	export const DEFAULT_MFU = 0.4 // prefill 算力利用率（经验值）
21	export const DEFAULT_MBU = 0.6 // decode 带宽利用率（经验值）
22	const KV_BYTES = 2 // KV 按 FP16 存储
23	
24	// 权重显存：参数量(B) × 每参数字节 = GB（1e9 × bytes / 1e9）
25	export function weightMemoryGB(totalParamsB: number, bytesPerParam: number): number {
26	  return totalParamsB * bytesPerParam
27	}
28	
29	// 每 token 每层之和的 KV 字节数；新型稀疏/线性注意力无公开参数时返回 null（不做伪精确估算）
30	export function kvBytesPerToken(kv: KVSpec): number | null {
31	  switch (kv.kind) {
32	    case 'mha-gqa':
33	      return 2 * kv.kvHeads * kv.headDim * kv.numLayers * KV_BYTES
34	    case 'mla':
35	      // MLA 只缓存压缩 latent（如 DeepSeek 512+64=576 维），无 K/V 两份
36	      return kv.kvLatentDim * kv.numLayers * KV_BYTES
37	    case 'unsupported':
38	      return null
39	  }
40	}
41	
42	export function kvCacheGB(kv: KVSpec, contextTokens: number, batch: number): number | null {
43	  const per = kvBytesPerToken(kv)
44	  if (per === null) return null
45	  return (per * contextTokens * batch) / 1e9
46	}
47	
48	export interface MemoryBreakdown {
49	  weightsGB: number
50	  kvGB: number | null
51	  overheadGB: number
52	  totalGB: number | null
53	}
54	
55	// 开销：激活/运行时/碎片，简化为权重 10% + 2GB
56	export function memoryBreakdown(
57	  totalParamsB: number,
58	  bytesPerParam: number,
59	  kv: KVSpec,
60	  contextTokens: number,
61	  batch: number,
62	): MemoryBreakdown {
63	  const weightsGB = weightMemoryGB(totalParamsB, bytesPerParam)
64	  const kvGB = kvCacheGB(kv, contextTokens, batch)
65	  const overheadGB = weightsGB * 0.1 + 2
66	  return { weightsGB, kvGB, overheadGB, totalGB: kvGB === null ? null : weightsGB + kvGB + overheadGB }
67	}
68	
69	// 最少 GPU 数（默认可用显存 90%，留服务余量）
70	export function minGpus(totalGB: number, gpuMemoryGB: number, usable = 0.9): number {
71	  return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalGB / (gpuMemoryGB * usable)))
72	}
73	
74	// 按所选量化取 GPU 算力口径：仅在官方公布对应精度算力时切换（INT4/FP4 → fp4Tflops），
75	// 其余（含 FP16——数据层无官方 FP16 字段）回退 FP8 口径，basis 供 UI 标注「按 FP8 算力口径」；不编造硬件数字
76	export function tflopsForQuant(
77	  gpu: { fp8Tflops: number | null; fp4Tflops: number | null },
78	  quantId: QuantOption['id'],
79	): { tflops: number | null; basis: 'fp8' | 'fp4' } {
80	  if (quantId === 'int4' && gpu.fp4Tflops !== null) return { tflops: gpu.fp4Tflops, basis: 'fp4' }
81	  return { tflops: gpu.fp8Tflops, basis: 'fp8' }
82	}
83	
84	// TTFT 估算（ms）：prefill FLOPs ≈ 2 × 激活参数 × prompt tokens
85	export function estTTFTms(
86	  activeParamsB: number,
87	  promptTokens: number,
88	  gpuTflops: number | null,
89	  gpuCount: number,
90	  mfu = DEFAULT_MFU,
91	): number | null {
92	  if (gpuTflops === null) return null
93	  const flops = 2 * activeParamsB * 1e9 * promptTokens
94	  return (flops / (gpuTflops * 1e12 * gpuCount * mfu)) * 1000
95	}
96	
97	// 每 decode 步时长（ms）：读一遍激活权重（batch 共享）+ batch 份 KV
98	export function estStepMs(
99	  activeParamsB: number,
100	  bytesPerParam: number,
101	  kvPerTokenBytes: number | null,
102	  contextTokens: number,
103	  batch: number,
104	  bandwidthTBs: number,
105	  gpuCount: number,
106	  mbu = DEFAULT_MBU,
107	): number {
108	  const weightBytes = activeParamsB * 1e9 * bytesPerParam
109	  const kvBytes = kvPerTokenBytes === null ? 0 : kvPerTokenBytes * contextTokens * batch
110	  return ((weightBytes + kvBytes) / (bandwidthTBs * 1e12 * gpuCount * mbu)) * 1000
111	}
112	
113	// 集群总吞吐 tokens/s：每步出 batch 个 token
114	export function tokensPerSecond(stepMs: number, batch: number): number {
115	  return (batch / stepMs) * 1000
116	}
117	
118	// ─────────── 经济模型 ───────────
119	
120	// 自建成本 $/MTok = 集群每小时总成本 ÷ (吞吐 tokens/s × 3600 × 利用率) × 1e6
121	// 利用率在分母：利用率越低单位成本越高
122	export function selfHostCostPerMTok(clusterHourlyUSD: number, tokensPerSec: number, utilization: number): number {
123	  return (clusterHourlyUSD / (tokensPerSec * 3600 * utilization)) * 1e6
124	}
125	
126	// 一次请求的 API 成本（$）：未命中输入 + 命中输入 + 输出 分段计价
127	export function apiRequestCost(
128	  inputTokens: number,
129	  outputTokens: number,
130	  cacheHitTokens: number,
131	  inputPerMTok: number,
132	  outputPerMTok: number,
133	  cachedPerMTok: number | null,
134	): number {
135	  const uncached = Math.max(0, inputTokens - cacheHitTokens)
136	  const cachedPrice = cachedPerMTok ?? inputPerMTok
137	  return (uncached * inputPerMTok + cacheHitTokens * cachedPrice + outputTokens * outputPerMTok) / 1e6
138	}
139	
140	// 按流量结构混合出的 API 均价 $/MTok（输入/输出/缓存占比加权）
141	export function apiBlendedPerMTok(
142	  inputShare: number,
143	  outputShare: number,
144	  cacheHitRateOnInput: number,
145	  inputPerMTok: number,
146	  outputPerMTok: number,
147	  cachedPerMTok: number | null,
148	): number {
149	  const cachedPrice = cachedPerMTok ?? inputPerMTok
150	  const inputPrice = inputPerMTok * (1 - cacheHitRateOnInput) + cachedPrice * cacheHitRateOnInput
151	  return inputShare * inputPrice + outputShare * outputPerMTok
152	}
153	
154	// 盈亏平衡日均 MTok：自建每日固定成本 ÷ API 均价
155	export function breakEvenDailyMTok(clusterHourlyUSD: number, apiPerMTok: number): number {
156	  return (clusterHourlyUSD * 24) / apiPerMTok
157	}
158	
159	// token 数估算（无 tokenizer 的经验近似，UI 需标注"估算"并允许手动修改）：
160	// 中文 ≈ 1 字 / 0.6 token 即 chars/1.6；英文与代码 ≈ 4 字符 / token
161	export function estimateTokens(text: string): number {
162	  let cjk = 0
163	  let other = 0
164	  for (const ch of text) {
165	    if (/[一-鿿　-〿＀-￯]/.test(ch)) cjk++
166	    else other++
167	  }
168	  return Math.max(1, Math.round(cjk / 1.6 + other / 4))
169	}
170

## 0. Decision: TS modules + unit tests, NOT Zod (with a JSON-ready escape hatch)

**Recommendation: follow the codebase convention — typed TS modules validated by Vitest. Do not add zod to the frontend in v1.** Rationale:

1. **Consistency**: `EXTENDING.md` documents the extension model explicitly: "所有内容都是 `src/data/` 下的类型化数据"; every existing dataset (`models.ts`, `pricing.ts`, `hardware.ts`, `kda.ts`) is a typed TS array with hand-written invariant tests (`models.test.ts`, `pricing.test.ts`, `kda.test.ts`). The frontend has no zod dependency (only `server/` does). Introducing zod creates a second validation idiom for the same repo.
2. **TS discriminated unions are strictly better at authoring time**: the `KVSpec` pattern already proves this — exhaustiveness is enforced by the compiler in the editor, before any test runs. Zod errors would only surface at test/run time.
3. **Zod can't do the hard part anyway**: referential integrity (assembly parent IDs, connection endpoints, source IDs, quantity invariants like "18 compute trays") requires custom test code regardless. Zod would only duplicate what `tsc --noEmit` already guarantees for shape.
4. **M3 JSON import/export is preserved by design, not by zod**: keep `src/data/factory/types.ts` dependency-free and make `FactoryContentPack` a **strictly JSON-serializable plain-data shape** (no functions, no `Date`, no class instances; optional fields only, never `undefined`-as-value). Add a trivial batch-1 test `'内容包可 JSON 往返（结构化克隆等价）'` — `JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(pack))` deep-equals the pack — which locks in serializability. When M3 adds runtime JSON import (a real trust boundary), add zod **only in the import path**, generated from or checked against these types. Zod belongs at trust boundaries; in-repo content has none.

Pack versioning: `packVersion: string` (semver) on the pack root; M3 migration keys off it.

## 1. Type design and file layout

### File layout under `src/data/factory/`

```
src/data/factory/
  types.ts               # all public types; zero imports from app code (JSON-portable)
  sources.ts             # SOURCES: SourceRef[] — single registry, incl. broker material
  shared.ts              # cross-generation components (Oberon rack shell, busbar, CDU,
                         # manifold, cold plate, mgmt switch, facility/row)
  gb300-nvl72.ts         # GB300 system + components + assemblies + connections + scenes
  vera-rubin-nvl72.ts    # announced-only facts
  rubin-ultra-nvl576.ts  # forecast-only (SemiAnalysis-sourced)
  flows.ts               # FlowEpisode[] (inference flow on GB300)
  comparisons.ts         # ComparisonDefinition[] (narrative overrides on roleKey matching)
  index.ts               # assembles FACTORY_PACK: FactoryContentPack + byId lookup helpers
  pack.test.ts           # structural invariants (batch 1)
  content.test.ts        # per-system content invariants (grows in batches 2-3)
src/lib/factory/
  capacity.ts            # rough-band capacity estimator (batch 4)
  capacity.test.ts
```

Vitest's `src/**/*.test.ts` include picks these up with no config change.

### Core type sketches (`src/data/factory/types.ts`)

```ts
export type EvidenceType =
  | 'verified_spec' | 'vendor_claim' | 'benchmark'
  | 'management_guidance' | 'analyst_estimate' | 'forecast' | 'author_opinion'
export type ProductStatus = 'shipping' | 'announced' | 'forecast'
export type NetworkPlane = 'nvlink' | 'scaleout' | 'business' | 'mgmt' | 'power' | 'cooling'

export interface SourceRef {
  id: string                        // 'src.nvidia-nvl72-ra'
  title: string
  publisher: string
  kind: 'official_doc' | 'official_press' | 'analyst_report' | 'earnings_call' | 'internal_deck'
  url: string | null                // null for local-only files
  localFile?: string                // repo-external path for provenance notes
  asOf: string                      // YYYY-MM
}

// 与既有 Sourced 约定同源：value=null 表示「官方未公布，不编数」
export interface Claim {
  value: number | string | null
  unit?: string                     // 'GB', 'TB/s', 'kW', 'count', 'U'...
  evidence: EvidenceType
  status: ProductStatus
  sourceId: string                  // must exist in SOURCES
  locator?: string                  // 'page 4' / 'slide 5' / '#components'
  asOf: string                      // YYYY-MM
  confidence?: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low'
  note?: string
}

export type VisualShape =
  | 'rack' | 'tray-1u' | 'tray-sub-u' | 'shelf' | 'board' | 'chip-large'
  | 'chip-small' | 'stack' | 'cable-bundle' | 'pipe' | 'cabinet' | 'room'
export interface VisualHint { shape: VisualShape; wireframe?: boolean } // 3D agent 只认通用外形

interface ComponentBase {
  id: string                        // 'cmp.gpu.b300'
  name: string
  vendor: string
  generation: 'blackwell-ultra' | 'rubin' | 'rubin-ultra' | 'generic'
  status: ProductStatus
  summary: string                   // 作用一句话
  presalesNote?: string             // 「售前怎么解释」
  visual: VisualHint
  sourceIds: string[]               // existence-level sources
  imageUrl?: string                 // 实物参考外链（不复制图片进包）
}

export type HardwareComponent =
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'gpu'; simGpuChipId?: string   // ← bridge to src/data/hardware.ts GPUS
      specs: { fp4TflopsDense?: Claim; hbmCapacityGB?: Claim; hbmBandwidthTBs?: Claim
               nvlinkGBsPerGpu?: Claim; tdpW?: Claim } })
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'cpu'; specs: { cores?: Claim; lpddrGB?: Claim } })
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'hbm'; specs: { gen: 'HBM3e' | 'HBM4' | 'HBM4e'
               stacks?: Claim; capacityPerStackGB?: Claim } })
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'tray'; trayRole: 'compute' | 'nvswitch'; heightU: number })
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'rack'; heightU: number; simRackId?: string  // ← bridge to RACKS
      specs: { totalPowerKW?: Claim } })
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'switch'; plane: Exclude<NetworkPlane, 'power' | 'cooling'>
      specs: { ports?: Claim; aggregateBWTBs?: Claim; portSpeedGbs?: Claim } })
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'nic';  specs: { portSpeedGbs?: Claim; ports?: Claim } })
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'dpu';  specs: { portSpeedGbs?: Claim } })
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'storage'; specs: { capacityTB?: Claim } })
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'power'; powerRole: 'power-shelf' | 'busbar' | 'pdu'
      specs: { outputKW?: Claim } })
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'cooling'; coolingRole: 'cdu' | 'manifold' | 'cold-plate' | 'drip-tray'
      specs: { capacityKW?: Claim } })
  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'facility'; facilityRole: 'room' | 'row' | 'pod' })

export interface FactorySystem {
  id: string                        // 'sys.gb300-nvl72'
  name: string
  status: ProductStatus
  generation: HardwareComponent['generation']
  referenceUrl: string | null
  keySpecs: Record<string, Claim>   // e.g. gpuCount, totalHbmTB, rackPowerKW
  simBridge?: { gpuChipId: string; gpuCount: number }  // capacity engine 入口（见 §3）
}

export interface AssemblyNode {
  id: string                        // 'asm.gb300.rack.compute-tray'
  systemId: string
  componentId: string
  parentId: string | null           // null = 该 system 装配树根（facility 级）
  roleKey: string                   // 跨代比较的稳定语义角色：'compute-tray' | 'nvswitch-tray' | ...
  count: number                     // 相对父节点的数量
  countClaim?: Claim                // 数量本身的证据（18 trays 等关键数量必带）
  position?: { uStart?: number; uHeight?: number; note?: string }
  lodLevel: 'cluster' | 'rack' | 'tray' | 'board'
}

export interface Connection {
  id: string                        // 'con.gb300.nvlink.gpu-nvswitch'
  systemId: string
  plane: NetworkPlane
  from: string; to: string          // AssemblyNode ids（同 system）
  fromPort?: string; toPort?: string
  medium: 'copper-backplane' | 'pcb' | 'dac' | 'optical' | 'busbar' | 'liquid' | 'cable'
  protocol?: string                 // 'NVLink 5' | 'Spectrum-X 800GbE' | 'PCIe Gen6' | ...
  bandwidth?: Claim
  direction: 'bidir' | 'uni' | 'supply' | 'return'
  topology?: 'all-to-all' | 'rail-optimized' | 'fat-tree' | 'star' | 'bus' | 'loop'
  note?: string
}

export interface FlowStep {
  id: string
  phase: 'ingress' | 'prefill' | 'kv-write' | 'decode' | 'moe-dispatch' | 'moe-combine' | 'egress'
  title: string
  narration: string                 // 明确区分逻辑/物理层，防「每次请求重载权重」误解
  presalesNote?: string             // WAIC PPT「能跑→跑对→跑快→跑稳→跑省」框架挂点
  connectionIds: string[]
  highlightAssemblyIds: string[]
  durationHint: number              // 教学节奏 ms，非真实时延（注释强制声明）
  logicalOnly?: boolean             // Gateway/Router 等纯逻辑步，无物理连接要求
}
export interface FlowEpisode { id: string; systemId: string; name: string
  description: string; steps: FlowStep[] }

export interface ComparisonDefinition {
  id: string
  leftSystemId: string; rightSystemId: string
  // 匹配主机制 = AssemblyNode.roleKey 自动配对；此处仅放 narrative 与显式覆盖
  overrides?: { roleKey: string; verdict: 'added' | 'removed' | 'changed'; narrative: string }[]
  summary: string[]                 // 汇报页「代际变化」要点
}

export interface ScenePreset {                 // 数据侧只存语义，相机数字归 3D agent
  id: string; systemId: string; name: string; description: string
  focusAssemblyId?: string; visiblePlanes: NetworkPlane[]
  lodLevel: AssemblyNode['lodLevel']
}

export interface FactoryContentPack {
  packVersion: string               // semver
  sources: SourceRef[]
  components: HardwareComponent[]
  systems: FactorySystem[]
  assemblies: AssemblyNode[]
  connections: Connection[]
  flows: FlowEpisode[]
  comparisons: ComparisonDefinition[]
  scenes: ScenePreset[]
}
```

Key design points:

- **`Claim` extends (not replaces) the existing `Sourced` idea**: same `asOf: 'YYYY-MM'` format, same "null = no official data" contract, but adds evidence type, status, and locator, which `/factory` needs and `Sourced` lacks. Existing `src/data/types.ts` is untouched.
- **`roleKey` on `AssemblyNode` is the cross-generation comparison spine.** Component IDs change per generation (`cmp.gpu.b300` vs `cmp.gpu.rubin`), but `roleKey: 'compute-tray'` is stable, so comparison matching is deterministic and testable without hand-maintaining ID pair tables. `ComparisonDefinition` only carries narratives and explicit `added/removed` overrides (e.g. NVL576's doubled NVSwitch trays get a `changed` narrative).
- **`simGpuChipId` / `simRackId` / `simBridge` are the only couplings to existing data** — they let the capacity engine reuse `GPUS`/`RACKS` numbers instead of duplicating them into Claims (single source of truth for roofline inputs; Claims carry evidence/UI provenance, `GpuChip` carries math inputs).
- **Connections are per-type between assembly nodes, not per-instance** (one `gpu→nvswitch-tray` edge with `topology: 'all-to-all'`, not 72×18 edges). Counts live on assemblies; the 3D agent fans out instances.

### ID naming scheme

- Prefix by collection: `src.`, `cmp.`, `sys.`, `asm.`, `con.`, `flow.`, `cmpdef.`, `scene.`
- Components: `cmp.<kind>.<product>` → `cmp.gpu.b300`, `cmp.gpu.rubin`, `cmp.gpu.rubin-ultra`, `cmp.switch.nvlink5-asic`, `cmp.nic.connectx8`, `cmp.dpu.bluefield3`
- Assemblies: `asm.<system-short>.<parent-path>.<role>` → `asm.gb300.rack.compute-tray`, `asm.gb300.compute-tray.gpu`
- Enforced by a regex test (see §5). Cross-generation matching never parses IDs — it uses `roleKey`.

## 2. simEngine bug fix (must land first, batch 1)

**Bug**: `simEngine.ts:109` — `const kvBytes = kvPerTokenBytes === null ? 0 : ...` silently treats unknown KV as zero, producing inflated TPOT/tokens/s that get *more* wrong as context×batch grows. The memory path (`kvCacheGB`, `memoryBreakdown`) already propagates null correctly; decode must match.

### Signature change: overloaded `estStepMs`

```ts
// src/lib/simEngine.ts
export function estStepMs(activeParamsB: number, bytesPerParam: number,
  kvPerTokenBytes: number, contextTokens: number, batch: number,
  bandwidthTBs: number, gpuCount: number, mbu?: number): number
export function estStepMs(activeParamsB: number, bytesPerParam: number,
  kvPerTokenBytes: number | null, contextTokens: number, batch: number,
  bandwidthTBs: number, gpuCount: number, mbu?: number): number | null
export function estStepMs(/* impl */ ..., kvPerTokenBytes: number | null, ...): number | null {
  if (kvPerTokenBytes === null) return null   // 未知 KV → 不估算（即使 ctx=0 也返回 null，语义统一）
  const weightBytes = activeParamsB * 1e9 * bytesPerParam
  const kvBytes = kvPerTokenBytes * contextTokens * batch
  return ((weightBytes + kvBytes) / (bandwidthTBs * 1e12 * gpuCount * mbu ?? DEFAULT_MBU)) * 1000
}
```

Strict propagation (null in → null out, unconditionally, even at `contextTokens = 0`): mirrors `kvBytesPerToken`/`kvCacheGB` semantics exactly and prevents callers "escaping" via zero context. The overload means callers that have already narrowed KV to `number` (LifecycleSim) keep a `number` return with zero runtime cost — same pattern quality bar as `tflopsForQuant`'s basis-tagged return.

`tokensPerSecond(stepMs: number, batch)` stays unchanged; callers guard before calling it (consistent with how `estTTFTms`'s null is handled today).

### Caller adaptations

**`src/components/MemoryCalculator.tsx`** (the actual blast site, lines 37–46 and 157–168):
- In the `useMemo`: `const stepMs = estStepMs(...)` now `number | null`; `tps: stepMs === null ? null : tokensPerSecond(stepMs, batch)`.
- TPOT card (line ~160) and 吞吐 card (line ~165): render `'无法估算'` when null, with the same explanatory subline pattern the TTFT card already uses at line 151 (`'该架构 KV 参数未公开（见模型层备注），不做伪精确估算'`). The TTFT card is **unchanged** — prefill is compute-side and doesn't depend on KV; it remains valid for unsupported-KV models.
- `r.unsupported` already exists at line 30 and can drive the sublines.

**`src/components/LifecycleSim.tsx`** (lines 64–73): `SIM_MODELS` at line 21 already filters unsupported models, so null never occurs at runtime. Adapt by explicit narrowing, not `!`:

```ts
const kvPerTok = kvBytesPerToken(model.kvSpec)
// SIM_MODELS 已过滤 unsupported，此分支不可达；防御性回退首个可估算模型的语义已在上方处理
const stepMs = kvPerTok === null ? null : estStepMs(..., kvPerTok, ...)  // 命中 number 重载 → number
const tps = stepMs === null ? null : tokensPerSecond(stepMs, batch)
```

Downstream animation pacing already tolerates null via `calc.ttft ?? 800` (line ~96); apply the same `?? fallback` for decode pacing, and metric displays guard null (unreachable, but type-honest).

### Test updates (`src/lib/simEngine.test.ts`)

Change (currently pass `null` KV deliberately):
- Line 70–74 batch-linearity test: replace `estStepMs(70, 1, null, 0, 1, 3.35, 1)` with `estStepMs(70, 1, 192512, 0, 1, 3.35, 1)` — a real GQA per-token value with `contextTokens = 0`, so KV contribution is genuinely zero and the "权重 batch 共享 → 吞吐近线性" assertions are preserved unchanged.
- Line 89–93 magnitude-sanity test: same substitution (`null, 0` → `192512, 0`).

Add:
- `'未知 KV → estStepMs 返回 null 而非按 0 计（修复虚高吞吐回归）'`: `expect(estStepMs(70, 1, null, 16000, 8, 3.35, 1)).toBeNull()` and `expect(estStepMs(70, 1, null, 0, 1, 3.35, 1)).toBeNull()` (ctx=0 也不豁免).
- `'KV 已知时 decode 步长随上下文×batch 增长（此前 bug 下不增长）'`: with `192512` per-token bytes, assert `estStepMs(..., ctx=32000, batch=8, ...)` > `estStepMs(..., ctx=0, batch=8, ...)`, and that tokens/s at long context is strictly below the weights-only ceiling — this is the regression test that would have caught the original bug.

## 3. Capacity module (`src/lib/factory/capacity.ts`, batch 4)

Pure functions, no React, imports only from `src/lib/simEngine.ts`, `src/data/hardware.ts`, `src/data/models.ts` types, and `src/data/factory/`.

### API

```ts
import type { ModelSpec } from '../../data/types'
import type { QuantOption } from '../simEngine'

export interface Band { low: number; mid: number; high: number }
export const MFU_BAND = { low: 0.3, mid: 0.4, high: 0.5 }   // mid = DEFAULT_MFU
export const MBU_BAND = { low: 0.5, mid: 0.6, high: 0.7 }   // mid = DEFAULT_MBU

export interface CapacityInput {
  systemId: string                    // FactorySystem id，须带 simBridge
  rackCount?: number                  // 默认 1；>1 仅做 DP 副本线性外推（caveat 声明）
  model: ModelSpec
  quantId: QuantOption['id']
  workload: { promptTokens: number; avgContextTokens: number; batchPerReplica: number }
}

export interface CapacityEstimate {
  kind: 'estimate' | 'refused'
  reason?: string                     // refused 时：'forecast 系统不输出产能' | '关键硬件参数无官方数据' | ...
  feasible?: boolean                  // 显存能否放下（memoryBreakdown + minGpus）
  gpusPerReplica?: number
  replicas?: number                   // floor(72 × rackCount / gpusPerReplica)
  ttftMs?: Band | null                // null: 该精度无官方算力口径
  ttftBasis?: 'fp8' | 'fp4'
  tpotMs?: Band | null                // null: KV unsupported
  tokensPerSec?: Band | null          // 全系统聚合 = 单副本 band × replicas
  tokensPerWatt?: Band | null         // null: 无官方整机功率 claim
  caveats: string[]                   // 恒非空；首条固定「粗估区间（roofline 示意），非实测/可承诺产能」
  evidence: { evidenceType: 'author_opinion'; inputClaims: { label: string; sourceId: string; asOf: string }[] }
}

export function estimateSystemCapacity(input: CapacityInput): CapacityEstimate
```

### Methodology

1. **Resolve hardware via `simBridge`, not Claims**: `FACTORY_PACK.systems` → `simBridge.gpuChipId` → `GPUS` row (`b300`: 278GB, 8TB/s, fp4 15000). Roofline math single-sources from `GpuChip`; Claims supply only the rack power figure (for tokens/W) and provenance labels. This avoids two copies of bandwidth/FLOPS numbers drifting apart.
2. **Refusal gates, checked in order**:
   - `system.status === 'forecast'` → `kind: 'refused'` (Rubin Ultra NVL576 never produces numbers — PLAN.md hard rule: analyst material can't drive capacity).
   - Missing `simBridge` or `GpuChip` fields null (e.g. Vera Rubin bandwidth unpublished) → refuse or partial-null with caveat naming the missing official datum.
3. **Memory/replicas**: `memoryBreakdown(model.totalParamsB, quant.bytesPerParam, model.kvSpec, avgContextTokens, batchPerReplica)` → `minGpus(totalGB, gpu.memoryGB)` → `gpusPerReplica`; `replicas = floor(gpuCount × rackCount / gpusPerReplica)`; `feasible = replicas >= 1`. Unsupported-KV models: fall back to weights+overhead lower bound for `gpusPerReplica` (as MemoryCalculator does) but `tpotMs`/`tokensPerSec` are null.
4. **Bands**: TTFT via `estTTFTms` evaluated at MFU {0.5, 0.4, 0.3} → {low, mid, high} ms (note inversion: high utilization = low latency); TPOT via `estStepMs` at MBU {0.7, 0.6, 0.5}; `tokensPerSec` band from TPOT band via `tokensPerSecond` × replicas. **Never** `fp4Pflops × constant → tokens/s`; the peak-FLOPS path simply does not exist in this module.
5. **tokens/W**: `tokensPerSec / (rackPowerKW × 1000 × rackCount)` where `rackPowerKW` comes from the GB300 system's `keySpecs.rackPowerKW` Claim (vendor_claim, exact locator recorded). Claim value null → `tokensPerWatt: null` + caveat.
6. **Explicit non-goals, documented in the module header and asserted by tests**: no goodput, no SLA/P95, no cost/TCO, no cross-rack TP/EP, no interconnect contention, no training. Cross-rack `rackCount > 1` is DP-replica linear extrapolation with a caveat string saying exactly that. Output labeled 粗估区间; result evidence is `author_opinion` (the methodology is ours) with `inputClaims` referencing the vendor claims consumed.

**Prerequisite content work in batch 4**: add `simBridge: { gpuChipId: 'b300', gpuCount: 72 }` to the GB300 system. For Vera Rubin, optionally add a `rubin` row to `GPUS` in `src/data/hardware.ts` containing **only** officially published values (nulls elsewhere, per the `h20` precedent) — capacity then degrades gracefully via the null gates. Needs user confirmation (see §7).

### `capacity.test.ts` cases

- `'band 有序：low ≤ mid ≤ high（tokens/s 与 tokens/W）'`
- `'GB300 + DeepSeek-V3 FP8 已知算例：mid 档与手算 roofline 一致（±ε）'`
- `'MFU/MBU band 端点与常量一致（mid=DEFAULT_MFU/MBU）'`
- `'KV unsupported 模型 → tpot/tokensPerSec 为 null 且 caveat 说明'`
- `'forecast 系统（NVL576）→ kind=refused，不产生任何数字'`
- `'GpuChip 关键字段 null（如 rubin 带宽未公布）→ 拒绝并点名缺失项'`
- `'无整机功率 claim → tokensPerWatt null'`
- `'replicas 计算：显存装不下 → feasible=false；rackCount=2 → tokens/s 恰好 2×（DP 线性外推）'`
- `'caveats 恒非空且首条为粗估声明'`

| id | kind | acquisition |

| `src.nvidia-nvl72-ra` | official_doc | Fetch during implementation from `docs.nvidia.com/enterprise-reference-architectures/nvl72-ai-factory/latest/components.html` (+ sibling pages for topology/power/cooling) |
| `src.nvidia-gb300-page` | official_doc | nvidia.com GB300 NVL72 page (already cited by `hardware.ts`) |

| `src.semianalysis-nvl576` | analyst_report | Local PDF `Rubin Ultra NVL576 架构：快速概览.pdf` (**SemiAnalysis, 2026-08-10 — verified not NVIDIA**) |
| `src.waic2026-deck` | internal_deck | Local `超节点-WAIC2026.pptx` |
| `src.marvell-fy27q1-call` | earnings_call | Local PDF — background only |

### Extraction plan (during implementation, read-only Claude work)

- **NVIDIA NVL72 RA (fetch)** → the GB300 master: component inventory and counts (compute trays, NVSwitch trays, power shelves, mgmt switches), rail-optimized Spectrum-X scale-out reference topology, ConnectX-8/BlueField-3 placement, liquid-cooling loop, multi-rack pod sizing. Evidence `verified_spec`/`vendor_claim`.
- **Rubin launch PDF (fetch)** → announced-only claims: Rubin GPU, Vera CPU, NVLink 6 (3.6TB/s per GPU per existing `INTERCONNECT_NOTES`), ConnectX-9, BlueField-4, HBM4, NVL72 form factor. Anything absent stays `Claim.value: null`.
- **SemiAnalysis NVL576 PDF (local, already skimmed)** → forecast claims: 8× Oberon racks; per-rack 9+18+9 layout (18 compute trays kept, split top/bottom); 18× 0.75U NVSwitch-7 trays × 2 ASICs = 36 ASICs/rack (parity with Rubin Oberon); 3U 110kW power shelves; compute tray = 2 Vera + 4 Rubin Ultra; GPU TDP 1.8–2.6kW; NPO-first inter-rack. All `forecast`/`analyst_estimate` with page locators. **The roadmap spec table (FP4 PFLOPS, HBM figures) is SemiAnalysis-estimated — it must NOT flow into `GPUS` or capacity.**
- **WAIC PPTX (local)** → text extraction via read-only `unzip -p … ppt/slides/slideN.xml` at implementation time; slides 3/5/17 become: supernode definition copy (tour narration), MoE flow narration (FlowStep text), 能跑→跑对→跑快→跑稳→跑省 (presalesNote framework). Evidence `author_opinion` (internal deck). Slide 18 excluded per PLAN.md.
- **Marvell/GS/JPM PDFs** → 2–3 background/roadmap `Claim`s (e.g. custom-silicon market direction) attached to a comparison summary or system-level narrative only; a dedicated test forbids these sourceIds on any `countClaim` or component spec.

## 7. Risks and mitigations

**Data-accuracy traps (things commonly gotten wrong):**
- **NVSwitch tray/ASIC counts**: NVL72 = 9 trays × 2 NVLink-5 ASICs = 18 chips — frequently misquoted as 18 trays or 9 chips. NVL576 doubles *trays* to 18 (0.75U) but keeps 36 ASICs/rack — and that is *analyst forecast*, not official. Mitigated by `countClaim` + the explicit quantity tests.
- **ConnectX/BlueField generation per platform**: GB300 → CX-8/BF-3; Rubin → CX-9/BF-4; easy to slip a generation. Dedicated content tests pin these.
- **Compute-tray composition**: GB300 tray = 2 Grace + 4 Blackwell Ultra (72/18); GB200-era "Bianca board" descriptions (1 Grace : 2 GPU superchips) get pasted into GB300 write-ups. The multiplication invariants (18×4=72, 18×2=36, cross-checked against `RACKS`) catch this.
- **Rack power figure** for tokens/W varies ~120–142kW across sources/configs → record exactly one vendor_claim with locator; capacity caveat names it. **Needs boss/user confirmation of which official figure to adopt.**
- **Official/analyst contamination**: the NVL576 PDF *looks* authoritative but is SemiAnalysis; the `verified_spec→official-source-only` test and the forecast-refusal gate in capacity make contamination structurally impossible rather than a review-time hope.

**Stale-source risk**: every Claim carries `asOf` + locator; the evidence system surfaces age in UI (other agent), and re-verification is a grep for `sourceId`. Rubin specs are "announced" and will churn — sparse-claim design (null until published) means updates are additive.

**Other confirmations to flag to user/boss**: (a) whether Vera Rubin gets a partial capacity estimate (requires adding a `rubin` GpuChip row) or is refused like NVL576 in v1; (b) default reference model for capacity (`deepseek-v3` vs `qwen3-235b`); (c) GB300 rack power figure; (d) how much of the RA's storage/mgmt detail to model vs simplify at board LOD.

### Zustand store shape (`factoryStore.ts`)

```ts
export type DrillLevel = 'cluster' | 'rack' | 'tray' | 'board'
export type ViewMode  = 'explore' | 'compare' | 'tour'

interface FactoryUiState {
  generation: GenerationId                // 'gb300-nvl72' | 'vr-nvl72' | 'rubin-ultra-nvl576'
  level: DrillLevel
  focusPath: string[]                     // assembly node ids root→focus; breadcrumb & camera preset derive from this
  selectedId: string | null               // detail panel target (component OR assembly node)
  hoveredId: string | null
  planes: Record<PlaneId, boolean>        // six toggles (persisted)
  mode: ViewMode
  compare: { right: GenerationId; showDiffOnly: boolean }
  flow: { episodeIdx: number; playing: boolean; speed: 0.5|1|2 }   // NO per-frame t here
  tourStopIdx: number
  reducedMotion: boolean                  // seeded from prefers-reduced-motion, user-overridable (persisted)
  glStatus: 'unknown' | 'ok' | 'failed'   // failed → Fallback2D
  ready: boolean                          // set after first rendered frame → data-ready attr for Playwright
  // actions: drillTo(nodeId), drillUp(), select(id), setPlane(id,on), play/pause/step, setMode, setGeneration, ...
}
```

- `drillTo/drillUp` delegate to pure `drill.ts` (`nextState(state, action, pack)`) so transitions are node-testable; the store is a thin binding.
- **Per-frame flow progress `t` lives in a mutable ref inside `FlowLayer`**, never in zustand — the DOM `FlowBar` only needs episode-granularity updates (`episodeIdx`), which `FlowLayer` pushes when crossing segment boundaries. This avoids React re-render per frame (the classic R3F + store mistake).
- Persist (like `paperUiStore`'s LayoutPrefs, with a `sanitize` on rehydrate): `planes`, `reducedMotion`, `generation` only. Everything else is session state.

### Semantic LOD = React mount/unmount, not `THREE.LOD`

`SceneRoot` switches subtree by `level`:

- **cluster**: rack shells only via one `<Instances>` per generation visual type (8–64 instances), scale-out spine switches as boxes, floor `<Grid>`. Tray children never mounted → the "8-rack overview never expands board detail" perf requirement is structural, not an optimization.
- **rack**: focused rack fully detailed — 18 compute trays + 9 NVSwitch trays as `<Instances>` of tray-front shapes placed by rack-U from `layout.ts`, power shelves, CDU/manifolds; neighbor racks stay as shared ghost-material shells for context. Tray internals not mounted.
- **tray**: focused tray with lid off — board plane + major components as chip shapes; rack ghosted around it.
- **board**: same `TrayScene` with explode offsets applied (lerp positions along +y, precomputed in `layout.ts` as `explodedPos`), full GPU/HBM/NIC/DPU detail with `<Edges>`.

Drill interaction: click selects (detail panel), the panel's 「进入 →」 button or double-click drills. On drill: store updates `focusPath` → `CameraRig` runs `controls.setLookAt(...preset, true)` (camera-controls' built-in smooth transition); content swaps immediately (v1 accepts the pop — a cross-fade is a polish item, noted in code).

### Instancing decision: drei `<Instances>`, not manual `InstancedMesh`

Counts are small (≤64 racks, 27 trays, 72 GPU packages): drei `<Instances>/<Instance>` gives declarative per-instance color (diff/status tint) and **per-instance raycast events** (hover/select on individual trays/racks) for free. Manual `InstancedMesh` only in `FlowLayer` (~64 pulses, matrices written imperatively in `useFrame`). Document the threshold in `GenericShapes.tsx`: >~5k instances → switch to manual.

### Selection/hover raycasting

R3F's built-in pointer events (raycast happens on the DOM event, so it works fine under `frameloop="demand"`). `Hotspot.tsx` wires `onPointerOver/Out/Click`, sets `document.body.style.cursor`, stops propagation so nested hotspots (tray inside rack) resolve to the deepest hit. Decorative meshes (floor, cables, ghosts) get `raycast={() => null}`. Highlight = emissive/color bump on state change + `invalidate()` — no postprocessing outline pass.

### Rendering look (light theme)

Scene background = `--color-ink` (#f4f1e8) via `palette.ts` bridge (Tailwind is inert inside the canvas — every color goes through this module). One ambient + one directional light, `MeshStandardMaterial` flat studio look, `<Edges>` for the schematic "高质量示意" language. Product-status materials: GB300 solid; Vera Rubin blue-tinted solid; Rubin Ultra amber `wireframe: true` + amber edges. No shadows in v1 (demand-mode friendly; `ContactShadows frames={1}` is an optional polish).

## 3. Connection planes & flow animation

### Plane overlays (`ConnectionLayer.tsx`)

- `routing.ts` resolves each `Connection`'s endpoints to port anchor points on the component boxes (per-plane face convention: NVLink → rear backplane, scale-out/business/mgmt → rear top cage, power → rear bus bar, cooling → side manifolds) and emits deterministic orthogonal polylines with a **per-plane lane offset** so six planes never overlap; also emits the cumulative arc-length LUT used by the flow layer.
- Rendering: per enabled plane, one drei `<Line>` (Line2 fat lines, `linewidth` 1.5–2.5) per connection at rack/tray level; at cluster level, scale-out only, merged into few polylines. Six plane colors defined in `palette.ts` (NVLink NVIDIA-green #76b900, scale-out violet `--color-accent-2`, business blue, management gray `--color-dim`, power `--color-amber`, cooling cyan) — mirrored 1:1 in the `PlaneToggles` DOM legend and the fallback table.
- Toggling a plane just mounts/unmounts its `<Line>` group + `invalidate()`.

### Flow animation (`flowTimeline.ts` + `FlowLayer.tsx` + `FlowBar.tsx`)

- `flowTimeline.ts` (pure): `FlowEpisode[]` → `TimelineSegment[]` with normalized `t0/t1` per pacing weights, each segment referencing a routed path LUT. Unit tests assert path continuity across consecutive connections and monotonic timing.
- `FlowLayer`: one `InstancedMesh` of small emissive quads/spheres; `useFrame((_, delta))` advances `tRef += delta * speed`, samples LUTs, writes instance matrices, marks `instanceMatrix.needsUpdate`. On segment-boundary crossing it calls `store.setEpisodeIdx()` so the DOM `FlowBar` step bar tracks (LifecycleSim's active/done/pending visual states, ported verbatim).
- **Logical vs physical**: episodes carry a `logical|physical` tag. Physical episodes animate pulses along connections; logical stages (Gateway auth, router decision, KV-cache semantics) render as 「逻辑层」-badged steps in the FlowBar with narration text — no fake 3D node. Resident weights: HBM gets a steady glow (not moving particles) annotated 「权重常驻 HBM，不随请求加载」.
- **Frameloop policy** (the whole policy, in one place in `FactoryCanvas.tsx`):
  ```tsx
  <Canvas frameloop={flow.playing ? 'always' : 'demand'} dpr={[1, isMobile ? 1.5 : 1.75]} ...>
  ```
  Everything else runs on demand: drei `CameraControls` auto-invalidates during orbit and `setLookAt` transitions, and hover/toggle/select handlers call `invalidate()`. `visibilitychange` → hidden pauses `flow.playing` explicitly (rAF stops anyway on hidden tabs, but pausing the store keeps the step bar honest on return). `reducedMotion` → playback becomes discrete stepping: no particles, current episode's connections statically highlighted instead (matches the PLAN.md test requirement "减少动态效果设置下不播放粒子动画").

## 4. Comparison mode — one Canvas, two synced viewports

`ComparisonView.tsx`:

```tsx
<div ref={container} className="grid h-full grid-cols-2 gap-px">
  <div ref={leftRef} className="relative" /> <div ref={rightRef} className="relative" />
  <Canvas frameloop="demand" eventSource={container} className="!absolute inset-0">
    <View track={leftRef}> <SceneRoot generation={generation} diffRole="left" /> <CameraRig master /> </View>
    <View track={rightRef}><SceneRoot generation={compare.right} diffRole="right" /><SlaveCamera poseRef={poseRef} /></View>
  </Canvas>
</div>
```

- **drei `<View>`** = one WebGL context, per-view `gl.setScissor` — exactly the "same-Canvas, no duplicate context" requirement. Camera sync: master `CameraControls` (left) writes position/target into a shared `poseRef` on its update event; `SlaveCamera` copies the pose in a `useFrame` and the shared demand loop re-renders both views on the same invalidation. Plan B (documented in a comment, ~40 lines): if `<View>` + demand mode misbehaves in drei 9.122, replace with a manual `useFrame(priority=1)` doing two scissored `gl.render(scene, cam)` passes — same architecture, no dependency change.
- Comparison depth: cluster + rack levels in v1 (tray/board compare only if the pack provides matched internals).
- **Diff highlighting** (consumes the data agent's `ComparisonDefinition` matcher output, keyed by stable component IDs): unchanged = default status material; spec-changed = accent outline (`<Edges color>`); qty-changed = outline + count delta in the DOM diff list; added = ok-green edges (right only); removed = bad-red edges (left only). `showDiffOnly` drops unchanged parts to ~8% opacity (shared ghost material). Detailed diff text lives in a DOM list in the right panel — not 3D labels (cheap, CJK-safe, screen-reader-visible).
- **Capacity band cards**: `CapacityBands.tsx` is a dumb props component rendered under the canvas in compare mode; it takes whatever the data agent's engine returns (low/mid/high bands + assumptions + evidence status) and renders theme-token cards. UI slot only — zero engine logic here.

---

## 5. 2D fallback & mobile tour

**Shared-by-construction**: breadcrumb, tour panel, plane toggles, detail panel, flow bar are all plain DOM in `FactoryPage` — the *only* thing that swaps is the center cell: `FactoryCanvas` vs `Fallback2D`.

- `webgl.ts` runs once on mount (`canvas.getContext('webgl2') || getContext('webgl')`, wrapped in try/catch; `?gl=off` search param forces `'none'` for tests/demos). Additionally: `Canvas onCreated` failure and a `webglcontextlost` listener flip `glStatus='failed'` → swap to `Fallback2D` with a toast 「3D 初始化失败，已切换 2D 结构视图」. Never a blank page: `ErrorBoundary` on the route is the last net.
- `Fallback2D` center = `SegmentedTabs`(结构图 | 组件树 | 连接列表): `RackElevationSvg` (SVG front elevation computed from the same `layout.ts` rack-U data; rects colored by component kind; click = same `select()` action), `ComponentTree`, `ConnectionListTable` (filtered by the same plane toggles). Flow playback in fallback highlights table rows/elevation slots per episode instead of particles — `FlowBar` works unchanged.
- **Mobile** (`useMediaQuery(MQ.md)` false): `MobileFactoryView` — condensed breadcrumb, 3D canvas with `CameraControls enabled={false}` (no orbit/explode), auto tour stepping through `TOUR_STOPS` (content-pack scenes → `cameraPresets.ts` — the *same* preset functions the desktop drill-down and Playwright shots use), hotspot list below the canvas (tap = fly + select), details in the existing `components/ui/Drawer`. dpr capped `[1, 1.5]`. No WebGL on the phone → same `Fallback2D` stack, which is fully touch-usable.

## 6. Printable report

- Separate lazy route `/factory/report` (`FactoryReportPage.tsx`), **DOM-only — importing anything from `components/factory/scene/` or three is forbidden** (enforce by review + a comment; it may import `data/factory`, `lib/factory/layout|flowTimeline`, and `fallback/RackElevationSvg` + diff table + `CapacityBands`). This means printing works even where WebGL doesn't, and the report chunk stays ~tens of KB.
- Sections per requirement: 需求背景 / 当前架构 (RackElevationSvg + key claims) / 推理数据流 (episode list + narration) / 代际变化 (diff table + capacity bands) / 证据边界 (claims grouped by evidence type with status chips) / 下一阶段.
- Print styling: Tailwind v4 `print:` variants on the page (`print:break-inside-avoid`, grayscale-safe borders); add `print:hidden` to the App `<header>` and `MobileTabBar` `<nav>` (one class each — harmless globally, desirable everywhere). 「打印 / 导出 PDF」 button = `window.print()`. Entry link in the factory breadcrumb bar.

### Node-env Vitest (fits existing `src/**/*.test.ts` include, zero config change)

| File | Asserts |
|---|---|
| `lib/factory/layout.test.ts` | rack-U → y math, 18+9 tray placement non-overlap, cluster pitch, deterministic output for same pack |
| `lib/factory/routing.test.ts` | polyline continuity (segment endpoints join), per-plane lane separation, endpoints anchor on component boxes, LUT monotonic |
| `lib/factory/drill.test.ts` | legal/illegal transitions per level, focusPath/breadcrumb derivation, drillUp inverse |
| `lib/factory/cameraPresets.test.ts` | preset frustum-fits focus bounding box (pure math: distance ≥ fit distance), per-level clamps |
| `lib/factory/flowTimeline.test.ts` | episode path continuity across connections, t0/t1 monotonic and normalized, logical episodes carry no path |
| `pages/factory/factoryStore.test.ts` | plane toggles persist-sanitize round-trip, play/pause/step transitions, reducedMotion forces discrete stepping, glStatus fallback flip |

The "no three imports in `lib/factory/`" rule is what makes all of this run in plain node. `webgl.ts` detection gets a `// @vitest-environment happy-dom` test (happy-dom returns null contexts → `'none'` path).

The installed `playwright@1.52` package already bundles the test runner (`playwright/test` entry) — **no new dependency**, just scaffolding:

Headless Chromium renders WebGL via SwiftShader → deterministic on a given machine/CI image; use `toHaveScreenshot({ maxDiffPixelRatio: 0.02 })`.
- Determinism plumbing = `useShotParams.ts`: HashRouter URLs like `/#/factory?level=rack&focus=rack-1&planes=nvlink,power&motion=off&gl=off&mode=compare` seed the store once on mount (doubles as a shareable-deep-link feature). Page sets `data-ready="1"` on the canvas container after the first rendered frame (`ready` flag set from a one-shot `useFrame`); specs `await locator('[data-ready="1"]')` before shooting.

Script `"test:e2e": "playwright test"` — intentionally **not** part of `npm test` (existing typecheck/test/build gate stays untouched); snapshots committed; doc note to run `npx playwright install chromium` once.

## 9. Risks & mitigations (R3F into this codebase)

1. **React-18 / R3F version wall** (highest): fiber 9 & drei 10 need React 19. Mitigation: exact pins (§1.1), a loud comment in `FactoryCanvas.tsx`, and no `^`-floating on `three` (drei 9.x + three ≥0.17x combos can break silently).
2. **StrictMode double-mount** (`main.tsx` has `<StrictMode>`): all Three resource creation must be idempotent — geometry/material as module-level shared constants or `useMemo`, dispose in cleanup; never create resources in effect bodies with side effects outside React.
3. **Per-frame state → React re-render storms**: flow `t` and camera pose stay in refs; zustand receives only coarse events (episode index, level). Enforced by the store-shape rule in §2.
4. **Bundle size**: ~300 KB gz factory chunk is acceptable *only* because isolation is airtight — the flag-off build diff check in Batch 1 acceptance is the guardrail; drei import allowlist prevents accidental HDR/troika/CDN pulls.
5. **Tailwind is nil inside the canvas**: every color flows through `lib/factory/palette.ts` (reads the `--color-*` tokens at runtime with fallbacks) so a future theme change doesn't fork the 3D look; all text/labels are DOM (Html/panels) so CJK fonts and theme come free.
6. **Safari/iOS WebGL quirks**: dpr cap 1.5 on mobile (memory), context-lost listener → fallback (iOS Safari sheds contexts under pressure), animation driven by clock `delta` not frame count (low-power-mode rAF throttling), `powerPreference: 'high-performance'`.
7. **`frameloop="demand"` + controls/View interplay**: drei CameraControls auto-invalidates, but the `<View>` + demand combination in drei 9.122 is the least-battle-tested piece — hence the documented manual-scissor plan B in `ComparisonView` that changes no architecture.
8. **Node-env test purity**: any accidental `import ... from 'three'` in `lib/factory/` breaks the whole node test suite — the rule is stated in each lib file header; tuple-based math keeps it honest.
9. **HashRouter deep links**: shot/deep-link params live inside the hash (`/#/factory?...`) — `useSearchParams` handles it, but Playwright specs must navigate hash URLs (noted in the spec file).

- 帧循环策略集中一处：`frameloop={playing ? 'always' : 'demand'}`，dpr 桌面 [1,1.75] / 移动 [1,1.5]，visibilitychange 暂停，reducedMotion → 离散步进（不放粒子，静态高亮当前连接）。
- 连接平面：`routing.ts` 纯函数出正交折线 + 每平面 lane 偏移 + 弧长 LUT；每平面一组 drei `<Line>`；六色定义于 `palette.ts`（NVLink #76b900 等），DOM 图例/降级表 1:1 复用。颜色全部经 `palette.ts` 读 `--color-*` CSS 变量（Tailwind 在 canvas 内失效）。
- 数据流：`flowTimeline.ts` 纯函数出 TimelineSegment；FlowLayer 一个 InstancedMesh 粒子 useFrame 驱动；跨段边界回写 episodeIdx 给 DOM FlowBar（LifecycleSim 步骤条模式移植，逻辑/物理徽章；HBM 常亮注「权重常驻 HBM，不随请求加载」）。
- 比较模式：单 Canvas + drei `<View>` 双视口（gl.setScissor），主相机 CameraControls 写 poseRef，从相机复制；diff 按 roleKey 配对结果高亮（新增绿边/移除红边/变更 accent 边/showDiffOnly ghost 8%）；详细 diff 文本在 DOM 列表。若 View+demand 不稳，plan B = 手动双 scissor render（注释预案）。产能 band 卡片 `CapacityBands` 为纯 props 组件。
- 状态材质：GB300 实体；Vera Rubin 蓝调实体；Rubin Ultra 琥珀 wireframe。无阴影。
- 降级/移动端：面包屑/导览/平面开关/详情/步骤条全是 DOM，仅中央格切换 Canvas↔`Fallback2D`（SegmentedTabs: 结构图 SVG 立面/组件树/连接表，流播放改行高亮）；`webgl.ts` 检测 + `?gl=off` 强制 + context-lost 监听 → 永不白屏。移动端 `MobileFactoryView`：禁 orbit、自动导览走同一 `cameraPresets.ts`、热点列表 + 现有 Drawer。
- 报告：`/factory/report` 独立懒路由，**禁止导入 three/scene**（复用 RackElevationSvg + diff 表 + CapacityBands + 证据分组），Tailwind `print:` 变体，`window.print()`；App header/MobileTabBar 加 `print:hidden`。
- 深链/测试确定性：`useShotParams.ts` 读 URL 参数（HashRouter hash 内）一次性 seed store；首帧后 `data-ready="1"`。

## 实施批次（5 批，每批结束 `typecheck` + `test` + `build` 全绿）

**B1 — 引擎修复 + 内容包地基 + GB300 数据**：simEngine 重载修复 + 测试更新 + MemoryCalculator/LifecycleSim 守卫；`data/factory/types.ts`（冻结）+ `sources.ts`（7 源全注册）+ `shared.ts` + `gb300-nvl72.ts` + `index.ts` + `pack.test.ts` + GB300 `content.test.ts`（18/9 tray、72 GPU=18×4、CX-8/BF-3 等不变量）。需抓取 NVIDIA NVL72 RA 页。

**B2 — 3D 下钻查看器（可用里程碑）**：依赖锁定 + `factoryOffPlugin` + flag + nav/App 路由；`lib/factory/` layout/drill/cameraPresets/webgl/palette + 测试；FactoryPage 骨架 + factoryStore + useShotParams；scene 基础组件 + BreadcrumbBar + DetailPanel + 最小降级（组件树）。验收：集群→机架→托盘→板卡下钻 + 点选详情；flag-off 构建零污染。

**B3 — 六平面 + 推理数据流**：`routing.ts`/`flowTimeline.ts` + 测试；ConnectionLayer/PlaneToggles/FlowLayer/FlowBar；帧循环策略/visibilitychange/reducedMotion；WAIC pptx 抽文案 → `flows.ts`（七阶段 episode + presalesNote）+ flow 测试。

**B4 — 代际 + 比较 + 产能 + 报告**：抓 Rubin 发布 PDF → `vera-rubin-nvl72.ts`；SemiAnalysis PDF → `rubin-ultra-nvl576.ts`（全 forecast）；`comparisons.ts` + 状态一致性/券商源禁令/配对确定性测试；GB300 `simBridge` + `hardware.ts` 增 `rubin` 行（仅官方值，其余 null）；`capacity.ts` + 测试；ComparisonView + diff 材质 + CapacityBands + 代际切换；FactoryReportPage + print。

**B5 — 移动端 + 完整降级 + E2E harness + 性能**：MobileFactoryView 自动导览；完整 Fallback2D；`playwright.config.ts` + `tests/e2e/factory.spec.ts`（桌面 1440×900 / 移动 390×844 / `gl=off`，`data-ready` 等待，`test:e2e` 脚本独立于 `npm test`）+ 截图基线；context-lost 处理；性能收口（raycast 剪枝、ghost 共享材质、dpr 审计）。

## 代理调度与验证策略（用户指定）

实现按批次派发专属子代理（general-purpose），模型按任务难度分配：
- **opus**：B1（引擎修复 + 事实性内容编写，需抓官方源、证据纪律）、B2（R3F 架构引入，版本墙/StrictMode 陷阱多）、B4（比较 + 产能引擎 + 多源数据）。
- **sonnet**：B3（在既定纯函数骨架上的机械性较强实现）、B5（harness 脚手架 + 打磨）。
- **fable（主循环/验证）**：每批完成后由主循环审查关键产出（类型冻结、证据纪律、隔离验收），必要时派 fable 级审查代理核对高风险点（NVSwitch 数量、CX/BF 代际、官方/分析师源污染）。
- 每批交付定义：typecheck/test/build 全绿 + 该批验收条款通过 + 向主循环报告实际结果（不得只报「完成」）。

**E2E 跟进代理（禁用 fable → 用 opus）**：全批次交付后启动专属子代理，职责：
1. 起 dev/preview 服务，API 层面验证（路由可达、flag on/off 构建产物、chunk 隔离）。
2. 通过 claude-in-chrome 浏览器实测：下钻全链路、详情面板、六平面开关、流播放/暂停/步进、比较模式、产能卡、`?gl=off` 降级、390×844 移动视图、`/factory/report` 打印视图。
3. 按 P0（白屏/崩溃/数据错误/隔离破坏）/ P1（核心交互失效/明显视觉破坏）/ P2（打磨项）分级报告；**P0/P1 修复后复测，循环直至 P0/P1 = 0**；P2 列表留档。

# AI Factory 3D 数字孪生模拟器 — 独立项目实施计划

## Context

用户是新入行 AI Factory 领域的售前解决方案架构师（互联网大厂研发背景），需要一个「算力集群模拟器」快速建立硬件主线认知：从多机架集群下钻到 GB300 NVL72 机架、Compute Tray、板卡、GPU/HBM/NIC/DPU；查看任意部件的作用/规格/连接；播放推理数据流动画理解各部件协同；对比 GB300 / Vera Rubin / Rubin Ultra 代际差异；粗估硬件方案调整对 token 产能的影响。它同时是给老板汇报「AI Factory 整体方案」的载体。

**实现载体（用户指定）：在 `~/projects/aifactory` 独立新建工作区，不在现有 llms-study 中实现。** llms-study（`/Users/caoruixin/projects/llms-study`）仅作只读参考：其 roofline 引擎数学、数据约定与 UI 模式可移植，不修改其任何文件。原始需求草稿 `~/projects/aifactory/PLAN.md`（其四周学习节奏与汇报脚本部分保持有效，本计划只覆盖实现，且落地位置由 llms-study `/factory` 模块改为独立应用）。

## 用户已定决策

1. **直接上 3D**（three.js + R3F，语义 LOD），2D 仅作 WebGL 降级视图。
2. **首版就带 token 产能粗估**：低/中/高区间 band，明确标注「粗估」。
3. **实现压缩为批次交付**（Claude Code 代理承担），用户保留四周学习节奏。
4. **独立工作区** `~/projects/aifactory`（本次改向）。
5. **代理调度**：用 fable/opus/sonnet 分派实现与验证；E2E 跟进代理不用 fable，通过 API + 浏览器测试，修复 P0/P1 直至清零。

## 新项目脚手架与技术栈

全新项目 → 无历史包袱，直接用最新栈（llms-study 的 React 18 版本墙不适用）：

- **Vite 7 + React 19 + TypeScript strict**；`three`（最新稳定）+ `@react-three/fiber@^9` + `@react-three/drei@^10`；`zustand@5`；`react-router-dom@7`（两条路由：`/` 主工作台、`/report` 打印报告，report 懒加载且禁止导入 three）；Tailwind CSS v4（`@tailwindcss/vite`），自定义 `@theme` tokens（浅色主题、CJK 字体栈，风格参照 llms-study）。
- 测试：Vitest（node env，`src/**/*.test.ts`）+ Playwright（`@playwright/test`，新建 config）。
- drei 导入白名单：`Instances/Instance, Line, Html, CameraControls, View, Edges, Grid`；禁 `Environment/Sky/Text/useGLTF`（CDN 资产/CJK 字体问题）。所有文字标签走 DOM。
- 无需包隔离/feature flag（整个应用就是 factory）。
- Git：`git init` + `.gitignore`（node_modules、dist、`sources/` 大文件）；每批次结束提交一次（含 Co-Authored-By 署名）。

## 内容包数据模型（TS 模块 + 测试，不用 zod）

理由：TS 判别联合编辑期强于 zod 运行期；引用完整性只能靠测试；`types.ts` 保持纯 JSON 可序列化（加 JSON 往返测试），未来做场景导入时再在信任边界加 zod。

核心类型（`src/data/types.ts`，批次 1 末冻结字段名，此后只增不改）：

- `EvidenceType = verified_spec|vendor_claim|benchmark|management_guidance|analyst_estimate|forecast|author_opinion`；`ProductStatus = shipping|announced|forecast`；`NetworkPlane = nvlink|scaleout|business|mgmt|power|cooling`。
- `SourceRef`（id/title/publisher/kind: official_doc|official_press|analyst_report|earnings_call|internal_deck/url/localFile/asOf）。
- `Claim`（value 可 null=「官方未公布不编数」/unit/evidence/status/sourceId/locator/asOf/confidence/note）。
- `HardwareComponent`：按 kind 判别联合（gpu/cpu/hbm/tray/rack/switch/nic/dpu/storage/power/cooling/facility），含 `visual: {shape: VisualShape; wireframe?}` 通用外形（3D 侧只认外形不认型号）、`summary`、`presalesNote`（售前怎么解释）、`imageUrl` 实物外链、`sourceIds`。GPU 组件额外带 `mathSpecs: {memoryGB, bandwidthTBs, fp8Tflops, fp4Tflops, tdpW} | null`（roofline 数学输入，与 Claim 证据展示分离；仅官方公布值，未公布整体为 null）。
- `FactorySystem`（id/status/generation/referenceUrl/keySpecs: Record<string, Claim>，含 gpuCount、rackPowerKW）。
- `AssemblyNode`（parentId 树、**`roleKey` 为跨代比较的稳定语义键**、count + 关键数量必带 countClaim、rack-U 占位、lodLevel: cluster|rack|tray|board）。
- `Connection`（按类型不按实例：一条 gpu→nvswitch 边 + `topology: all-to-all|rail-optimized|fat-tree|star|bus|loop`，非 72×18 条；plane/medium/protocol/bandwidth?: Claim/direction）。
- `FlowEpisode/FlowStep`（phase: ingress→prefill→kv-write→decode→moe-dispatch→moe-combine→egress；`logicalOnly` 标记逻辑层步骤；durationHint 仅教学节奏，注释强制声明非真实时延）。
- `ComparisonDefinition`（roleKey 自动配对 + narrative overrides + summary 要点）；`ScenePreset`（导览语义，相机数字归 3D 侧）。
- `ModelSpec/KVSpec`：从 llms-study `src/data/models.ts` 移植类型 + 2~3 个参考模型行（deepseek-v3 为默认，KV 已知的 MoE，契合 MoE 动画叙事）。
- ID 规范：`src.|cmp.|sys.|asm.|con.|flow.|cmpdef.|scene.` 前缀，regex 测试强制；比较匹配永不解析 ID，只用 roleKey。

内容量级：shared ~8 组件（Oberon 机架壳/busbar/CDU/manifold/cold-plate/管理交换机/facility）；GB300 ~14 组件/28 装配/30 连接（全深度：18 compute tray + 9 NVSwitch tray；tray = 2 Grace + 4 B300 + 4 CX-8 + BF-3；六平面）；Vera Rubin ~8/24/24（仅官方已公布，未公布 value:null）；Rubin Ultra ~6/26/18（粗粒度，全 forecast）。作序：shared → GB300 全量 → Vera Rubin（复制骨架改 diff）→ Rubin Ultra。

### 内容测试不变量（`pack.test.ts` / `content.test.ts` 代表性用例）

全集合 ID 唯一与命名规范；JSON 往返；装配树每系统单根/无环/引用存在；连接端点同系统存在；Claim 的 sourceId 存在 + asOf 格式 + evidence 合法；**verified_spec/vendor_claim 只能引用官方源**；券商源禁令；状态一致性（shipping 系统无 forecast 组件）；Rack U 兄弟不重叠不超高；GB300：18×compute tray、9×NVSwitch tray、GPU=18×4=72、Grace=36、CX-8/BF-3（非上代）；NVL576 全 claim ∈ {forecast, analyst_estimate}；比较配对确定性（每 roleKey 两侧至多一对）与核心 roleKey 覆盖；flow 连接引用存在、phase 单调、非 logicalOnly 相邻步骤路径连通。

## Roofline 引擎与产能粗估

**`src/lib/roofline.ts`**：从 llms-study `src/lib/simEngine.ts` 移植数学（weightMemoryGB / kvBytesPerToken / kvCacheGB / memoryBreakdown / minGpus / tflopsForQuant / estTTFTms / estStepMs / tokensPerSecond / QUANTS，弃成本函数），**一开始就正确传播 null**：`estStepMs` 在 KV 未知时返回 null（含 ctx=0），不再有「null 当 0 → 吞吐虚高」bug。附移植测试 + 「KV 已知时步长随 ctx×batch 增长」回归用例。

**`src/lib/capacity.ts`**：`estimateSystemCapacity({systemId, rackCount=1, model, quantId, workload}) → CapacityEstimate`：

- 输出 `{kind: estimate|refused, reason?, feasible, gpusPerReplica, replicas, ttftMs/tpotMs/tokensPerSec/tokensPerWatt: Band{low,mid,high}|null, caveats[], evidence}`。
- Band 方法：MFU {0.3,0.4,0.5} / MBU {0.5,0.6,0.7}；replicas = floor(gpuCount×racks / minGpus)；tokens/W 用系统 rackPowerKW Claim（null → 该项 null + caveat）。**峰值 FLOPS→tokens/s 直接换算路径不存在**；rackCount>1 仅 DP 副本线性外推并在 caveat 声明。
- 拒绝门（按序）：forecast 系统（NVL576）→ refused 永不出数；GPU `mathSpecs` 为 null 或关键字段缺 → 拒绝并点名缺失官方数据（Vera Rubin 自然降级/局部拒绝，不编数）；KV unsupported → tpot/tokensPerSec 为 null。caveats 恒非空，首条固定「粗估区间（roofline 示意），非实测/可承诺产能」。不做 goodput/SLA/成本/跨机架 TP（二期）。
- 测试：band 有序、GB300+deepseek-v3 FP8 手算对照 ±ε、refused 门逐条、tokens/W null 门、replicas/显存可行性、caveats 非空。

## 3D 场景与交互要点

- **语义 LOD = React 挂载/卸载**（非 THREE.LOD）：cluster 只挂机架壳 `<Instances>` + scale-out 主干 + `<Grid>` 地面；rack 挂焦点机架全细节（18+9 托盘按 rack-U 由 `layout.ts` 摆位，邻架 ghost）；tray/board 同组件 + explode 偏移（`layout.ts` 预计算）。「8 机架总览不展开板级」由结构保证。
- **store（zustand）**：`generation/level/focusPath/selectedId/hoveredId/planes/mode(explore|compare|tour)/compare{right,showDiffOnly}/flow{episodeIdx,playing,speed}/tourStopIdx/reducedMotion/glStatus/ready`；drill 转移委托纯函数 `drill.ts`；**每帧 t 放 FlowLayer ref，绝不进 store**；persist 仅 planes/reducedMotion/generation。
- 交互：R3F 指针事件（demand 模式可用），`Hotspot` 最深命中，装饰物 `raycast={()=>null}`；高亮 = emissive + `invalidate()`，无后处理；点选出详情，详情面板「进入 →」或双击下钻，`CameraRig`（drei CameraControls）`setLookAt` 平滑飞行。
- **帧循环策略集中于 FactoryCanvas**：`frameloop={playing ? 'always' : 'demand'}`；dpr 桌面 [1,1.75] / 移动 [1,1.5]；visibilitychange 暂停；reducedMotion → 离散步进（不放粒子，静态高亮当前连接）。
- **连接平面**：`routing.ts` 纯函数出端口锚点 + 正交折线 + 每平面 lane 偏移 + 弧长 LUT；每平面一组 drei `<Line>`；六色定义于 `palette.ts`（NVLink #76b900、scale-out 紫、业务蓝、管理灰、供电琥珀、液冷青），DOM 图例/降级表 1:1 复用；颜色全经 `palette.ts` 读 CSS `--color-*` 变量（Tailwind 在 canvas 内失效）。
- **数据流**：`flowTimeline.ts` 纯函数 FlowEpisode→TimelineSegment（归一化 t0/t1 + 路径 LUT）；FlowLayer 单 InstancedMesh 粒子 `useFrame` 驱动，跨段边界回写 episodeIdx 给 DOM FlowBar（步骤条 + 播放/暂停/步进/速度，逻辑/物理徽章）；HBM 常亮注「权重常驻 HBM，不随请求加载」。
- **比较模式**：单 Canvas + drei `<View>` 双视口（同一 WebGL context），主相机写 poseRef 从相机复制；diff 按 roleKey 配对：新增绿边/移除红边/规格变更 accent 边/数量变化边+DOM 计数、showDiffOnly → 未变部件 ghost 8%；详细 diff 文本在 DOM 列表；产能对比 `CapacityBands` 纯 props 卡片。View+demand 若不稳 → 注释预案：手动双 scissor render。
- 状态材质：GB300 实体 / Vera Rubin 蓝调实体 / Rubin Ultra 琥珀 wireframe；单环境光+单平行光，MeshStandardMaterial + `<Edges>` 示意风，无阴影。
- **降级/移动端**：面包屑/导览/平面开关/详情/步骤条全是 DOM，仅中央格切换 Canvas↔`Fallback2D`（SegmentedTabs：SVG 机架立面 / 组件树 / 连接表；流播放改行高亮）；`webgl.ts` 检测 + `?gl=off` 强制 + context-lost 监听 → 永不白屏（外层 ErrorBoundary 兜底）。移动端 `MobileFactoryView`：禁 orbit、自动导览走同一 `cameraPresets.ts`、热点列表 + Drawer 详情。
- **报告** `/report`：懒路由、禁止导入 three/scene（复用 RackElevationSvg + diff 表 + CapacityBands + 证据分组），六节：需求背景/当前架构/推理数据流/代际变化/证据边界/下一阶段；Tailwind `print:` 变体 + `window.print()`。
- **深链/测试确定性**：`useShotParams.ts` 读 URL 参数一次性 seed store（`?level=rack&focus=…&planes=…&motion=off&gl=off&mode=compare`）；首帧后容器 `data-ready="1"`。
- StrictMode 双挂载风险：Three 资源创建幂等（模块级常量/useMemo + cleanup dispose）。

## 实施批次（5 批，每批结束 `typecheck` + `test` + `build` 全绿 + git 提交）

**B1 — 脚手架 + 引擎 + 内容包地基 + GB300 数据**（opus）：`git init` + 资料移入 `sources/` + Vite/React19/TS/Tailwind/Vitest 脚手架 + 主题 tokens；`roofline.ts`（null-correct 移植）+ 测试；`data/types.ts`（冻结）+ `sources.ts`（7 源全注册）+ `models.ts` + `shared.ts` + `gb300-nvl72.ts` + `index.ts` + `pack.test.ts` + GB300 `content.test.ts`。需抓取 NVIDIA NVL72 RA 页。验收：测试全绿，`npm run dev` 出占位首页。

**B2 — 3D 下钻查看器（可用里程碑）**（opus）：R3F 依赖；`lib/` layout/drill/cameraPresets/webgl/palette + 测试；store + FactoryPage 骨架（顶面包屑/左导览/中 Canvas/右详情/底步骤条占位）+ useShotParams；scene 基础（FactoryCanvas/SceneRoot/三级场景/GenericShapes/Hotspot/CameraRig）+ BreadcrumbBar + DetailPanel（作用/规格 Claim 表+证据徽章/位置/邻居跳转/实物外链/售前话术）+ 最小降级（组件树）。验收：集群→机架→托盘→板卡下钻 + 点选详情全通。

**B3 — 六平面 + 推理数据流**（sonnet）：`routing.ts`/`flowTimeline.ts` + 测试；ConnectionLayer/PlaneToggles/FlowLayer/FlowBar；帧循环策略/visibilitychange/reducedMotion；WAIC pptx 抽文案 → `flows.ts`（七阶段 episode + presalesNote）+ flow 测试。验收：六平面开关、流播放/暂停/步进、空闲零连续帧。

**B4 — 代际 + 比较 + 产能 + 报告**（opus）：抓 Rubin 发布 PDF → `vera-rubin-nvl72.ts`；SemiAnalysis PDF → `rubin-ultra-nvl576.ts`（全 forecast）；`comparisons.ts` + 状态一致性/券商禁令/配对确定性测试；`capacity.ts` + 测试；ComparisonView + diff 材质 + CapacityBands + 代际切换；ReportPage + print。验收：三代同屏对比 + diff 高亮 + 产能 band 卡 + 报告可打印一页。

**B5 — 移动端 + 完整降级 + E2E harness + 性能**（sonnet）：MobileFactoryView 自动导览；完整 Fallback2D（SVG 立面/连接表/行高亮流）；`playwright.config.ts` + `tests/e2e/factory.spec.ts`（桌面 1440×900 / 移动 390×844 / `gl=off`，`data-ready` 等待）+ 截图基线 + `test:e2e` 脚本；context-lost 处理；性能收口（raycast 剪枝、ghost 共享材质、dpr 审计）。

## 代理调度与验证策略（用户指定）

- 各批次派专属 general-purpose 子代理实现，模型如上标注（opus：事实性内容/架构引入/多源数据；sonnet：既定骨架上的机械实现与脚手架）。

- **E2E 跟进代理（禁用 fable → opus）**：全批次交付后启动，职责：

  3. 按 P0（白屏/崩溃/数据错误）/ P1（核心交互失效/明显视觉破坏）/ P2（打磨）分级报告；**P0/P1 修复后复测，循环直至 P0/P1 = 0**；P2 留档。

# AI Factory 3D 数字孪生模拟器 — 独立项目实施计划

## Context

用户是新入行 AI Factory 领域的售前解决方案架构师（互联网大厂研发背景），需要一个「算力集群模拟器」快速建立硬件主线认知：从多机架集群下钻到 GB300 NVL72 机架、Compute Tray、板卡、GPU/HBM/NIC/DPU；查看任意部件的作用/规格/连接；播放推理数据流动画理解各部件协同；对比 GB300 / Vera Rubin / Rubin Ultra 代际差异；粗估硬件方案调整对 token 产能的影响。它同时是给老板汇报「AI Factory 整体方案」的载体。

**实现载体（用户指定）：在 `~/projects/aifactory` 独立新建工作区，不在现有 llms-study 中实现。** llms-study（`/Users/caoruixin/projects/llms-study`）仅作只读参考：其 roofline 引擎数学、数据约定与 UI 模式可移植，不修改其任何文件。原始需求草稿 `~/projects/aifactory/PLAN.md`（其四周学习节奏与汇报脚本部分保持有效，本计划只覆盖实现，且落地位置由 llms-study `/factory` 模块改为独立应用）。

## 用户已定决策

1. **直接上 3D**（three.js + R3F，语义 LOD），2D 仅作 WebGL 降级视图。
2. **首版就带 token 产能粗估**：低/中/高区间 band，明确标注「粗估」。
3. **实现压缩为批次交付**（Claude Code 代理承担），用户保留四周学习节奏。
4. **独立工作区** `~/projects/aifactory`（本次改向）。
5. **代理调度**：用 fable/opus/sonnet 分派实现与验证；E2E 跟进代理不用 fable，通过 API + 浏览器测试，修复 P0/P1 直至清零。

## 新项目脚手架与技术栈

## 内容包数据模型（TS 模块 + 测试，不用 zod）

理由：TS 判别联合编辑期强于 zod 运行期；引用完整性只能靠测试；`types.ts` 保持纯 JSON 可序列化（加 JSON 往返测试），未来做场景导入时再在信任边界加 zod。

核心类型（`src/data/types.ts`，批次 1 末冻结字段名，此后只增不改）：

- `EvidenceType = verified_spec|vendor_claim|benchmark|management_guidance|analyst_estimate|forecast|author_opinion`；`ProductStatus = shipping|announced|forecast`；`NetworkPlane = nvlink|scaleout|business|mgmt|power|cooling`。
- `SourceRef`（id/title/publisher/kind: official_doc|official_press|analyst_report|earnings_call|internal_deck/url/localFile/asOf）。
- `Claim`（value 可 null=「官方未公布不编数」/unit/evidence/status/sourceId/locator/asOf/confidence/note）。
- `HardwareComponent`：按 kind 判别联合（gpu/cpu/hbm/tray/rack/switch/nic/dpu/storage/power/cooling/facility），含 `visual: {shape: VisualShape; wireframe?}` 通用外形（3D 侧只认外形不认型号）、`summary`、`presalesNote`（售前怎么解释）、`imageUrl` 实物外链、`sourceIds`。GPU 组件额外带 `mathSpecs: {memoryGB, bandwidthTBs, fp8Tflops, fp4Tflops, tdpW} | null`（roofline 数学输入，与 Claim 证据展示分离；仅官方公布值，未公布整体为 null）。
- `FactorySystem`（id/status/generation/referenceUrl/keySpecs: Record<string, Claim>，含 gpuCount、rackPowerKW）。
- `AssemblyNode`（parentId 树、**`roleKey` 为跨代比较的稳定语义键**、count + 关键数量必带 countClaim、rack-U 占位、lodLevel: cluster|rack|tray|board）。
- `Connection`（按类型不按实例：一条 gpu→nvswitch 边 + `topology: all-to-all|rail-optimized|fat-tree|star|bus|loop`，非 72×18 条；plane/medium/protocol/bandwidth?: Claim/direction）。
- `FlowEpisode/FlowStep`（phase: ingress→prefill→kv-write→decode→moe-dispatch→moe-combine→egress；`logicalOnly` 标记逻辑层步骤；durationHint 仅教学节奏，注释强制声明非真实时延）。
- `ComparisonDefinition`（roleKey 自动配对 + narrative overrides + summary 要点）；`ScenePreset`（导览语义，相机数字归 3D 侧）。
- `ModelSpec/KVSpec`：从 llms-study `src/data/models.ts` 移植类型 + 2~3 个参考模型行（deepseek-v3 为默认，KV 已知的 MoE，契合 MoE 动画叙事）。
- ID 规范：`src.|cmp.|sys.|asm.|con.|flow.|cmpdef.|scene.` 前缀，regex 测试强制；比较匹配永不解析 ID，只用 roleKey。

内容量级：shared ~8 组件（Oberon 机架壳/busbar/CDU/manifold/cold-plate/管理交换机/facility）；GB300 ~14 组件/28 装配/30 连接（全深度：18 compute tray + 9 NVSwitch tray；tray = 2 Grace + 4 B300 + 4 CX-8 + BF-3；六平面）；Vera Rubin ~8/24/24（仅官方已公布，未公布 value:null）；Rubin Ultra ~6/26/18（粗粒度，全 forecast）。作序：shared → GB300 全量 → Vera Rubin（复制骨架改 diff）→ Rubin Ultra。
