```tsx
/**
 * 语义 LOD 的落地点。
 *
 * ★ 「LOD」在这里**不是** `THREE.LOD`（按距离切换网格），而是
 *   **按下钻层级挂载/卸载不同的 React 子树**：
 *     cluster → 只有机架壳 `<Instances>` + 机房设施 + 地面网格；
 *     rack    → 焦点机架的全部 U 位设备（18 计算托盘 + 9 交换托盘 + 8 电源架 + 2 管理交换机
 *               + 母排/歧管/背板），邻架用共享材质的 ghost；
 *     tray    → 焦点托盘的板级内部；
 *     board   → 同一棵子树，位置换成 `explodedSlots`（拆解视图）。
 *
 *   因此「集群总览里不会挂出 72 张 GPU」不是靠判断距离，而是**结构上就没挂**——
 *   这是本项目控制 draw call 的主要手段，也是唯一需要维护的一条不变量。
 *
 * 层级 → 渲染深度：cluster 只渲染 lodLevel='cluster' 的节点，rack 到 'rack'，
 * tray/board 到 'board'。深度截断由 `RENDER_DEPTH` 一处控制。
 */

import { Grid, Instance, Instances } from '@react-three/drei'
import { invalidate } from '@react-three/fiber'
import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { assemblyById, childrenOf, componentById } from '../../data'
import type { AssemblyNode, LodLevel } from '../../data/types'
import { levelIndex, sceneAnchorOf } from '../../lib/drill'
import { layoutOf, worldPositionOf } from '../../lib/layout'
import type { ResolvedLayout, Vec3 } from '../../lib/layout'
import { HIGHLIGHT, SURFACE, palette } from '../../lib/palette'
import { useFactoryStore } from '../../store'
import { ShapeMesh, ShellMesh, colorForComponent } from './GenericShapes'
import { Hotspot } from './Hotspot'

/** 每级最深渲染到哪一层 lodLevel。 */
const RENDER_DEPTH: Record<LodLevel, LodLevel> = {
  cluster: 'cluster',
  rack: 'rack',
  tray: 'board',
  board: 'board',
}

/** 该节点在世界坐标系里的祖先链（不含自身）。 */
function ancestorChain(assemblyId: string): string[] {
  const out: string[] = []
  let cur = assemblyById(assemblyId)
  while (cur) {
    out.unshift(cur.id)
    cur = cur.parentId === null ? undefined : assemblyById(cur.parentId)
  }
  return out
}

// ─────────────────────────── 递归分支 ───────────────────────────

interface BranchProps {
  node: AssemblyNode
  layout: ResolvedLayout
  depth: LodLevel
  exploded: boolean
  /** 该节点自身是否作为「玻璃罩」渲染（正在被钻入的容器）。 */
  asShell?: boolean
  /** 只渲染第几个实例；省略则全部渲染。 */
  onlyInstance?: number
}

function AssemblyBranch({ node, layout, depth, exploded, asShell = false, onlyInstance }: BranchProps) {
  const item = layout.get(node.id)
  const kids = childrenOf(node.id)
  const maxDepth = levelIndex(depth)
  const component = componentById(node.componentId)

  if (!item) return null

  const slots = exploded ? item.explodedSlots : item.slots
  const indices = onlyInstance === undefined ? slots.map((_, i) => i) : [onlyInstance]
  const visibleKids = kids.filter((k) => levelIndex(k.lodLevel) <= maxDepth)
  const drillable = kids.some((k) => levelIndex(k.lodLevel) > levelIndex(node.lodLevel))

  return (
    <>
      {indices.map((i) => {
        const p = slots[i]
        if (!p) return null
        return (
          <group key={`${node.id}#${i}`} position={p}>
            {asShell ? (
              <ShellMesh
                shape={component?.visual.shape ?? 'rack-frame'}
                size={item.size}
                color={SURFACE.rack}
              />
            ) : (
              <Hotspot node={node} instanceIndex={i} position={[0, 0, 0]} size={item.size} drillable={drillable} />
            )}
            {visibleKids.map((kid) => (
              <AssemblyBranch
                key={kid.id}
                node={kid}
                layout={layout}
                depth={depth}
                exploded={exploded}
              />
            ))}
          </group>
        )
      })}
    </>
  )
}

// ─────────────────────────── 集群级 ───────────────────────────

/**
 * 8 个机架用 drei `<Instances>` 走一次 draw call。
 * 代价：instanced mesh 不支持 per-instance emissive，因此高亮改用 per-instance color
 * （观感与 Hotspot 的 emissive 高亮对齐，两处都取 palette 的 accent）。
 */
function RackInstances({ node, layout }: { node: AssemblyNode; layout: ResolvedLayout }) {
  const item = layout.get(node.id)
  const select = useFactoryStore((s) => s.select)
  const drillTo = useFactoryStore((s) => s.drillTo)
  const hover = useFactoryStore((s) => s.hover)
  const isSelected = useFactoryStore((s) => s.selectedId === node.id)
  const [hoveredIdx, setHoveredIdx] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const p = palette()

  const onOver = useCallback(
    (i: number) => () => {
      setHoveredIdx(i)
      hover(node.id)
      if (typeof document !== 'undefined') document.body.style.cursor = 'pointer'
      invalidate()
    },
    [hover, node.id],
  )
  const onOut = useCallback(() => {
    setHoveredIdx(null)
    hover(null)
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined') document.body.style.cursor = ''
    invalidate()
  }, [hover])

  if (!item) return null
  const base = SURFACE.rack

  return (
    <Instances limit={item.slots.length} range={item.slots.length} frustumCulled={false}>
      <boxGeometry args={[item.size[0], item.size[1], item.size[2]]} />
      <meshStandardMaterial color={base} roughness={0.55} metalness={0.2} />
      {item.slots.map((pos, i) => (
        <Instance
          key={i}
          position={pos}
          // 选中时高亮第 0 架（相机也飞向它），悬停时高亮鼠标下的那一架
          color={hoveredIdx === i ? p[HIGHLIGHT.hoveredToken] : isSelected && i === 0 ? p[HIGHLIGHT.selectedToken] : base}
          onPointerOver={onOver(i)}
          onPointerOut={onOut}
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation()
            select(node.id)
            invalidate()
          }}
          onDoubleClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation()
            drillTo(node.id)
            invalidate()
          }}
        />
      ))}
    </Instances>
  )
}

function ClusterScene({ layout, rootId }: { layout: ResolvedLayout; rootId: string }) {
  const root = assemblyById(rootId)
  if (!root) return null
  const clusterKids = childrenOf(rootId).filter((k) => k.lodLevel === 'cluster')

  return (
    <group>
      {clusterKids.map((kid) => {
        if (kid.roleKey === 'rack-row') {
          const rowItem = layout.get(kid.id)
          const rack = childrenOf(kid.id).find((r) => r.roleKey === 'rack')
          return (
            <group key={kid.id} position={rowItem?.slots[0] ?? [0, 0, 0]}>
              {rack ? <RackInstances node={rack} layout={layout} /> : null}
            </group>
          )
        }
        return (
          <AssemblyBranch key={kid.id} node={kid} layout={layout} depth="cluster" exploded={false} />
        )
      })}
    </group>
  )
}

// ─────────────────────────── 机架级 ───────────────────────────

/** 邻架 ghost：共享同一份材质与几何，`raycast=null`，只提供空间参照。 */
function GhostRacks({ layout, rackId, focusIndex }: { layout: ResolvedLayout; rackId: string; focusIndex: number }) {
  const item = layout.get(rackId)
  if (!item) return null
  const others = item.slots.map((p, i) => ({ p, i })).filter(({ i }) => i !== focusIndex)
  if (others.length === 0) return null
  return (
    <Instances limit={others.length} range={others.length} frustumCulled={false}>
      <boxGeometry args={[item.size[0], item.size[1], item.size[2]]} />
      <meshStandardMaterial
        color={SURFACE.ghost}
        transparent
        opacity={HIGHLIGHT.ghostOpacity}
        depthWrite={false}
        roughness={1}
        metalness={0}
      />
      {others.map(({ p, i }) => (
        <Instance key={i} position={p} raycast={() => null} />
      ))}
    </Instances>
  )
}

function RackScene({ layout, rackId }: { layout: ResolvedLayout; rackId: string }) {
  const rack = assemblyById(rackId)
  const chain = useMemo(() => ancestorChain(rackId), [rackId])
  if (!rack) return null
  const parentChain = chain.slice(0, -1)
  const parentOrigin = worldPositionOf(layout, parentChain)

  return (
    <group position={parentOrigin}>
      <GhostRacks layout={layout} rackId={rackId} focusIndex={0} />
      <AssemblyBranch node={rack} layout={layout} depth="rack" exploded={false} asShell onlyInstance={0} />
    </group>
  )
}

// ─────────────────────────── 托盘 / 板级 ───────────────────────────

function TrayScene({
  layout,
  trayId,
  exploded,
}: {
  layout: ResolvedLayout
  trayId: string
  exploded: boolean
}) {
  const tray = assemblyById(trayId)
  const chain = useMemo(() => ancestorChain(trayId), [trayId])
  if (!tray) return null
  const parentChain = chain.slice(0, -1)
  const parentOrigin = worldPositionOf(layout, parentChain)
  const rackId = parentChain[parentChain.length - 1]
  const rackItem = rackId ? layout.get(rackId) : undefined

  return (
    <group position={parentOrigin}>
      {/* 机架外壳保留成极淡的参照物，让人知道「这块板在机架的什么高度」 */}
      {rackItem ? (
        <ShapeMesh
          shape="rack-frame"
          size={rackItem.size}
          color={SURFACE.ghost}
          opacity={0.05}
          depthWrite={false}
          roughness={1}
          metalness={0}
          raycast={() => null}
        />
      ) : null}
      <AssemblyBranch
        node={tray}
        layout={layout}
        depth="board"
        exploded={exploded}
        asShell
        onlyInstance={0}
      />
    </group>
  )
}

// ─────────────────────────── 地面 ───────────────────────────

function GroundGrid({ visible }: { visible: boolean }) {
  if (!visible) return null
  return (
    <Grid
      position={[0, 0.002, 0]}
      args={[40, 24]}
      cellSize={0.9}
      cellThickness={0.6}
      cellColor={SURFACE.ground}
      sectionSize={4.5}
      sectionThickness={1}
      sectionColor={SURFACE.edge}
      fadeDistance={70}
      fadeStrength={1.2}
      infiniteGrid
      raycast={() => null}
    />
  )
}

// ─────────────────────────── 根 ───────────────────────────

export default function SceneRoot() {
  const generation = useFactoryStore((s) => s.generation)
  const level = useFactoryStore((s) => s.level)
  const focusPath = useFactoryStore((s) => s.focusPath)

  const layout = useMemo(() => layoutOf(generation), [generation])
  const anchor = useMemo(
    () => sceneAnchorOf({ level, focusPath, selectedId: null }),
    [level, focusPath],
  )
  const rootId = focusPath[0]

  return (
    <>
      <GroundGrid visible={anchor.kind === 'cluster'} />
      {anchor.kind === 'cluster' && rootId ? (
        <ClusterScene layout={layout} rootId={rootId} />
      ) : null}
      {anchor.kind === 'rack' ? <RackScene layout={layout} rackId={anchor.rackAssemblyId} /> : null}
      {anchor.kind === 'tray' ? (
        <TrayScene layout={layout} trayId={anchor.trayAssemblyId} exploded={anchor.exploded} />
      ) : null}
    </>
  )
}

```

```tsx
/**
 * 相机控制：drei `<CameraControls>` + `lib/cameraPresets.ts` 的纯数学机位。
 *
 * 层级或焦点一变，就 `setLookAt(...preset, enableTransition)` 平滑飞过去，
 * 并按该级的 fit 距离 clamp 缩放范围（防止在板级把镜头推进芯片内部，
 * 或在集群级拉到看不见机架）。
 *
 * ⚠️ frameloop 是 `demand`：平滑飞行期间没有任何东西会自动请求帧，
 *    所以过渡开始时手动 pump 一段 rAF。`reducedMotion` 下直接瞬移，不 pump。
 */

import { CameraControls } from '@react-three/drei'
import { useThree } from '@react-three/fiber'
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { cameraPresetFor } from '../../lib/cameraPresets'
import { layoutOf } from '../../lib/layout'
import { useFactoryStore } from '../../store'

/** 过渡期间持续请求帧；返回取消函数。 */
function pumpFrames(invalidate: () => void, ms: number): () => void {
  if (ms <= 0) {
    invalidate()
    return () => {}
  }
  let raf = 0
  const t0 = typeof performance !== 'undefined' ? performance.now() : Date.now()
  const step = () => {
    invalidate()
    const now = typeof performance !== 'undefined' ? performance.now() : Date.now()
    if (now - t0 < ms) raf = requestAnimationFrame(step)
  }
  raf = requestAnimationFrame(step)
  return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf)
}

export default function CameraRig() {
  const controls = useRef<CameraControls | null>(null)
  const invalidate = useThree((s) => s.invalidate)
  const width = useThree((s) => s.size.width)
  const height = useThree((s) => s.size.height)

  const generation = useFactoryStore((s) => s.generation)
  const level = useFactoryStore((s) => s.level)
  const focusPath = useFactoryStore((s) => s.focusPath)
  const reducedMotion = useFactoryStore((s) => s.reducedMotion)

  useEffect(() => {
    const c = controls.current
    if (!c) return
    const aspect = height > 0 ? width / height : 16 / 9
    const preset = cameraPresetFor(level, focusPath, layoutOf(generation), { aspect })
    c.minDistance = preset.minDistance
    c.maxDistance = preset.maxDistance
    void c.setLookAt(
      preset.position[0],
      preset.position[1],
      preset.position[2],
      preset.target[0],
      preset.target[1],
      preset.target[2],
      !reducedMotion,
    )
    return pumpFrames(invalidate, reducedMotion ? 0 : 1500)
  }, [level, focusPath, generation, width, height, reducedMotion, invalidate])

  return (
    <CameraControls
      ref={controls}
      makeDefault
      // 拖拽/滚轮期间也要请求帧，否则 demand 模式下画面不动
      onChange={() => invalidate()}
      // 示意场景不需要仰角翻到地面以下
      maxPolarAngle={Math.PI * 0.495}
    />
  )
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * Canvas 宿主：帧循环策略、灯光、颜色与 WebGL 失效处理都集中在这一处。
 *
 * - `frameloop="demand"`：空闲时零连续帧（B3 播放数据流时会切成 'always'）。
 *   任何改变画面的动作都必须显式 `invalidate()`——约定见 Hotspot / CameraRig。
 * - `dpr`：桌面 [1, 1.75]，移动 [1, 1.5]。不用 devicePixelRatio 原值，
 *   高分屏上 3x 渲染对这种示意场景是纯浪费。
 * - 灯光只有一盏环境光 + 一盏平行光（外加一盏很弱的补光），无阴影：
 *   工程示意图风格，靠 `<Edges>` 描边而不是靠光影表达结构。
 * - 颜色全部经 `lib/palette.ts`（Canvas 内 Tailwind class 不生效）。
 * - 初始化抛错 / `webglcontextlost` → `store.glStatus = 'failed'`，
 *   外层 FactoryPage 立刻切到结构视图，永不白屏。
 */

import { Canvas } from '@react-three/fiber'
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react'
import { CAMERA_FOV } from '../../lib/cameraPresets'
import { palette } from '../../lib/palette'
import { useFactoryStore } from '../../store'
import { ErrorBoundary } from '../ErrorBoundary'
import CameraRig from './CameraRig'
import SceneRoot from './SceneRoot'

/** 首帧探针：demand 模式下 R3F 挂载后至少渲染一次，这里把 ready 回写给 DOM。 */
function ReadyProbe() {
  const setReady = useFactoryStore((s) => s.setReady)
  useEffect(() => {
    // rAF 比 useFrame 更可靠：不依赖 demand 模式是否恰好排到帧。
    const id = requestAnimationFrame(() => setReady(true))
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(id)
  }, [setReady])
  return null
}

export default function FactoryCanvas() {
  const setGlStatus = useFactoryStore((s) => s.setGlStatus)
  const setReady = useFactoryStore((s) => s.setReady)
  const cleanupRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null)

  const p = palette()
  const dpr = useMemo<[number, number]>(() => {
    const mobile = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768
    return mobile ? [1, 1.5] : [1, 1.75]
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => () => cleanupRef.current?.(), [])

  return (
    <ErrorBoundary
      onError={() => {
        setGlStatus('failed')
        setReady(true)
      }}
      fallback={null}
    >
      <Canvas
        frameloop="demand"
        dpr={dpr}
        shadows={false}
        flat
        camera={{ fov: CAMERA_FOV, near: 0.01, far: 600, position: [7, 4.5, 10] }}
        gl={{ antialias: true, powerPreference: 'high-performance', alpha: false }}
        onCreated={({ gl }) => {
          const canvas = gl.domElement
          const onLost = (e: Event) => {
            e.preventDefault()
            setGlStatus('failed')
          }
          canvas.addEventListener('webglcontextlost', onLost, false)
          cleanupRef.current = () => canvas.removeEventListener('webglcontextlost', onLost)
        }}
      >
        <color attach="background" args={[p.ink]} />
        <ambientLight intensity={0.95} />
        <directionalLight position={[8, 14, 7]} intensity={1.3} />
        <directionalLight position={[-7, 6, -9]} intensity={0.32} />
        <SceneRoot />
        <CameraRig />
        <ReadyProbe />
      </Canvas>
    </ErrorBoundary>
  )
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * 应用级兜底。
 *
 * 存在的唯一理由：**永不白屏**。3D 初始化失败、驱动崩溃、内容包某条数据把渲染打挂，
 * 都应该退化成一段可读的文字 + 结构视图，而不是一片空白让人以为「网站坏了」。
 */

import { Component } from 'react'
import type { ErrorInfo, ReactNode } from 'react'

interface Props {
  children: ReactNode
  /** null = 出错时什么都不渲染（由外层决定替代内容，例如切到结构视图）。 */
  fallback: ReactNode | ((error: Error, reset: () => void) => ReactNode)
  onError?: (error: Error) => void
}

interface State {
  error: Error | null
}

export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
  override state: State = { error: null }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {
    return { error }
  }

  override componentDidCatch(error: Error, info: ErrorInfo): void {
    // 保留控制台线索：降级之后现场就没了，日志是唯一的排查入口。
    console.error('[aifactory] 渲染异常，已降级：', error, info.componentStack)
    this.props.onError?.(error)
  }

  private reset = (): void => this.setState({ error: null })

  override render(): ReactNode {
    const { error } = this.state
    if (!error) return this.props.children
    const { fallback } = this.props
    return typeof fallback === 'function' ? fallback(error, this.reset) : fallback
  }
}

/** 整页兜底界面（App 根用）。 */
export function AppErrorFallback(error: Error, reset: () => void): ReactNode {
  return (
    <main className="mx-auto max-w-2xl px-6 py-16">
      <h1 className="text-xl font-semibold">页面出了点问题</h1>
      <p className="mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-dim">
        模拟器渲染时抛出了异常，已经中断以免出现白屏。可以先重试；如果反复出现，
        用 <code className="rounded bg-panel-2 px-1">?gl=off</code> 打开纯结构视图。
      </p>
      <pre className="mt-4 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-line bg-panel-2 p-3 text-xs text-dim">
        {error.message}
      </pre>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={reset}
        className="mt-5 rounded-md border border-line bg-panel px-3 py-1.5 text-sm hover:border-accent"
      >
        重试
      </button>
    </main>
  )
}

```

```tsx
 * 一个部件被选中后要回答六个问题：

import {

  sourceById,

  childrenOf,
  assembliesUsingComponent,
} from '../../data'
import type { AssemblyNode, Claim, Connection, HardwareComponent } from '../../data/types'
import { LEVEL_LABEL, canDrillInto, levelOfFocus, rackContainerOf } from '../../lib/drill'
import { PLANE_LABEL, planeColor } from '../../lib/palette'
import { detailIdOf, useFactoryStore } from '../../store'
import { EvidenceChip, MetaChip, StatusChip } from '../ui/Chips'

export default function DetailPanel() {
  const detailId = useFactoryStore(detailIdOf)
  const select = useFactoryStore((s) => s.select)
  const drillTo = useFactoryStore((s) => s.drillTo)
  const hover = useFactoryStore((s) => s.hover)

  const node = detailId ? assemblyById(detailId) : undefined
  const component = node ? componentById(node.componentId) : undefined

  if (!node || !component) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 text-sm leading-relaxed text-dim">
        <h2 className="text-xs font-semibold tracking-widest text-dim uppercase">部件详情</h2>
        <p className="mt-3">
          在 3D 视图里<strong className="font-medium text-fg">单击</strong>任意部件查看它的作用、
          官方规格与连接关系；<strong className="font-medium text-fg">双击</strong>下钻一层。
        </p>
        <p className="mt-2">也可以从左栏的场景导览直接跳到某一屏。</p>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const connections = connectionsOf(node.id)
  const kids = childrenOf(node.id)
  const parent = node.parentId ? assemblyById(node.parentId) : undefined
  const drillable = canDrillInto(node.id)

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-col overflow-y-auto">
      {/* ── 标题 ── */}
      <header className="border-b border-line px-4 py-3">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
          <MetaChip title="语义 LOD 层级">{LEVEL_LABEL[levelOfFocus(node.id)]}</MetaChip>
          <StatusChip status={component.status} />
          {node.count > 1 ? <MetaChip title="每个父实例下的数量">×{node.count}</MetaChip> : null}
        </div>
        <h2 className="mt-2 text-base leading-snug font-semibold">{node.label}</h2>
        <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-dim">
          {component.name} · {component.vendor}
        </p>
        {drillable ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => drillTo(node.id)}
            className="mt-2.5 rounded-md border border-accent/40 bg-accent/10 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-accent hover:bg-accent/20"
          >
            进入 →
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </header>

      <div className="space-y-5 px-4 py-4">
        {/* ── 作用 ── */}
        <Section title="它是干嘛的">
          <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed">{component.summary}</p>
          {node.note ? <p className="mt-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-dim">{node.note}</p> : null}
        </Section>

        {/* ── 售前话术 ── */}
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-warn/30 bg-warn/10 p-3">
          <h3 className="text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-widest text-warn uppercase">
            售前怎么解释
          </h3>
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm leading-relaxed">{component.presalesNote}</p>
        </div>

        {/* ── 数量证据 ── */}
        {node.countClaim ? (
          <Section title="数量出处">
            <ClaimRow name="每个上级里的数量" claim={node.countClaim} />
          </Section>
        ) : null}

        {/* ── 规格表 ── */}
        <Section title="官方规格">
          {Object.keys(component.specs).length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-xs text-dim">该组件在内容包中未登记规格项。</p>
          ) : (
            <dl className="divide-y divide-line rounded-md border border-line">
              {Object.entries(component.specs).map(([key, claim]) => (
                <ClaimRow key={key} name={key} claim={claim} />
              ))}
            </dl>
          )}
        </Section>

        {/* ── 物理位置 ── */}
        <Section title="物理位置">
          <Position node={node} />
        </Section>

        {/* ── 上下级 ── */}
        <Section title="上下级结构">
          <ul className="space-y-1 text-sm">
            {parent ? (
              <li>
                <span className="text-dim">上级：</span>
                <LinkButton onClick={() => select(parent.id)} onHover={hover} id={parent.id}>
                  {parent.label}
                </LinkButton>
              </li>
            ) : (
              <li className="text-dim">上级：装配树根</li>
            )}
            {kids.length > 0 ? (
              <li>
                <span className="text-dim">下级：</span>
                <span className="inline-flex flex-wrap gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5 align-top">
                  {kids.map((k) => (
                    <LinkButton key={k.id} onClick={() => select(k.id)} onHover={hover} id={k.id}>
                      {k.label}
                      {k.count > 1 ? ` ×${k.count}` : ''}
                    </LinkButton>
                  ))}
                </span>
              </li>
            ) : (
              <li className="text-dim">下级：无（叶子件）</li>
            )}
          </ul>
        </Section>

        {/* ── 连接 ── */}
        <Section title={`相邻连接（${connections.length}）`}>
          {connections.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-xs text-dim">内容包中没有登记与该部件直接相连的链路。</p>
          ) : (
            <ul className="space-y-2">
              {connections.map((c) => (
                <ConnectionRow
                  key={c.id}
                  connection={c}
                  selfId={node.id}
                  onJump={(id) => select(id)}
                  onHover={hover}
                />
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </Section>

        {/* ── 实物参考 ── */}
        <Section title="实物参考与出处">
          <ul className="space-y-1 text-xs">
            {component.imageUrl ? (
              <li>
                <a
                  href={component.imageUrl}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noreferrer noopener"
                  className="text-accent underline"
                >
                  厂商页面 / 实物图 ↗
                </a>
              </li>
            ) : (
              <li className="text-dim">未收录实物图外链。</li>
            )}
            {component.sourceIds.map((sid) => (
              <SourceLine key={sid} sourceId={sid} />
            ))}
          </ul>
          <ComponentReuse component={component} selfId={node.id} onJump={select} />
        </Section>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

// ─────────────────────────── 子块 ───────────────────────────

function Section({ title, children }: { title: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section>
      <h3 className="text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-widest text-dim uppercase">{title}</h3>
      <div className="mt-1.5">{children}</div>
    </section>
  )
}

function formatValue(claim: Claim): string {
  if (claim.value === null) return '官方未公布'
  if (typeof claim.value === 'boolean') return claim.value ? '是' : '否'
  if (typeof claim.value === 'number') return claim.value.toLocaleString('zh-CN')
  return claim.value
}

function ClaimRow({ name, claim }: { name: string; claim: Claim }) {
  const source = sourceById(claim.sourceId)
  const unknown = claim.value === null
  return (
    <div className="px-2.5 py-2">
      <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2">
        <dt className="font-mono text-[11px] break-all text-dim">{name}</dt>
        <dd className={`text-right text-sm font-medium ${unknown ? 'text-dim italic' : ''}`}>
          {formatValue(claim)}
          {claim.unit && !unknown ? <span className="ml-0.5 text-xs text-dim">{claim.unit}</span> : null}
        </dd>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
        <EvidenceChip evidence={claim.evidence} />
        <StatusChip status={claim.status} />
        <span className="text-[11px] text-dim" title={claim.locator ?? undefined}>
          {source ? source.title : claim.sourceId}
          {' · '}
          {claim.asOf}
        </span>
      </div>
      {claim.locator ? (
        <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-snug text-dim">出处：{claim.locator}</p>
      ) : null}
      {claim.note ? (
        <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-snug text-warn">{claim.note}</p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  )
}

function Position({ node }: { node: AssemblyNode }) {
  const rackId = rackContainerOf(node.id)
  const chain = ancestorsOf(node.id)
  const perRack = rackId ? totalInstances(node.id, rackId) : null
  const perCluster = totalInstances(node.id)

  return (
    <ul className="space-y-1 text-sm">
      <li>
        <span className="text-dim">父链：</span>
        <span className="text-xs">{chain.map((n) => n.label).join(' › ')}</span>
      </li>
      {node.rackU ? (
        <li>
          <span className="text-dim">机架 U 位：</span>
          {node.count > 1
            ? `U${node.rackU.start} – U${node.rackU.start + node.rackU.height - 1}（${node.count} 个实例连续占位，每个 ${node.rackU.height / node.count}U）`
            : `U${node.rackU.start} – U${node.rackU.start + node.rackU.height - 1}`}
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] leading-snug text-dim">
            ⚠️ NVIDIA 未公布逐 U 布局，此处为 3D 摆位示意占位。
          </p>
        </li>
      ) : null}
      {perRack !== null && rackId !== node.id ? (
        <li>
          <span className="text-dim">每机架数量：</span>
          <span className="font-mono">{perRack.toLocaleString('zh-CN')}</span>
        </li>
      ) : null}
      <li>
        <span className="text-dim">全集群数量：</span>
        <span className="font-mono">{perCluster.toLocaleString('zh-CN')}</span>
        <span className="ml-1 text-[11px] text-dim">（按装配树 count 连乘）</span>
      </li>
    </ul>
  )
}

function ConnectionRow({
  connection,
  selfId,
  onJump,
  onHover,
}: {
  connection: Connection
  selfId: string
  onJump: (id: string) => void
  onHover: (id: string | null) => void
}) {
  const otherId =
    connection.fromAssemblyId === selfId ? connection.toAssemblyId : connection.fromAssemblyId
  const other = assemblyById(otherId)
  const outgoing = connection.fromAssemblyId === selfId

  return (
    <li className="rounded-md border border-line px-2.5 py-2">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <span
          aria-hidden
          className="inline-block h-2.5 w-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-full"
          style={{ background: planeColor(connection.plane) }}
        />
        <span className="text-[11px] text-dim">{PLANE_LABEL[connection.plane]}</span>
        <span className="ml-auto font-mono text-[11px] text-dim">{connection.topology}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-1 text-sm">
        <span className="text-dim">{outgoing ? '→ ' : '← '}</span>
        <LinkButton onClick={() => onJump(otherId)} onHover={onHover} id={otherId}>
          {other?.label ?? otherId}
        </LinkButton>
      </div>
      <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] leading-snug text-dim">
        {connection.protocol}
        {connection.bandwidth?.value !== null && connection.bandwidth
          ? ` · ${connection.bandwidth.value}${connection.bandwidth.unit ?? ''}`
          : ''}
        {' · '}
        {connection.medium}
      </p>
      <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-relaxed">{connection.summary}</p>
    </li>
  )
}

function ComponentReuse({
  component,
  selfId,
  onJump,
}: {
  component: HardwareComponent
  selfId: string
  onJump: (id: string) => void
}) {
  const uses = assembliesUsingComponent(component.id).filter((a) => a.id !== selfId)
  if (uses.length === 0) return null
  return (
    <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-dim">
      同一组件还出现在：
      {uses.map((a, i) => (
        <span key={a.id}>
          {i > 0 ? '、' : ' '}
          <button type="button" onClick={() => onJump(a.id)} className="text-accent underline">
            {a.label}
          </button>
        </span>
      ))}
    </p>
  )
}

function SourceLine({ sourceId }: { sourceId: string }) {
  const source = sourceById(sourceId)
  if (!source) return <li className="text-dim">{sourceId}</li>
  return (
    <li>
      {source.url ? (
        <a href={source.url} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener" className="text-accent underline">
          {source.title} ↗
        </a>
      ) : (
        <span>{source.title}</span>
      )}
      <span className="text-dim">
        {' · '}
        {source.publisher} · {source.asOf}
      </span>
    </li>
  )
}

function LinkButton({
  id,
  onClick,
  onHover,
  children,
}: {
  id: string
  onClick: () => void
  onHover: (id: string | null) => void
  children: React.ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      onMouseEnter={() => onHover(id)}
      onMouseLeave={() => onHover(null)}
      className="text-accent underline decoration-accent/40 underline-offset-2 hover:decoration-accent"
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  )
}
```

```tsx
 * 它同时承担三件事：告诉你「现在在哪一层」、提供一键回跳、把产品状态挂在最显眼的位置

              className={

              }

      <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2">

        </span>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={drillUp}
          disabled={level === 'cluster'}
          className="rounded-md border border-line bg-panel px-2 py-1 text-xs hover:border-accent disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
        >
          ↑ 上一层
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* 深链与 E2E 用：当前焦点写进 DOM，不依赖 3D */}
      <span hidden data-focus-id={focusId ?? ''} data-level={level} />
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
              </li>
            )
          })}
        </ol>
        {activeScene ? (
          <div className="mt-2.5 rounded-lg border border-line bg-panel p-2.5">

/**

 * 但配色与文案在这里就定死，DOM 图例与 3D 连线共用 `lib/palette.ts` 的同一组值。

  const setAll = (on: boolean) => {

  }

  return (
    <section className="px-3 py-3">
      <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between">
        <h2 className="text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-widest text-dim uppercase">网络与设施平面</h2>
        <div className="flex gap-2 text-[11px]">
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setAll(true)} className="text-dim hover:text-accent">
            全开
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setAll(false)} className="text-dim hover:text-accent">
            全关
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1">
        {PLANE_ORDER.map((plane) => (
          <li key={plane}>
            <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded px-1 py-1 text-xs hover:bg-panel-2">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={planes[plane]}
                onChange={() => togglePlane(plane)}
                className="h-3.5 w-3.5"
              />
              <span
                aria-hidden
                className="inline-block h-2.5 w-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-full"
                style={{ background: planeColor(plane) }}
              />
              <span className={planes[plane] ? '' : 'text-dim line-through'}>
                {PLANE_LABEL[plane]}
              </span>
            </label>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] leading-snug text-dim">
        平面连线将在批次 3 接入 3D 视图；当前开关只保存状态，配色即最终配色。
      </p>
    </section>
  )
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * 最小降级视图：嵌套装配树。
 *
 * 触发条件：`?gl=off`、探测不到 WebGL、运行期 context lost、或 Canvas 抛错。
 * 交互与 3D 完全对齐——点节点 = 选中（右栏同样出详情），点「进入」= 下钻，
 * 因此即使没有 3D，这个工具的**学习价值仍然成立**。B5 会把它扩成完整 Fallback2D
 * （SVG 机架立面 / 连接表 / 行高亮流）。
 */

import { assemblyById, childrenOf, componentById, rootAssemblyOf } from '../../data'
import type { AssemblyNode } from '../../data/types'
import { LEVEL_LABEL, canDrillInto, levelOfFocus } from '../../lib/drill'
import { useFactoryStore } from '../../store'
import { MetaChip, StatusChip } from '../ui/Chips'

export default function ComponentTree() {
  const generation = useFactoryStore((s) => s.generation)
  const root = rootAssemblyOf(generation)
  if (!root) return <p className="p-4 text-sm text-dim">内容包中找不到该系统的装配树。</p>
  return (
    <div className="h-full overflow-auto px-4 py-3">
      <TreeNode node={root} depth={0} />
    </div>
  )
}

function TreeNode({ node, depth }: { node: AssemblyNode; depth: number }) {
  const selectedId = useFactoryStore((s) => s.selectedId)
  const select = useFactoryStore((s) => s.select)
  const drillTo = useFactoryStore((s) => s.drillTo)
  const hover = useFactoryStore((s) => s.hover)
  const component = componentById(node.componentId)
  const kids = childrenOf(node.id)
  const selected = selectedId === node.id

  return (
    <div style={{ marginLeft: depth === 0 ? 0 : 14 }}>
      <div
        className={`flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 rounded border-l-2 py-1 pl-2 ${
          selected ? 'border-accent bg-accent/10' : 'border-line hover:bg-panel-2'
        }`}
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => select(node.id)}
          onMouseEnter={() => hover(node.id)}
          onMouseLeave={() => hover(null)}
          className="text-sm font-medium"
        >
          {node.label}
        </button>
        {node.count > 1 ? <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-dim">×{node.count}</span> : null}
        <MetaChip>{LEVEL_LABEL[levelOfFocus(node.id)]}</MetaChip>
        {component ? <StatusChip status={component.status} /> : null}
        {node.rackU ? (
          <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-dim">
            U{node.rackU.start}–{node.rackU.start + node.rackU.height - 1}
          </span>
        ) : null}
        {canDrillInto(node.id) ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => drillTo(node.id)}
            className="ml-1 text-[11px] text-accent underline"
          >
            进入
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      {kids.map((kid) => (
        <TreeNode key={kid.id} node={assemblyById(kid.id) ?? kid} depth={depth + 1} />
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * URL 参数 → store 的**一次性**播种。
 *
 * 两个用途合一：
 * 1. 深链——`/?level=board&focus=asm.gb300.b300-gpu` 直接把人送到某一屏，
 *    汇报时不用现场点五下；
 * 2. 截图/E2E 的确定性入口——`?motion=off&gl=off` 可以关掉相机动画与 WebGL，
 *    让 B5 的 Playwright 基线不受动画时序影响。
 *
 * 「一次性」很重要：播种之后用户的手动操作不应该被 URL 覆盖，
 * 因此这里不做双向同步（URL ← store 的回写留给后续批次按需加）。
 */

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { assemblyById } from '../data'
import type { LodLevel, NetworkPlane } from '../data/types'
import { LEVEL_ORDER } from '../lib/drill'
import { PLANE_ORDER } from '../lib/palette'
import { detectWebGL } from '../lib/webgl'
import { useFactoryStore } from '../store'
import type { PlaneFlags } from '../store'

export interface ShotParams {
  level: LodLevel | null
  focus: string | null
  planes: NetworkPlane[] | null
  motionOff: boolean
  glOff: boolean
}

/** 纯解析，不碰 store。 */
export function parseShotParams(search: string): ShotParams {
  const q = new URLSearchParams(search)
  const rawLevel = q.get('level')
  const level = rawLevel && (LEVEL_ORDER as readonly string[]).includes(rawLevel)
    ? (rawLevel as LodLevel)
    : null

  const rawPlanes = q.get('planes')
  const planes = rawPlanes
    ? rawPlanes
        .split(',')
        .map((s) => s.trim())
        .filter((s): s is NetworkPlane => (PLANE_ORDER as readonly string[]).includes(s))
    : null

  return {
    level,
    focus: q.get('focus'),
    planes,
    motionOff: q.get('motion') === 'off',
    glOff: q.get('gl') === 'off',
  }
}

export function useShotParams(): void {
  const seeded = useRef(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (seeded.current) return
    seeded.current = true

    const search = typeof window === 'undefined' ? '' : window.location.search
    const params = parseShotParams(search)
    const store = useFactoryStore.getState()

    // WebGL：显式关闭优先，否则跑一次能力探测。
    store.setGlStatus(params.glOff ? 'none' : detectWebGL(search))
    if (params.glOff) store.setReady(true) // 没有 Canvas 就没有首帧回调

    if (params.motionOff) store.setReducedMotion(true)

    if (params.planes) {
      const flags = PLANE_ORDER.reduce((acc, p) => {
        acc[p] = params.planes!.includes(p)
        return acc
      }, {} as PlaneFlags)
      store.setPlanes(flags)
    }

    // 焦点先于层级：层级由焦点的结构位置推导，显式 level 再覆盖一次。
    if (params.focus && assemblyById(params.focus)) store.drillTo(params.focus)
    if (params.level) store.setLevel(params.level)
  }, [])
}

```

```tsx
/**
 * 主工作台。四区布局：
 *   顶  BreadcrumbBar（物理层级 + 产品状态）
 *   左  TourPanel（场景导览 + 六平面开关）
 *   中  FactoryCanvas（3D）或 ComponentTree（降级）
 *   右  DetailPanel
 *   底  步骤条（B3 的数据流播放控件占位）
 *
 * 布局原则：**除中央格外全部是 DOM**。这样 WebGL 不可用时只要换掉中央那一格，
 * 面包屑/导览/详情/步骤条全部照常工作——降级路径不是另写一套界面。
 *
 * 桌面三栏 grid；移动端先纵向堆叠保证可用，专门的移动视图（禁 orbit、自动导览、
 * 热点列表 + Drawer）留到 B5。
 */

import { Suspense, lazy } from 'react'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import BreadcrumbBar from '../components/panels/BreadcrumbBar'
import DetailPanel from '../components/panels/DetailPanel'
import TourPanel from '../components/panels/TourPanel'
import ComponentTree from '../components/fallback/ComponentTree'
import { ErrorBoundary } from '../components/ErrorBoundary'
import { useFactoryStore } from '../store'
import { useShotParams } from './useShotParams'

// three 体量不小，且降级路径根本不需要它 → 懒加载，让 `?gl=off` 首屏不必下载 3D 代码。
const FactoryCanvas = lazy(() => import('../components/scene/FactoryCanvas'))

export default function FactoryPage() {
  useShotParams()
  const glStatus = useFactoryStore((s) => s.glStatus)
  const ready = useFactoryStore((s) => s.ready)
  const degraded = glStatus === 'none' || glStatus === 'failed'

  return (
    <main
      data-ready={ready ? '1' : '0'}
      data-gl={glStatus}
      className="grid h-screen grid-rows-[auto_1fr_auto] bg-ink text-fg"
    >
      <BreadcrumbBar />

      <div className="grid min-h-0 grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-[248px_1fr_360px]">
        <aside className="min-h-0 border-line bg-panel lg:border-r">
          <TourPanel />
        </aside>

        <section className="relative min-h-[52vh] min-w-0 bg-ink lg:min-h-0">
          {degraded ? <DegradedNotice status={glStatus} /> : null}
          {degraded ? (
            <ComponentTree />
          ) : (
            <ErrorBoundary
              fallback={<ComponentTree />}
              onError={() => useFactoryStore.getState().setGlStatus('failed')}
            >
              <Suspense fallback={<CanvasSkeleton />}>
                <FactoryCanvas />
              </Suspense>
            </ErrorBoundary>
          )}
          {!degraded ? <ViewHint /> : null}
        </section>

        <aside className="min-h-0 border-line bg-panel lg:border-l">
          <DetailPanel />
        </aside>
      </div>

      <FlowBarPlaceholder />
    </main>
  )
}

function DegradedNotice({ status }: { status: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="border-b border-warn/30 bg-warn/10 px-4 py-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-warn">
      3D 不可用（{status === 'none' ? '未检测到 WebGL 或已用 ?gl=off 关闭' : 'WebGL 上下文丢失'}
      ），已切换结构视图。层级、选中与详情面板功能不受影响。
    </div>
  )
}

function CanvasSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center text-sm text-dim">3D 场景加载中…</div>
  )
}

/** 3D 视图的操作提示：第一次用的人不知道双击能下钻。 */
function ViewHint() {
  return (
    <p className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full border border-line bg-panel/85 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] text-dim">
      单击选中 · 双击下钻 · 拖拽旋转 · 滚轮缩放
    </p>
  )
}

/** 底部步骤条占位。B3 会把它换成真正的数据流播放控件（播放/暂停/步进/速度）。 */
function FlowBarPlaceholder() {
  const flows = useFactoryStore((s) => s.flow)
  return (
    <footer className="flex items-center gap-3 border-t border-line bg-panel px-4 py-2 text-xs text-dim">
      <span className="rounded border border-line bg-panel-2 px-1.5 py-px text-[11px]">批次 3</span>
      <span>推理数据流播放（七阶段 ingress → egress）将在下一批接入此处。</span>
      <span className="font-mono opacity-60">episode {flows.episodeIdx}</span>
      <Link to="/report" className="ml-auto text-accent underline">
        打印报告 →
      </Link>
    </footer>
  )
}
```

B2 is complete and committed. Working tree clean, 3 new commits on top of B1.

## 完成清单

**依赖**: `three@0.185.1` + `@react-three/fiber@9.7.0` + `@react-three/drei@10.7.8` + `@types/three`。drei 只用了白名单内的 `Instances/Instance, Edges, Grid, CameraControls`；未使用 `Environment/Sky/Text/useGLTF`，canvas 内零文字。

**`src/lib/` 纯函数层（零 three 导入，node 环境可测）**
- `layout.ts` — 装配树 → `ResolvedLayout`（1 unit = 1 m）。`rackU.height / count` 分槽，18+9 托盘各占 1U；`explodedSlots` 预计算。
- `drill.ts` — `nextState(state, action, pack)` 状态机 + `crumbsOf` + `sceneAnchorOf`。**层级从装配树结构推导**（根→cluster；叶子→自身 lodLevel；有子节点→`max(自身, 最粗子节点)`），不解析 ID 字符串，换代无需改动。
- `cameraPresets.ts` — 包围球 fit + 逐级方位角/仰角，输出 `{position,target,min/maxDistance,fitDistance}`。
- `webgl.ts` / `palette.ts` — 探测 + `?gl=off`；调色板读 CSS 变量带 fallback，另含 3D 专用中性色阶与 `STATUS_MATERIALS`。

**store / 页面 / 场景 / 面板** — 见下方交接。降级用 `ComponentTree` + App 级 `ErrorBoundary`。

## 验收输出

- `npm run typecheck` — 通过。
- `npm test` — **8 文件 / 182 测试全通过**（B1 的 89 + 本批新增 93：layout 20、drill 34、cameraPresets 20、webgl+palette 6、store 13）。
- `npm run build` — 成功。产物：`index` 322 kB、`FactoryCanvas` 981 kB（three 独立懒加载 chunk）、`ReportPage` 0.45 kB。**`/report` 与降级路径都不加载 three**，`?gl=off` 时页面上根本没有 canvas 元素（已用 JS 断言 `hasCanvas: false`）。
- 唯一告警：FactoryCanvas chunk > 500 kB（three 本身体积，已隔离在懒加载 chunk）。

## 浏览器实测（claude-in-chrome，dev server 5173）

curl `/` 与 `/report` 均 200。逐屏截图确认：

1. **集群** — 8 机架成排、网络机柜堆叠、CDU/存储/管理节点列/一次侧水管、地面网格。
2. **双击机架 → 机架级** — 18 计算托盘（灰）/ 9 交换托盘（NVLink 绿）/ 8 电源架（供电琥珀）/ 2 管理交换机 按 rack-U 正确分层，母排与歧管纵向贯穿，邻架 ghost 可见。
3. **托盘级 / 板级** — explode 视图里 4 GPU + 2 Grace + 8 HBM/卡 + 2 夹层板（4 CX-8）+ BF-3 + M.2/E1.S + 半透明冷板全部可辨。
4. **右栏详情全程跟随**，Claim 表证据徽章 / locator / 「官方未公布」/ 售前话术卡 / 数量出处均正确渲染。
5. **`?gl=off`** — 提示条 + 完整结构树（50 个可交互节点），`data-ready="1"`、`data-gl="none"`。
6. 深链 `?focus=&level=` 生效。

实测中发现并修掉的 5 个真实缺陷：instanced 机架 per-instance color 乘在材质色上导致发黑；冷板不透明挡住全部芯片；横向水管被压成扁盘（圆柱轴向未按最长边旋转）；降级树溢出被底部步骤条盖住；`ready` 与首帧机位依赖 rAF。

**一个如实说明**：截图工具在标签页未获焦点时抓到的是空画布——`frameloop="demand"` 的补帧走 rAF，而 Chrome 会节流未聚焦标签页的 rAF。每次先点击/滚轮激活标签页后画面即正确。已把首次机位改成 `useLayoutEffect` + 瞬移、`ready` 改由 `onCreated` 回写来把首帧确定化，但这属于浏览器行为，代码侧无法完全消除。**B5 写 Playwright 基线时需注意：等 `data-ready="1"` 之后仍应触发一次交互或用 `page.screenshot()` 强制合成。**

## 与计划的偏差

1. `ClusterScene/RackScene/TrayScene` 作为三个组件放在 `SceneRoot.tsx` 内，未拆成独立文件（本批共 ~330 行，拆开反而割裂 LOD 挂载逻辑）。
2. 任务书列的形状词汇（`tray-1u/chip-large/cabinet/room`…）与 B1 冻结的 `VisualShape` 联合不一致——**以冻结的 `types.ts` 为准**，实现覆盖了全部 17 个 shape。
3. `RackInstances` 的高亮用 per-instance color 而非 emissive（InstancedMesh 不支持逐实例 emissive），取色仍走 palette 的同一组 accent，观感对齐。
4. 新增两个计划外文件：`components/ui/Chips.tsx`（证据/状态徽章，DetailPanel 与 ComponentTree 共用）、`components/ErrorBoundary.tsx`（B1 没有）。
5. `parseShotParams` 未加测试（避免把 React 拖进 node 测试环境），逻辑本身是纯函数已导出。

## 给 B3 的交接

**store 字段（`src/store.ts`）**

101	
102	- **语义 LOD = React 挂载/卸载**（非 THREE.LOD）：cluster 只挂机架壳 `<Instances>` + scale-out 主干 + `<Grid>` 地面；rack 挂焦点机架全细节（18+9 托盘按 rack-U 由 `layout.ts` 摆位，邻架 ghost）；tray/board 同组件 + explode 偏移（`layout.ts` 预计算）。「8 机架总览不展开板级」由结构保证。
103	- **store（zustand）**：`generation/level/focusPath/selectedId/hoveredId/planes/mode(explore|compare|tour)/compare{right,showDiffOnly}/flow{episodeIdx,playing,speed}/tourStopIdx/reducedMotion/glStatus/ready`；drill 转移委托纯函数 `drill.ts`；**每帧 t 放 FlowLayer ref，绝不进 store**；persist 仅 planes/reducedMotion/generation。
104	- 交互：R3F 指针事件（demand 模式可用），`Hotspot` 最深命中，装饰物 `raycast={()=>null}`；高亮 = emissive + `invalidate()`，无后处理；点选出详情，详情面板「进入 →」或双击下钻，`CameraRig`（drei CameraControls）`setLookAt` 平滑飞行。
105	- **帧循环策略集中于 FactoryCanvas**：`frameloop={playing ? 'always' : 'demand'}`；dpr 桌面 [1,1.75] / 移动 [1,1.5]；visibilitychange 暂停；reducedMotion → 离散步进（不放粒子，静态高亮当前连接）。
106	- **连接平面**：`routing.ts` 纯函数出端口锚点 + 正交折线 + 每平面 lane 偏移 + 弧长 LUT；每平面一组 drei `<Line>`；六色定义于 `palette.ts`（NVLink #76b900、scale-out 紫、业务蓝、管理灰、供电琥珀、液冷青），DOM 图例/降级表 1:1 复用；颜色全经 `palette.ts` 读 CSS `--color-*` 变量（Tailwind 在 canvas 内失效）。
107	- **数据流**：`flowTimeline.ts` 纯函数 FlowEpisode→TimelineSegment（归一化 t0/t1 + 路径 LUT）；FlowLayer 单 InstancedMesh 粒子 `useFrame` 驱动，跨段边界回写 episodeIdx 给 DOM FlowBar（步骤条 + 播放/暂停/步进/速度，逻辑/物理徽章）；HBM 常亮注「权重常驻 HBM，不随请求加载」。
108	- **比较模式**：单 Canvas + drei `<View>` 双视口（同一 WebGL context），主相机写 poseRef 从相机复制；diff 按 roleKey 配对：新增绿边/移除红边/规格变更 accent 边/数量变化边+DOM 计数、showDiffOnly → 未变部件 ghost 8%；详细 diff 文本在 DOM 列表；产能对比 `CapacityBands` 纯 props 卡片。View+demand 若不稳 → 注释预案：手动双 scissor render。
109	- 状态材质：GB300 实体 / Vera Rubin 蓝调实体 / Rubin Ultra 琥珀 wireframe；单环境光+单平行光，MeshStandardMaterial + `<Edges>` 示意风，无阴影。
110	- **降级/移动端**：面包屑/导览/平面开关/详情/步骤条全是 DOM，仅中央格切换 Canvas↔`Fallback2D`（SegmentedTabs：SVG 机架立面 / 组件树 / 连接表；流播放改行高亮）；`webgl.ts` 检测 + `?gl=off` 强制 + context-lost 监听 → 永不白屏（外层 ErrorBoundary 兜底）。移动端 `MobileFactoryView`：禁 orbit、自动导览走同一 `cameraPresets.ts`、热点列表 + Drawer 详情。
111	- **报告** `/report`：懒路由、禁止导入 three/scene（复用 RackElevationSvg + diff 表 + CapacityBands + 证据分组），六节：需求背景/当前架构/推理数据流/代际变化/证据边界/下一阶段；Tailwind `print:` 变体 + `window.print()`。
112	- **深链/测试确定性**：`useShotParams.ts` 读 URL 参数一次性 seed store（`?level=rack&focus=…&planes=…&motion=off&gl=off&mode=compare`）；首帧后容器 `data-ready="1"`。
113	- StrictMode 双挂载风险：Three 资源创建幂等（模块级常量/useMemo + cleanup dispose）。

```text
91	export function rootAssemblyOf(systemId: string): AssemblyNode | undefined {

93	}

95	/** 直接子节点，保持内容文件中的声明顺序。 */
96	export function childrenOf(assemblyId: string): AssemblyNode[] {
97	  return FACTORY_PACK.assemblies.filter((a) => a.parentId === assemblyId)
98	}
99	
100	/** 从根到该节点的路径（含自身），用于面包屑。存在环时返回已收集到的部分。 */
101	export function ancestorsOf(assemblyId: string): AssemblyNode[] {
102	  const path: AssemblyNode[] = []
103	  const seen = new Set<string>()
104	  let cur = assemblyIndex.get(assemblyId)
105	  while (cur && !seen.has(cur.id)) {
106	    seen.add(cur.id)
107	    path.unshift(cur)
108	    cur = cur.parentId === null ? undefined : assemblyIndex.get(cur.parentId)
109	  }
110	  return path
111	}
112	
113	/** 子树内全部节点（含自身），深度优先。 */
114	export function descendantsOf(assemblyId: string): AssemblyNode[] {
115	  const out: AssemblyNode[] = []
116	  const seen = new Set<string>()
117	  const walk = (id: string) => {
118	    if (seen.has(id)) return
119	    seen.add(id)
120	    const node = assemblyIndex.get(id)
121	    if (!node) return
122	    out.push(node)
123	    for (const child of childrenOf(id)) walk(child.id)
124	  }
125	  walk(assemblyId)
126	  return out
127	}
128	
129	/**
130	 * 该节点的实例总数 = 沿祖先链的 count 连乘。
131	 *
132	 * @param scopeAssemblyId 计数的参照系（**不含**它自身的 count），省略则从装配树根算起。
133	 *   例：`totalInstances('asm.gb300.b300-gpu', 'asm.gb300.rack')` = 18 × 4 = 72（每机架 72 张卡）；
134	 *   省略 scope 则再乘上 rack 的 8 个 SU = 576。
135	 */
136	export function totalInstances(assemblyId: string, scopeAssemblyId?: string): number {
137	  const path = ancestorsOf(assemblyId)
138	  const scopeIdx = scopeAssemblyId ? path.findIndex((a) => a.id === scopeAssemblyId) : -1
139	  return path.slice(scopeIdx + 1).reduce((acc, node) => acc * node.count, 1)
140	}

146	  )
147	}
```

```text
245	function genericPlacement(ctx: PlacementCtx): Placement {
246	  const [pw, ph, pd] = ctx.parentSize
247	  const size: Vec3 = [
248	    Math.max(pw * 0.12, 0.02),
249	    Math.max(ph * 0.12, 0.02),

251	  ]

259	
260	function vAdd(a: Vec3, b: Vec3): Vec3 {
261	  return [a[0] + b[0], a[1] + b[1], a[2] + b[2]]
262	}
263	
264	function centerOf(slots: Vec3[]): Vec3 {
265	  if (slots.length === 0) return [0, 0, 0]
266	  const s = slots.reduce<Vec3>((acc, p) => vAdd(acc, p), [0, 0, 0])
267	  return [s[0] / slots.length, s[1] / slots.length, s[2] / slots.length]
268	}
269	
270	function extentOf(slots: Vec3[], size: Vec3): Vec3 {
271	  if (slots.length === 0) return size
272	  const out: Vec3 = [0, 0, 0]
273	  for (let axis = 0; axis < 3; axis += 1) {
274	    let lo = Infinity
275	    let hi = -Infinity
276	    for (const p of slots) {
277	      lo = Math.min(lo, p[axis] - size[axis] / 2)
278	      hi = Math.max(hi, p[axis] + size[axis] / 2)
279	    }
280	    out[axis] = hi - lo
281	  }
282	  return out
283	}

288	export function resolveLayout(
289	  systemId: string,
290	  pack: FactoryContentPack = FACTORY_PACK,
291	): ResolvedLayout {
292	  const out = new Map<string, LayoutItem>()
293	  const root = pack.assemblies.find((a) => a.systemId === systemId && a.parentId === null)
294	  if (!root) return out
295	
296	  const system = pack.systems.find((s) => s.id === systemId)
297	  const rackUnits = system?.rackUnitsForLayout ?? DEFAULT_RACK_UNITS
298	  const rackHeight = rackUnits * U_METERS
299	
300	  const byParent = new Map<string, AssemblyNode[]>()
301	  for (const a of pack.assemblies) {
302	    if (a.parentId === null) continue
303	    const bucket = byParent.get(a.parentId)
304	    if (bucket) bucket.push(a)
305	    else byParent.set(a.parentId, [a])
306	  }
307	  const kidsOf = (id: string): AssemblyNode[] => byParent.get(id) ?? []
308	  const rackCount = pack.assemblies.find((a) => a.systemId === systemId && a.roleKey === 'rack')?.count ?? 1
309	
310	  const walk = (node: AssemblyNode, parentSize: Vec3): void => {
311	    const ctx: PlacementCtx = { parentSize, rackHeight, node }
312	    const rule = PLACEMENTS[node.roleKey] ?? genericPlacement(ctx)
313	
314	    // rack-U 设备的尺寸由槽高推导；机架与机架列的高度跟随 rackUnitsForLayout。
315	    let size = rule.size
316	    if (node.rackU) size = rackUSize(ctx)
317	    else if (node.roleKey === 'rack') size = [RACK_WIDTH, rackHeight, RACK_DEPTH]
318	    else if (node.roleKey === 'rack-row') size = [rackCount * RACK_PITCH, rackHeight, RACK_DEPTH]
319	    else if (node.roleKey === 'dc-busbar' || node.roleKey === 'liquid-manifold')
320	      size = [rule.size[0], rackHeight * 0.86, rule.size[2]]
321	    else if (node.roleKey === 'nvlink-backplane')
322	      size = [rule.size[0], rackHeight * 0.42, rule.size[2]]
323	    else if (size[0] === 0 && size[1] === 0 && size[2] === 0) size = TRAY_SIZE
324	
325	    const slots = rule.slots(node.count, ctx)
326	    const ex = rule.explode
327	    const explodedSlots: Vec3[] = ex
328	      ? slots.map((p) => [p[0] * ex.spread, p[1] + ex.lift, p[2] * ex.spread] as Vec3)
329	      : slots.map((p) => [...p] as Vec3)
330	
331	    out.set(node.id, {
332	      assemblyId: node.id,
333	      size,
334	      slots,
335	      explodedSlots,
336	      pos: centerOf(slots),
337	      explodedPos: centerOf(explodedSlots),
338	      extent: extentOf(slots, size),
339	    })
340	
341	    for (const kid of kidsOf(node.id)) walk(kid, size)
342	  }
343	
344	  // 机房本体：根节点的「父」是世界坐标系。
345	  const rootRule = PLACEMENTS[root.roleKey] ?? genericPlacement({ parentSize: [30, 6, 20], rackHeight, node: root })
346	  walk(root, rootRule.size)
347	  return out
348	}
349	
350	// ─────────────────────────── 记忆化 + 世界坐标 ───────────────────────────
351	
352	const layoutCache = new Map<string, ResolvedLayout>()
353	
354	/** 记忆化版本：内容包是静态的，同一系统只解析一次。 */
355	export function layoutOf(systemId: string): ResolvedLayout {
356	  const hit = layoutCache.get(systemId)
357	  if (hit) return hit
358	  const resolved = resolveLayout(systemId)
359	  layoutCache.set(systemId, resolved)
360	  return resolved
361	}
362	
363	/**
364	 * 把某节点的实例位置累加成世界坐标。
365	 *
366	 * 祖先链上 count > 1 的节点一律取第 0 个实例——B2 的下钻焦点不区分实例序号
367	 * （面包屑与相机只认 assemblyId），这个约定同时保证了相机预设的确定性。
368	 */
369	export function worldPositionOf(
370	  layout: ResolvedLayout,
371	  ancestorChain: readonly string[],
372	  instanceIndex = 0,
373	  exploded = false,
374	): Vec3 {
375	  let acc: Vec3 = [0, 0, 0]
376	  ancestorChain.forEach((id, depth) => {
377	    const item = layout.get(id)
378	    if (!item) return
379	    const idx = depth === ancestorChain.length - 1 ? instanceIndex : 0
380	    const source = exploded ? item.explodedSlots : item.slots
381	    const slot = source[Math.min(idx, source.length - 1)] ?? [0, 0, 0]
382	    acc = vAdd(acc, slot)
383	  })
384	  return acc
385	}
386
```
</details></tool-use>

```text
2	 * 颜色单一事实源。
3	 *
4	 * ★ 硬规则：本文件（与整个 `src/lib/`）零 three 导入——只产出 `#rrggbb` 字符串，
5	 *   因此 node 环境可测。
6	 *
7	 * 为什么需要它：Canvas 内部 Tailwind class 不生效，3D 材质只能吃具体颜色值。
8	 * 而 DOM 侧的图例/降级表必须与 3D 连线颜色 1:1 一致，否则「绿色是 NVLink」这个
9	 * 讲解锚点就断了。于是两侧都以 `src/index.css` 的 CSS 变量为准：
10	 * DOM 直接用 Tailwind token，3D 侧在这里用 getComputedStyle 读同一个变量。
11	 *
12	 * 读取一次性缓存（内容包与主题都是静态的），非浏览器环境（Vitest node）走 fallback 常量表。
13	 */
14	
15	import type { NetworkPlane, ProductStatus } from '../data/types'
16	
17	/** fallback 必须与 `src/index.css` 的 `@theme` 逐条对齐；改主题时两边一起改。 */
18	export const PALETTE_FALLBACK = {
19	  ink: '#eef1f5',
20	  panel: '#ffffff',
21	  'panel-2': '#f4f6fa',
22	  line: '#d8dee8',
23	  fg: '#16202b',
24	  dim: '#5f6b7a',
25	  accent: '#0f766e',
26	  'accent-2': '#6d28d9',
27	  ok: '#166534',
28	  warn: '#92400e',

30	  amber: '#d97706',

32	  'plane-scaleout': '#6d28d9',
33	  'plane-business': '#1d4ed8',
34	  'plane-mgmt': '#64748b',
35	  'plane-power': '#d97706',
36	  'plane-cooling': '#0891b2',
37	} as const
38	
39	export type PaletteToken = keyof typeof PALETTE_FALLBACK
40	export type Palette = Record<PaletteToken, string>
41	
42	const TOKENS = Object.keys(PALETTE_FALLBACK) as PaletteToken[]
43	
44	let cached: Palette | null = null
45	
46	function readVar(name: PaletteToken): string {
47	  if (typeof document === 'undefined' || !document.documentElement) return PALETTE_FALLBACK[name]
48	  const raw = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(`--color-${name}`).trim()
49	  // 变量缺失或被写成 oklch()/color-mix() 这类 three 解析不了的形式时退回常量。
50	  return /^#[0-9a-f]{3,8}$/i.test(raw) || /^rgb/i.test(raw) ? raw : PALETTE_FALLBACK[name]
51	}
52	
53	/** 读取整套调色板（首次调用后缓存）。 */
54	export function palette(): Palette {
55	  if (cached) return cached
56	  const out = {} as Palette
57	  for (const t of TOKENS) out[t] = readVar(t)
58	  cached = out
59	  return out
60	}
61	
62	/** 测试或主题切换后强制重读。 */
63	export function resetPaletteCache(): void {
64	  cached = null
65	}
66	
67	/** 取单个 token 的颜色；未知 token 返回 `fallbackToken` 的颜色。 */
68	export function color(token: string | null, fallbackToken: PaletteToken = 'dim'): string {
69	  const p = palette()
70	  if (token && token in p) return p[token as PaletteToken]
```

```text
1	import type { Claim, ClaimValue, Confidence, EvidenceType, ProductStatus } from './types'
2	
3	/**
4	 * Claim 构造小工具。纯函数、返回纯对象（模块加载期求值），不破坏 JSON 可序列化。
5	 * 目的只有一个：让内容文件里「每个数字都带出处」写起来不痛苦，从而不会有人图省事去写裸数字。
6	 */
7	
8	export const RA_SOURCE = 'src.nvidia-nvl72-ra'
9	export const GB300_PAGE_SOURCE = 'src.nvidia-gb300-page'
10	/** NVIDIA 官方页面抓取时间。 */
11	export const NVIDIA_ASOF = '2026-08'
12	
13	interface ClaimInit<T extends ClaimValue> {
14	  value: T | null
15	  sourceId: string
16	  unit?: string | null
17	  evidence?: EvidenceType
18	  status?: ProductStatus
19	  locator?: string | null
20	  asOf?: string
21	  confidence?: Confidence
22	  note?: string | null
23	}
24	
25	export function claim<T extends ClaimValue>(init: ClaimInit<T>): Claim<T> {
26	  return {
27	    value: init.value,
28	    unit: init.unit ?? null,
29	    evidence: init.evidence ?? 'verified_spec',
30	    status: init.status ?? 'shipping',
31	    sourceId: init.sourceId,
32	    locator: init.locator ?? null,
33	    asOf: init.asOf ?? NVIDIA_ASOF,
34	    confidence: init.confidence ?? 'high',
35	    note: init.note ?? null,
36	  }
37	}
38	
39	/** NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 企业参考架构文档中的确切规格。 */
40	export function raSpec<T extends ClaimValue>(
41	  value: T | null,
42	  unit: string | null,
43	  locator: string,
44	  note: string | null = null,
45	): Claim<T> {
46	  return claim<T>({ value, unit, sourceId: RA_SOURCE, locator, note })
47	}
48	
49	/** 关键数量：locator 必填，保证任何时候都能回查官方文档的具体表格/段落。 */
50	export function raCount(value: number, locator: string, note: string | null = null): Claim<number> {
51	  return claim<number>({ value, unit: '个', sourceId: RA_SOURCE, locator, note })
52	}
53	
54	/** NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 产品页规格表中的确切规格。 */
55	export function pageSpec<T extends ClaimValue>(
56	  value: T | null,
57	  unit: string | null,
58	  locator: string,
59	  note: string | null = null,
60	): Claim<T> {
61	  return claim<T>({ value, unit, sourceId: GB300_PAGE_SOURCE, locator, note })
62	}
63	
64	/** 厂商宣称（营销口径，非可验证规格）——UI 上要与 verified_spec 明显区分。 */
65	export function vendorClaim<T extends ClaimValue>(
66	  value: T | null,
67	  unit: string | null,
68	  sourceId: string,
69	  locator: string,
70	  note: string | null = null,
71	): Claim<T> {
72	  return claim<T>({ value, unit, sourceId, locator, evidence: 'vendor_claim', confidence: 'medium', note })
73	}
74	
75	/**
76	 * 「官方未公布，本项目不编数」——value 恒为 null。
77	 * 下游必须把它渲染成 N/A 并显示 note，产能估算遇到它要走拒绝/降级门。
78	 */
79	export function notPublished(
80	  unit: string | null,
81	  sourceId: string,
82	  note: string,
83	  locator: string | null = null,
84	): Claim {
85	  return claim({
86	    value: null,
87	    unit,
88	    sourceId,
89	    locator,
90	    confidence: 'low',
91	    note,
92	  })
93	}
```

```text
1	/**
2	 * 全局 UI 状态（zustand）。
3	 *
4	 * 三条硬规则：
5	 * 1. **每帧动画值绝不进 store**——粒子进度 / 相机插值 / 悬停高亮的 tween 一律留在
6	 *    R3F 的 ref 与 useFrame 里。store 只存「离散的、会引起 DOM 重渲染的」状态。
7	 * 2. 下钻转移全部委托 `lib/drill.ts` 的纯函数，store 只是它的宿主，
8	 *    这样状态机可以在 node 环境里单测。
9	 * 3. persist 只落盘用户偏好（planes / reducedMotion / generation），
10	 *    不落盘 level/focus/selected——刷新后回到干净的集群总览，避免旧 ID 把界面卡死。
11	 */
12	
13	import { create } from 'zustand'
14	import { persist, createJSONStorage } from 'zustand/middleware'
15	import { FACTORY_PACK, sceneById } from './data'
16	import type { LodLevel, NetworkPlane } from './data/types'
17	import type { DrillState } from './lib/drill'
18	import { initialDrillState, nextState } from './lib/drill'
19	import { PLANE_ORDER } from './lib/palette'
20	
21	export type PlaneFlags = Record<NetworkPlane, boolean>
22	
23	/** 'unknown' = 尚未探测；'failed' = 运行期 context lost 或初始化抛错。 */
24	export type GlStatus = 'unknown' | 'webgl2' | 'webgl' | 'none' | 'failed'
25	
26	export type ExplorerMode = 'explore' | 'compare' | 'tour'
27	
28	export const DEFAULT_SYSTEM_ID = FACTORY_PACK.systems[0]?.id ?? 'sys.gb300-nvl72'
29	
30	/** 默认全开：先让用户看到「六个平面同时存在」，再靠开关做减法。 */
31	export function defaultPlanes(): PlaneFlags {
32	  return PLANE_ORDER.reduce((acc, p) => {
33	    acc[p] = true
34	    return acc
35	  }, {} as PlaneFlags)
36	}
37	
38	export interface FactoryState extends DrillState {
39	  /** 当前代际 = FactorySystem.id。B4 起可切换。 */
40	  generation: string
41	  hoveredId: string | null
42	  planes: PlaneFlags
43	  mode: ExplorerMode
44	  /** B3 的数据流播放状态，本批只占位存态。 */
45	  flow: { episodeIdx: number; playing: boolean; speed: number }
46	  tourStopIdx: number
47	  reducedMotion: boolean
48	  glStatus: GlStatus
49	  /** 3D 首帧已出（或已确定走降级）。E2E 用容器上的 data-ready 等它。 */
50	  ready: boolean
51	
52	  drillTo: (assemblyId: string) => void
53	  drillUp: () => void
54	  jumpTo: (assemblyId: string) => void
55	  select: (assemblyId: string | null) => void
56	  hover: (assemblyId: string | null) => void
57	  applyScene: (sceneId: string) => void
58	  setTourStop: (idx: number) => void
59	  togglePlane: (plane: NetworkPlane) => void
60	  setPlanes: (planes: Partial<PlaneFlags>) => void
61	  setMode: (mode: ExplorerMode) => void
62	  setFlow: (patch: Partial<FactoryState['flow']>) => void
63	  setReducedMotion: (v: boolean) => void
64	  setGlStatus: (s: GlStatus) => void
65	  setReady: (v: boolean) => void
66	  setLevel: (level: LodLevel) => void
67	  reset: () => void
68	}
69	
70	/** `prefers-reduced-motion` 作为初始种子；用户之后可以显式覆盖并落盘。 */
71	function prefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
72	  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof window.matchMedia !== 'function') return false
73	  try {
74	    return window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches
75	  } catch {
76	    return false
77	  }
78	}
79	
80	/** 非浏览器环境（Vitest node / SSR）下的空存储，避免 persist 触碰不存在的 localStorage。 */
81	const memoryStore = new Map<string, string>()
82	const safeStorage = {
83	  getItem: (name: string): string | null =>
84	    typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage
85	      ? window.localStorage.getItem(name)
86	      : (memoryStore.get(name) ?? null),
87	  setItem: (name: string, value: string): void => {
88	    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) window.localStorage.setItem(name, value)
89	    else memoryStore.set(name, value)
90	  },
91	  removeItem: (name: string): void => {
92	    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) window.localStorage.removeItem(name)
93	    else memoryStore.delete(name)
94	  },
95	}
96	
97	/** 落盘的那三项。 */
98	export interface PersistedSlice {
99	  planes: PlaneFlags
100	  reducedMotion: boolean
101	  generation: string
102	}
103	
104	/**
105	 * rehydrate 清洗：老版本的 localStorage、被手改坏的值、已删除的 systemId
106	 * 都不能把界面打崩——一律回落到默认值。
107	 */
108	export function sanitizePersisted(raw: unknown): PersistedSlice {
109	  const fallback: PersistedSlice = {
110	    planes: defaultPlanes(),
111	    reducedMotion: false,
112	    generation: DEFAULT_SYSTEM_ID,
113	  }
114	  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') return fallback
115	  const o = raw as Record<string, unknown>
116	
117	  const planes = defaultPlanes()
118	  if (o.planes && typeof o.planes === 'object') {
119	    const p = o.planes as Record<string, unknown>
120	    for (const key of PLANE_ORDER) {
121	      if (typeof p[key] === 'boolean') planes[key] = p[key]
122	    }
123	  }
124	
125	  const generation =
126	    typeof o.generation === 'string' && FACTORY_PACK.systems.some((s) => s.id === o.generation)
127	      ? o.generation
128	      : DEFAULT_SYSTEM_ID
129	
130	  return {
131	    planes,
132	    reducedMotion: typeof o.reducedMotion === 'boolean' ? o.reducedMotion : false,
133	    generation,
134	  }
135	}
136	
137	export const useFactoryStore = create<FactoryState>()(
138	  persist(
139	    (set) => ({
140	      ...initialDrillState(DEFAULT_SYSTEM_ID),
141	      generation: DEFAULT_SYSTEM_ID,
142	      hoveredId: null,
143	      planes: defaultPlanes(),
144	      mode: 'explore',
145	      flow: { episodeIdx: 0, playing: false, speed: 1 },
146	      tourStopIdx: -1,
147	      reducedMotion: prefersReducedMotion(),
148	      glStatus: 'unknown',
149	      ready: false,
150	
151	      drillTo: (assemblyId) => set((s) => nextState(s, { type: 'drillTo', assemblyId })),
152	      drillUp: () => set((s) => nextState(s, { type: 'drillUp' })),
153	      jumpTo: (assemblyId) => set((s) => nextState(s, { type: 'jumpTo', assemblyId })),
154	      select: (assemblyId) => set((s) => nextState(s, { type: 'select', assemblyId })),
155	      hover: (assemblyId) => set((s) => (s.hoveredId === assemblyId ? s : { hoveredId: assemblyId })),
156	      setLevel: (level) => set({ level }),
157	
158	      applyScene: (sceneId) => {
159	        const scene = sceneById(sceneId)
160	        if (!scene) return
161	        const idx = FACTORY_PACK.scenes.findIndex((s) => s.id === sceneId)
162	        const planes = defaultPlanes()
163	        for (const key of PLANE_ORDER) planes[key] = scene.planes.includes(key)
164	        set((s) => ({
165	          ...nextState(s, {
166	            type: 'applyScene',
167	            level: scene.lodLevel,
168	            focusAssemblyId: scene.focusAssemblyId,
169	          }),
170	          planes,
171	          tourStopIdx: idx,
172	          mode: 'tour',
```

```text
4	 * - `frameloop="demand"`：空闲时零连续帧（B3 播放数据流时会切成 'always'）。
5	 *   任何改变画面的动作都必须显式 `invalidate()`——约定见 Hotspot / CameraRig。

9	 *   工程示意图风格，靠 `<Edges>` 描边而不是靠光影表达结构。
10	 * - 颜色全部经 `lib/palette.ts`（Canvas 内 Tailwind class 不生效）。
11	 * - 初始化抛错 / `webglcontextlost` → `store.glStatus = 'failed'`，
12	 *   外层 FactoryPage 立刻切到结构视图，永不白屏。
13	 */
14	
15	import { Canvas } from '@react-three/fiber'
16	import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react'
17	import { CAMERA_FOV } from '../../lib/cameraPresets'
18	import { palette } from '../../lib/palette'
19	import { useFactoryStore } from '../../store'
20	import { ErrorBoundary } from '../ErrorBoundary'
21	import CameraRig from './CameraRig'
22	import SceneRoot from './SceneRoot'
23	
24	export default function FactoryCanvas() {
25	  const setGlStatus = useFactoryStore((s) => s.setGlStatus)
26	  const setReady = useFactoryStore((s) => s.setReady)
27	  const cleanupRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null)
28	
29	  const p = palette()
30	  const dpr = useMemo<[number, number]>(() => {
31	    const mobile = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768
32	    return mobile ? [1, 1.5] : [1, 1.75]
33	  }, [])
34	
35	  useEffect(() => () => cleanupRef.current?.(), [])
36	
37	  return (
38	    <ErrorBoundary
39	      onError={() => {
40	        setGlStatus('failed')
41	        setReady(true)
42	      }}
43	      fallback={null}
44	    >
45	      <Canvas
46	        frameloop="demand"
47	        dpr={dpr}
48	        shadows={false}
49	        flat
50	        camera={{ fov: CAMERA_FOV, near: 0.01, far: 600, position: [7, 4.5, 10] }}
51	        gl={{ antialias: true, powerPreference: 'high-performance', alpha: false }}
52	        onCreated={({ gl }) => {
53	          const canvas = gl.domElement
54	          const onLost = (e: Event) => {
55	            e.preventDefault()
56	            setGlStatus('failed')
57	          }
58	          canvas.addEventListener('webglcontextlost', onLost, false)
59	          cleanupRef.current = () => canvas.removeEventListener('webglcontextlost', onLost)
60	          // ready 必须由 onCreated 决定，不能靠 requestAnimationFrame：
61	          // 后台/未聚焦标签页里 rAF 会被节流甚至完全暂停，那样 data-ready 永远停在 0，
62	          // E2E 会白等到超时。onCreated 说明 WebGL 上下文已经建起来了，这就够了。

67	        <ambientLight intensity={0.95} />
68	        <directionalLight position={[8, 14, 7]} intensity={1.3} />
69	        <directionalLight position={[-7, 6, -9]} intensity={0.32} />
70	        <SceneRoot />
```

```text
4	 * 语义 LOD 的四级：cluster → rack → tray → board。

6	 * 这样换代（Vera Rubin / Rubin Ultra）时不需要改一行下钻逻辑。
7	 *
8	 * 推导规则（`levelOfFocus`）：
9	 *   - 树根 → cluster；
10	 *   - 叶子节点 → 它自己的 lodLevel（「进不去了，就停在它所在的那一层」）；
11	 *   - 有子节点 → max(自身 lodLevel, 最粗的子节点 lodLevel)
12	 *     （即「至少能展开到子层」，但不会因为个别深层子孙就跳级）。
13	 *
14	 * 代入 GB300 校验：
15	 *   facility→cluster、row→cluster、rack→rack、compute-tray→tray、
16	 *   nvswitch-tray→tray、b300-gpu→board、power-shelf→rack、cdu→cluster。
17	 */
18	
19	import { FACTORY_PACK, ancestorsOf, assemblyById, childrenOf } from '../data'
20	import type { AssemblyNode, FactoryContentPack, LodLevel } from '../data/types'
21	
22	export const LEVEL_ORDER: readonly LodLevel[] = ['cluster', 'rack', 'tray', 'board']
23	
24	export const LEVEL_LABEL: Record<LodLevel, string> = {
25	  cluster: '集群',
26	  rack: '机架',
27	  tray: '托盘',
28	  board: '板级',
29	}
30	
31	export function levelIndex(level: LodLevel): number {
32	  return LEVEL_ORDER.indexOf(level)
33	}
34	
35	export interface DrillState {
36	  level: LodLevel
37	  /** 从树根到当前焦点的完整 ID 链（含焦点自身）。空数组 = 尚未初始化。 */
38	  focusPath: string[]
39	  selectedId: string | null
40	}
41	
42	export type DrillAction =
43	  /** 双击 / 详情面板「进入 →」：把焦点移到该节点并推进层级。 */
44	  | { type: 'drillTo'; assemblyId: string }
45	  /** 返回上一层（焦点跳到最近的、层级更浅的祖先）。 */
46	  | { type: 'drillUp' }
47	  /** 面包屑点击：直接跳到指定祖先。 */
48	  | { type: 'jumpTo'; assemblyId: string }
49	  /** 单击选中，不改变层级。 */
50	  | { type: 'select'; assemblyId: string | null }
51	  /** 导览场景应用：显式指定层级与焦点。 */
52	  | { type: 'applyScene'; level: LodLevel; focusAssemblyId: string | null }
53	  | { type: 'reset' }
54	
55	// ─────────────────────────── 结构推导 ───────────────────────────
56	
57	interface PackView {
58	  node: (id: string) => AssemblyNode | undefined
59	  kids: (id: string) => AssemblyNode[]
60	  chain: (id: string) => AssemblyNode[]
61	  root: (systemId: string) => AssemblyNode | undefined
62	}
63	
64	function viewOf(pack: FactoryContentPack): PackView {
65	  if (pack === FACTORY_PACK) {
66	    return {
67	      node: assemblyById,
68	      kids: childrenOf,
69	      chain: ancestorsOf,
70	      root: (systemId) => FACTORY_PACK.assemblies.find((a) => a.systemId === systemId && a.parentId === null),
71	    }
72	  }
73	  const byId = new Map(pack.assemblies.map((a) => [a.id, a]))
74	  return {
75	    node: (id) => byId.get(id),
76	    kids: (id) => pack.assemblies.filter((a) => a.parentId === id),
77	    chain: (id) => {
78	      const out: AssemblyNode[] = []
79	      const seen = new Set<string>()
80	      let cur = byId.get(id)
81	      while (cur && !seen.has(cur.id)) {
82	        seen.add(cur.id)
83	        out.unshift(cur)
84	        cur = cur.parentId === null ? undefined : byId.get(cur.parentId)
85	      }
86	      return out
87	    },
88	    root: (systemId) => pack.assemblies.find((a) => a.systemId === systemId && a.parentId === null),
89	  }
90	}
91	
92	/** 聚焦该节点时应处的 LOD 层级。 */
93	export function levelOfFocus(assemblyId: string, pack: FactoryContentPack = FACTORY_PACK): LodLevel {
94	  const v = viewOf(pack)
95	  const node = v.node(assemblyId)
96	  if (!node) return 'cluster'
97	  if (node.parentId === null) return 'cluster'
98	  const kids = v.kids(assemblyId)
99	  if (kids.length === 0) return node.lodLevel
100	  const own = levelIndex(node.lodLevel)
101	  const shallowestKid = Math.min(...kids.map((k) => levelIndex(k.lodLevel)))
102	  return LEVEL_ORDER[Math.max(own, shallowestKid)] ?? node.lodLevel
103	}
104	
105	/** 该节点是否还能再往里钻（存在子节点且子节点会推进层级）。 */
106	export function canDrillInto(assemblyId: string, pack: FactoryContentPack = FACTORY_PACK): boolean {
107	  const v = viewOf(pack)
108	  const kids = v.kids(assemblyId)
109	  if (kids.length === 0) return false
110	  const here = levelIndex(levelOfFocus(assemblyId, pack))
111	  return kids.some((k) => levelIndex(levelOfFocus(k.id, pack)) > here)
112	}
113	
114	/**
115	 * 场景挂载锚点：3D 侧按它决定挂哪一棵子树（语义 LOD = React 挂载/卸载）。
116	 * - cluster：只挂机架壳与机房设施；
117	 * - rack：挂焦点机架的全部 U 位设备；
118	 * - tray：挂焦点托盘的板级内部（board 级额外应用 explode 偏移）。
119	 */
120	export type SceneAnchor =
121	  | { kind: 'cluster' }
122	  | { kind: 'rack'; rackAssemblyId: string }
123	  | { kind: 'tray'; trayAssemblyId: string; exploded: boolean }
124	
125	/** 最深的「其子节点里有 rack 层设备」的祖先或自身——GB300 里就是机架节点。 */
126	export function rackContainerOf(
127	  assemblyId: string,
128	  pack: FactoryContentPack = FACTORY_PACK,
129	): string | null {
130	  const v = viewOf(pack)
131	  const chain = v.chain(assemblyId)
132	  for (let i = chain.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
133	    const n = chain[i]!
134	    if (v.kids(n.id).some((k) => k.lodLevel === 'rack')) return n.id
135	  }
136	  return null
137	}
138	
139	/** 最深的「自身处于 rack 层且有内部结构」的祖先或自身——即计算/交换托盘。 */
140	export function trayContainerOf(
141	  assemblyId: string,
142	  pack: FactoryContentPack = FACTORY_PACK,
143	): string | null {
144	  const v = viewOf(pack)
145	  const chain = v.chain(assemblyId)
146	  for (let i = chain.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
147	    const n = chain[i]!
148	    if (n.lodLevel === 'rack' && v.kids(n.id).length > 0) return n.id
149	  }
150	  return null
151	}
152	
153	export function sceneAnchorOf(
154	  state: DrillState,
155	  pack: FactoryContentPack = FACTORY_PACK,
156	): SceneAnchor {
157	  const focusId = state.focusPath[state.focusPath.length - 1]
158	  if (!focusId || state.level === 'cluster') return { kind: 'cluster' }
159	  if (state.level === 'rack') {
160	    const rackId = rackContainerOf(focusId, pack)
161	    return rackId ? { kind: 'rack', rackAssemblyId: rackId } : { kind: 'cluster' }
162	  }
163	  const trayId = trayContainerOf(focusId, pack)
164	  if (trayId) return { kind: 'tray', trayAssemblyId: trayId, exploded: state.level === 'board' }
165	  const rackId = rackContainerOf(focusId, pack)
166	  return rackId ? { kind: 'rack', rackAssemblyId: rackId } : { kind: 'cluster' }
167	}
168	
169	// ─────────────────────────── 面包屑 ───────────────────────────
170	
171	export interface Crumb {
172	  assemblyId: string
173	  label: string
174	  level: LodLevel
175	  /** 当前焦点本身。 */
176	  current: boolean
177	}
178	
179	/** focusPath → 面包屑（复用 data 层的 ancestorsOf，不重写树遍历）。 */
180	export function crumbsOf(focusPath: readonly string[], pack: FactoryContentPack = FACTORY_PACK): Crumb[] {
181	  const focusId = focusPath[focusPath.length - 1]
182	  if (!focusId) return []
183	  const v = viewOf(pack)
184	  const chain = v.chain(focusId)
185	  return chain.map((n, i) => ({
186	    assemblyId: n.id,
187	    label: n.label,
188	    level: levelOfFocus(n.id, pack),
189	    current: i === chain.length - 1,
190	  }))
191	}
192	
193	// ─────────────────────────── 状态转移 ───────────────────────────
194	
195	export function initialDrillState(
196	  systemId: string,
197	  pack: FactoryContentPack = FACTORY_PACK,
198	): DrillState {
199	  const root = viewOf(pack).root(systemId)
200	  return { level: 'cluster', focusPath: root ? [root.id] : [], selectedId: null }
201	}
202	
203	function focusTo(assemblyId: string, pack: FactoryContentPack, prev: DrillState): DrillState {
204	  const v = viewOf(pack)
205	  const node = v.node(assemblyId)
206	  if (!node) return prev // 非法 ID：状态不变（深链参数写错时不该把界面打崩）
207	  const chain = v.chain(assemblyId)
208	  return {
209	    level: levelOfFocus(assemblyId, pack),
210	    focusPath: chain.map((n) => n.id),
211	    selectedId: assemblyId,
212	  }
213	}
214	
215	export function nextState(
216	  state: DrillState,
217	  action: DrillAction,
218	  pack: FactoryContentPack = FACTORY_PACK,
219	): DrillState {
220	  const v = viewOf(pack)
221	  switch (action.type) {
222	    case 'drillTo':
223	      return focusTo(action.assemblyId, pack, state)
224	
225	    case 'jumpTo': {
226	      const next = focusTo(action.assemblyId, pack, state)
227	      // 面包屑回跳不应该顺手改选中项之外的东西；选中项跟随焦点是刻意的（右栏立刻有内容）。
228	      return next
229	    }
230	
231	    case 'drillUp': {
232	      const focusId = state.focusPath[state.focusPath.length - 1]
233	      if (!focusId) return state
234	      const here = levelIndex(state.level)
235	      if (here <= 0) return state // 已在 cluster：无处可退
236	      const targetLevel = LEVEL_ORDER[here - 1]!
237	      const chain = v.chain(focusId)
238	      // 优先回到「恰好是上一级」的祖先。从根往下找 ⇒ 命中最外层的那个，
239	      // 例如从 rack 退出时落到「机房」而不是中间的「机架列」（两者同为 cluster 级）。
240	      for (let i = 0; i < chain.length - 1; i += 1) {
241	        if (levelOfFocus(chain[i]!.id, pack) === targetLevel) return focusTo(chain[i]!.id, pack, state)
242	      }
243	      // 树形不规则时兜底：退到最近的更浅祖先。
244	      for (let i = chain.length - 2; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
245	        if (levelIndex(levelOfFocus(chain[i]!.id, pack)) < here) return focusTo(chain[i]!.id, pack, state)
246	      }
247	      return state
248	    }
249	
250	    case 'select': {
251	      if (action.assemblyId === null) return { ...state, selectedId: null }
252	      return v.node(action.assemblyId) ? { ...state, selectedId: action.assemblyId } : state
253	    }
254	
255	    case 'applyScene': {
256	      if (action.focusAssemblyId === null) return { ...state, level: action.level }
257	      const next = focusTo(action.focusAssemblyId, pack, state)
258	      if (next === state) return state
259	      // 导览场景显式声明层级（例如「一个计算托盘里有什么」要求 board 级拆解视图），
260	      // 它优先于结构推导出的层级。
261	      return { ...next, level: action.level }
262	    }
263	
264	    case 'reset': {
265	      const focusId = state.focusPath[0]
266	      const node = focusId ? v.node(focusId) : undefined
267	      return node ? initialDrillState(node.systemId, pack) : state
268	    }
269	
270	    default:
271	      return state
272	  }
273	}
274
```

```text
1	/**
2	 * URL 参数 → store 的**一次性**播种。
3	 *
4	 * 两个用途合一：
5	 * 1. 深链——`/?level=board&focus=asm.gb300.b300-gpu` 直接把人送到某一屏，
6	 *    汇报时不用现场点五下；
7	 * 2. 截图/E2E 的确定性入口——`?motion=off&gl=off` 可以关掉相机动画与 WebGL，
8	 *    让 B5 的 Playwright 基线不受动画时序影响。
9	 *
10	 * 「一次性」很重要：播种之后用户的手动操作不应该被 URL 覆盖，
11	 * 因此这里不做双向同步（URL ← store 的回写留给后续批次按需加）。
12	 */
13	
14	import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
15	import { assemblyById } from '../data'
16	import type { LodLevel, NetworkPlane } from '../data/types'
17	import { LEVEL_ORDER } from '../lib/drill'
18	import { PLANE_ORDER } from '../lib/palette'
19	import { detectWebGL } from '../lib/webgl'
20	import { useFactoryStore } from '../store'
21	import type { PlaneFlags } from '../store'
22	
23	export interface ShotParams {
24	  level: LodLevel | null
25	  focus: string | null
26	  planes: NetworkPlane[] | null
27	  motionOff: boolean
28	  glOff: boolean
29	}
30	
31	/** 纯解析，不碰 store。 */
32	export function parseShotParams(search: string): ShotParams {
33	  const q = new URLSearchParams(search)
34	  const rawLevel = q.get('level')
35	  const level = rawLevel && (LEVEL_ORDER as readonly string[]).includes(rawLevel)
36	    ? (rawLevel as LodLevel)
37	    : null
38	
39	  const rawPlanes = q.get('planes')
40	  const planes = rawPlanes
41	    ? rawPlanes
42	        .split(',')
43	        .map((s) => s.trim())
44	        .filter((s): s is NetworkPlane => (PLANE_ORDER as readonly string[]).includes(s))
45	    : null
46	
47	  return {
48	    level,
49	    focus: q.get('focus'),
50	    planes,
51	    motionOff: q.get('motion') === 'off',
52	    glOff: q.get('gl') === 'off',
53	  }
54	}
55	
56	export function useShotParams(): void {
57	  const seeded = useRef(false)
58	
59	  useEffect(() => {
60	    if (seeded.current) return
61	    seeded.current = true
62	
63	    const search = typeof window === 'undefined' ? '' : window.location.search
64	    const params = parseShotParams(search)
65	    const store = useFactoryStore.getState()
66	
67	    // WebGL：显式关闭优先，否则跑一次能力探测。
68	    store.setGlStatus(params.glOff ? 'none' : detectWebGL(search))
69	    if (params.glOff) store.setReady(true) // 没有 Canvas 就没有首帧回调
70	
71	    if (params.motionOff) store.setReducedMotion(true)
72	
73	    if (params.planes) {
74	      const flags = PLANE_ORDER.reduce((acc, p) => {
75	        acc[p] = params.planes!.includes(p)
76	        return acc
77	      }, {} as PlaneFlags)
78	      store.setPlanes(flags)
79	    }
80	
81	    // 焦点先于层级：层级由焦点的结构位置推导，显式 level 再覆盖一次。
82	    if (params.focus && assemblyById(params.focus)) store.drillTo(params.focus)
83	    if (params.level) store.setLevel(params.level)
84	  }, [])
85	}
86
```
