```text
119	  | 'switch'
120	  | 'nic'
121	  | 'dpu'
122	  | 'storage'
123	  | 'power'
124	  | 'cooling'
125	  | 'facility'
126	
127	export type ComponentKind = 'gpu' | NonGpuComponentKind
128	
129	/**
130	 * roofline 数学的输入口径——**与 Claim 证据展示刻意分离**：
131	 * 这里只放能直接进公式的官方数字，任一关键字段为 null 时 `capacity.ts` 走拒绝/降级门。
132	 * 未公布的整体设为 `mathSpecs: null`，不允许拿分析师估算填。
133	 */
134	export interface GpuMathSpecs {
135	  memoryGB: number
136	  bandwidthTBs: number
137	  fp8Tflops: number | null // 稠密口径（dense）
138	  fp4Tflops: number | null // 稠密口径（dense）
139	  tdpW: number | null
140	  /** 数值怎么来的（如「官方整机值 ÷72」），UI 悬浮显示，防止被当成芯片规格表直接引用。 */
141	  derivation: string
142	}
143	
144	interface ComponentBase {
145	  id: string // cmp.*
146	  name: string
147	  vendor: string
148	  status: ProductStatus
149	  /** 作用一句话：这东西是干嘛的。 */
150	  summary: string
151	  /** 售前怎么跟客户解释（人话、带业务价值）。 */
152	  presalesNote: string
153	  visual: VisualHint
154	  /** 实物图外链（只外链，不复制进包）。 */
155	  imageUrl: string | null
156	  sourceIds: string[]
157	  /** 规格表：键为稳定语义键（如 'hbmPerGpuGB'），值为可溯源 Claim。 */
158	  specs: Record<string, Claim>
159	}
160	
161	export type HardwareComponent =
162	  | (ComponentBase & { kind: 'gpu'; mathSpecs: GpuMathSpecs | null })
163	  | (ComponentBase & { kind: NonGpuComponentKind; mathSpecs?: never })
164	
165	// ─────────────────────────── 系统（一代机架方案） ───────────────────────────
166	
167	export interface FactorySystem {
168	  id: string // sys.*
169	  name: string
170	  vendor: string
171	  status: ProductStatus
172	  /** 代际标识，如 'blackwell-ultra' / 'vera-rubin' / 'rubin-ultra'。 */
173	  generation: string
174	  referenceUrl: string | null
175	  summary: string
176	  presalesNote: string
177	  sourceIds: string[]
178	  /** 至少包含 'gpuCount' 与 'rackPowerKW'（后者为 tokens/W 估算输入，未公布则 value: null）。 */
179	  keySpecs: Record<string, Claim>
180	  /**
181	   * 机架总高（U），仅供 3D 摆位与 rack-U 不重叠校验使用。
182	   * ⚠️ 非官方规格 claim——官方未公布逐 U 布局，`AssemblyNode.rackU` 全为示意占位。
183	   */
184	  rackUnitsForLayout: number | null
185	}
186	
187	// ─────────────────────────── 装配树 ───────────────────────────
188	
189	/** 语义 LOD 层级 = React 挂载/卸载的粒度（非 THREE.LOD）。 */
190	export type LodLevel = 'cluster' | 'rack' | 'tray' | 'board'
191	
192	/** 机架内占位区间（1U 起）。`start` 为最低 U，`height` 覆盖该节点全部 `count` 个实例的连续跨度。 */
193	export interface RackUSpan {
194	  start: number
195	  height: number
196	}
197	
198	export interface AssemblyNode {
199	  id: string // asm.*
200	  systemId: string // → FactorySystem.id
201	  parentId: string | null // null = 该系统的树根（每系统恰好一个）
202	  componentId: string // → HardwareComponent.id
203	  /** ★ 跨代比较的稳定语义键（如 'accelerator' / 'nvswitch-asic'）。比较逻辑只认它，永不解析 ID。 */
204	  roleKey: string
205	  label: string
206	  /** 每个父实例下的数量。 */
207	  count: number
208	  /** 关键数量必须带证据（18 托盘 / 9 NVSwitch 托盘 / 4 GPU / 2 CPU …）；非关键数量可为 null。 */
209	  countClaim: Claim<number> | null
210	  lodLevel: LodLevel
211	  rackU: RackUSpan | null
212	  note: string | null
213	}
214	
215	// ─────────────────────────── 连接（按类型，不按实例） ───────────────────────────
216	
217	/**
218	 * 拓扑形态。一条 gpu→nvswitch 边 + `topology: 'all-to-all'` 表达 72×18 的全互联，
219	 * 而不是在数据里铺 1296 条实例边。
220	 */
221	export type ConnectionTopology =
222	  | 'all-to-all'
223	  | 'rail-optimized'
224	  | 'fat-tree'
225	  | 'star'
226	  | 'bus'
227	  | 'loop'
228	  | 'point-to-point'
229	
230	export type ConnectionMedium =
231	  | 'copper-backplane'
232	  | 'pcb-trace'
233	  | 'dac-cable'
234	  | 'optical-fiber'
235	  | 'busbar'
236	  | 'ac-feed'
237	  | 'liquid-loop'
238	  | 'thermal-contact'
239	
240	export interface Connection {
241	  id: string // con.*
242	  systemId: string
243	  fromAssemblyId: string // → AssemblyNode.id（须同 systemId）
244	  toAssemblyId: string
245	  plane: NetworkPlane
246	  topology: ConnectionTopology
247	  medium: ConnectionMedium
248	  /** 协议/标准名，如 'NVLink 5' / 'Ethernet RoCEv2' / 'DC 800V busbar'。 */
249	  protocol: string
250	  bandwidth: Claim<number> | null
251	  direction: 'bidirectional' | 'unidirectional'
252	  label: string
253	  summary: string
254	  sourceIds: string[]
255	}
256	
257	// ─────────────────────────── 推理数据流 ───────────────────────────
258	
259	/** 七阶段。`pack.test.ts` 校验一个 episode 内 phase 序号单调不减。 */
260	export type FlowPhase =
261	  | 'ingress'
262	  | 'prefill'
263	  | 'kv-write'
264	  | 'decode'
265	  | 'moe-dispatch'
266	  | 'moe-combine'
267	  | 'egress'
268	
269	export const FLOW_PHASE_ORDER: readonly FlowPhase[] = [
270	  'ingress',
271	  'prefill',
272	  'kv-write',
273	  'decode',
274	  'moe-dispatch',
275	  'moe-combine',
276	  'egress',
277	]
278	
279	export interface FlowStep {
280	  id: string
281	  phase: FlowPhase
282	  label: string
283	  description: string
284	  /** 该步骤点亮的连接；`logicalOnly: true` 的步骤可为空数组。 */
285	  connectionIds: string[]
286	  /**
287	   * 该步骤高亮的装配节点（批次 3 新增，向后兼容追加字段）——用于点亮没有对应
288	   * `Connection` 的部件本身（例如「权重常驻 HBM」要常亮 HBM 装配节点，而不是某条连接）。
289	   * `logicalOnly: true` 的步骤同样可为空数组。
290	   */
291	  highlightAssemblyIds: string[]
292	  /** true = 纯逻辑层步骤（如「路由器选专家」），没有对应物理链路，UI 打「逻辑」徽章。 */
293	  logicalOnly: boolean
294	  /**
295	   * ⚠️ 仅用于动画节奏配比的相对权重，**不是真实时延**，禁止在 UI 上换算成 ms 展示。
296	   */
297	  durationHint: number
298	  presalesNote: string | null
299	}
300	
301	export interface FlowEpisode {
302	  id: string // flow.*
303	  systemId: string
304	  title: string
305	  summary: string
306	  modelId: string | null // → ModelSpec.id
307	  steps: FlowStep[]
308	  sourceIds: string[]
309	}
310	
311	// ─────────────────────────── 代际比较 ───────────────────────────
312	
313	export interface ComparisonRow {
314	  roleKey: string
315	  label: string
316	  /** 覆盖自动生成的 diff 叙述；null = 用自动文案。 */
317	  narrative: string | null

320	export interface ComparisonDefinition {
321	  id: string // cmpdef.*

324	  title: string
325	  /** 给老板汇报用的要点（3~5 条）。 */
326	  summary: string[]
327	  rows: ComparisonRow[]
328	  sourceIds: string[]
329	}
330	
331	// ─────────────────────────── 导览场景 ───────────────────────────
332	
333	/** 导览语义。相机的具体数字归 3D 侧 `cameraPresets.ts`，这里只给「看什么」。 */

335	  id: string // scene.*

346	// ─────────────────────────── 模型（roofline 输入） ───────────────────────────
```

```text
1	import type { Claim, ClaimValue, Confidence, EvidenceType, ProductStatus } from './types'
2	
3	/**
4	 * Claim 构造小工具。纯函数、返回纯对象（模块加载期求值），不破坏 JSON 可序列化。
5	 * 目的只有一个：让内容文件里「每个数字都带出处」写起来不痛苦，从而不会有人图省事去写裸数字。
6	 */
7	
8	export const RA_SOURCE = 'src.nvidia-nvl72-ra'
9	export const GB300_PAGE_SOURCE = 'src.nvidia-gb300-page'
10	/** NVIDIA 官方页面抓取时间。 */
11	export const NVIDIA_ASOF = '2026-08'
12	
13	interface ClaimInit<T extends ClaimValue> {
14	  value: T | null
15	  sourceId: string
16	  unit?: string | null
17	  evidence?: EvidenceType
18	  status?: ProductStatus
19	  locator?: string | null
20	  asOf?: string
21	  confidence?: Confidence
22	  note?: string | null
23	}
24	
25	export function claim<T extends ClaimValue>(init: ClaimInit<T>): Claim<T> {
26	  return {
27	    value: init.value,
28	    unit: init.unit ?? null,
29	    evidence: init.evidence ?? 'verified_spec',
30	    status: init.status ?? 'shipping',
31	    sourceId: init.sourceId,
32	    locator: init.locator ?? null,
33	    asOf: init.asOf ?? NVIDIA_ASOF,
34	    confidence: init.confidence ?? 'high',
35	    note: init.note ?? null,
36	  }
37	}
38	
39	/** NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 企业参考架构文档中的确切规格。 */
40	export function raSpec<T extends ClaimValue>(
41	  value: T | null,
42	  unit: string | null,
43	  locator: string,
44	  note: string | null = null,
45	): Claim<T> {
46	  return claim<T>({ value, unit, sourceId: RA_SOURCE, locator, note })
47	}
48	
49	/** 关键数量：locator 必填，保证任何时候都能回查官方文档的具体表格/段落。 */
50	export function raCount(value: number, locator: string, note: string | null = null): Claim<number> {
51	  return claim<number>({ value, unit: '个', sourceId: RA_SOURCE, locator, note })
52	}
53	
54	/** NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 产品页规格表中的确切规格。 */
55	export function pageSpec<T extends ClaimValue>(
56	  value: T | null,
57	  unit: string | null,
58	  locator: string,
59	  note: string | null = null,
60	): Claim<T> {
61	  return claim<T>({ value, unit, sourceId: GB300_PAGE_SOURCE, locator, note })
62	}
63	
64	/** 厂商宣称（营销口径，非可验证规格）——UI 上要与 verified_spec 明显区分。 */
65	export function vendorClaim<T extends ClaimValue>(
66	  value: T | null,
67	  unit: string | null,
68	  sourceId: string,
69	  locator: string,
70	  note: string | null = null,
71	): Claim<T> {
72	  return claim<T>({ value, unit, sourceId, locator, evidence: 'vendor_claim', confidence: 'medium', note })
73	}
74	
75	/**
76	 * 「官方未公布，本项目不编数」——value 恒为 null。
77	 * 下游必须把它渲染成 N/A 并显示 note，产能估算遇到它要走拒绝/降级门。
78	 */
79	export function notPublished(
80	  unit: string | null,
81	  sourceId: string,
82	  note: string,
83	  locator: string | null = null,
84	): Claim {
85	  return claim({
86	    value: null,
87	    unit,
88	    sourceId,
89	    locator,
90	    confidence: 'low',
91	    note,
92	  })
93	}
94
```

```text
23	} from './types'
24	
25	/** 全量内容包。B2 起 3D 与 UI 只读这一个对象，不直接 import 各代际文件。 */
26	export const FACTORY_PACK: FactoryContentPack = {
27	  version: '0.1.0',
28	  generatedAsOf: '2026-08',
29	  sources: SOURCES,
30	  systems: [GB300_SYSTEM],
31	  components: [...SHARED_COMPONENTS, ...GB300_COMPONENTS],
32	  assemblies: GB300_ASSEMBLIES,
33	  connections: GB300_CONNECTIONS,
34	  flows: FLOWS,
35	  comparisons: COMPARISONS,
36	  scenes: GB300_SCENES,
37	  models: MODELS,
38	}
39	
40	// ─────────────────────────── byId 索引 ───────────────────────────
41	// 模块级构建一次即可：内容包是不可变的静态数据。
42	
43	function indexBy<T extends { id: string }>(rows: T[]): ReadonlyMap<string, T> {
44	  return new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.id, r]))
45	}
46	
47	const sourceIndex = indexBy(FACTORY_PACK.sources)
48	const systemIndex = indexBy(FACTORY_PACK.systems)
49	const componentIndex = indexBy(FACTORY_PACK.components)
50	const assemblyIndex = indexBy(FACTORY_PACK.assemblies)
51	const connectionIndex = indexBy(FACTORY_PACK.connections)
52	const sceneIndex = indexBy(FACTORY_PACK.scenes)
53	const modelIndex = indexBy(FACTORY_PACK.models)
54	
55	// ─────────────────────────── 查询辅助（纯函数） ───────────────────────────
56	
57	export function sourceById(id: string): SourceRef | undefined {
58	  return sourceIndex.get(id)
59	}
60	
61	export function systemById(id: string): FactorySystem | undefined {
62	  return systemIndex.get(id)
63	}
64	
65	export function componentById(id: string): HardwareComponent | undefined {
66	  return componentIndex.get(id)
67	}
68	
69	export function assemblyById(id: string): AssemblyNode | undefined {
70	  return assemblyIndex.get(id)
71	}
72	
73	export function connectionById(id: string): Connection | undefined {
74	  return connectionIndex.get(id)
75	}
76	
77	export function sceneById(id: string): ScenePreset | undefined {
78	  return sceneIndex.get(id)
79	}
80	
81	export function modelById(id: string): ModelSpec | undefined {
82	  return modelIndex.get(id)
83	}
84	
85	/** 某系统的全部装配节点。 */
86	export function assembliesOfSystem(systemId: string): AssemblyNode[] {
87	  return FACTORY_PACK.assemblies.filter((a) => a.systemId === systemId)
88	}
89	
90	/** 某系统装配树的根（每系统恰好一个，由 pack.test.ts 保证）。 */
91	export function rootAssemblyOf(systemId: string): AssemblyNode | undefined {
92	  return FACTORY_PACK.assemblies.find((a) => a.systemId === systemId && a.parentId === null)
93	}
94	
95	/** 直接子节点，保持内容文件中的声明顺序。 */
96	export function childrenOf(assemblyId: string): AssemblyNode[] {
97	  return FACTORY_PACK.assemblies.filter((a) => a.parentId === assemblyId)
98	}
99	
100	/** 从根到该节点的路径（含自身），用于面包屑。存在环时返回已收集到的部分。 */
101	export function ancestorsOf(assemblyId: string): AssemblyNode[] {
102	  const path: AssemblyNode[] = []
103	  const seen = new Set<string>()
104	  let cur = assemblyIndex.get(assemblyId)
105	  while (cur && !seen.has(cur.id)) {
106	    seen.add(cur.id)
107	    path.unshift(cur)
108	    cur = cur.parentId === null ? undefined : assemblyIndex.get(cur.parentId)
109	  }
110	  return path
111	}
112	
113	/** 子树内全部节点（含自身），深度优先。 */
114	export function descendantsOf(assemblyId: string): AssemblyNode[] {
115	  const out: AssemblyNode[] = []
116	  const seen = new Set<string>()
117	  const walk = (id: string) => {
118	    if (seen.has(id)) return
119	    seen.add(id)
120	    const node = assemblyIndex.get(id)
121	    if (!node) return
122	    out.push(node)
123	    for (const child of childrenOf(id)) walk(child.id)
124	  }
125	  walk(assemblyId)
126	  return out
127	}
128	
129	/**
130	 * 该节点的实例总数 = 沿祖先链的 count 连乘。
131	 *
132	 * @param scopeAssemblyId 计数的参照系（**不含**它自身的 count），省略则从装配树根算起。
133	 *   例：`totalInstances('asm.gb300.b300-gpu', 'asm.gb300.rack')` = 18 × 4 = 72（每机架 72 张卡）；
134	 *   省略 scope 则再乘上 rack 的 8 个 SU = 576。
135	 */
136	export function totalInstances(assemblyId: string, scopeAssemblyId?: string): number {
137	  const path = ancestorsOf(assemblyId)
138	  const scopeIdx = scopeAssemblyId ? path.findIndex((a) => a.id === scopeAssemblyId) : -1
139	  return path.slice(scopeIdx + 1).reduce((acc, node) => acc * node.count, 1)
140	}
141	
142	/** 与该装配节点相连的全部连接（任一端命中）。 */
143	export function connectionsOf(assemblyId: string): Connection[] {
144	  return FACTORY_PACK.connections.filter(
145	    (c) => c.fromAssemblyId === assemblyId || c.toAssemblyId === assemblyId,
146	  )
147	}
148	
149	/** 某系统在指定平面上的连接。 */
150	export function connectionsOfPlane(systemId: string, plane: NetworkPlane): Connection[] {
151	  return FACTORY_PACK.connections.filter((c) => c.systemId === systemId && c.plane === plane)
152	}
153	
154	/** 某系统的导览场景。 */
155	export function scenesOfSystem(systemId: string): ScenePreset[] {
156	  return FACTORY_PACK.scenes.filter((s) => s.systemId === systemId)
157	}
158	
159	/** 引用了某组件的全部装配节点（详情面板「它在哪出现」用）。 */
160	export function assembliesUsingComponent(componentId: string): AssemblyNode[] {
161	  return FACTORY_PACK.assemblies.filter((a) => a.componentId === componentId)
162	}
163	
164	/** 内容包统计摘要（占位首页与报告页用）。 */
165	export interface PackStats {
166	  sources: number
167	  systems: number
168	  components: number
169	  assemblies: number
170	  connections: number
171	  flows: number
172	  comparisons: number
173	  scenes: number
174	  models: number
175	}
176	
177	export function packStats(pack: FactoryContentPack = FACTORY_PACK): PackStats {
178	  return {
179	    sources: pack.sources.length,
180	    systems: pack.systems.length,
181	    components: pack.components.length,
182	    assemblies: pack.assemblies.length,
183	    connections: pack.connections.length,
184	    flows: pack.flows.length,
185	    comparisons: pack.comparisons.length,
186	    scenes: pack.scenes.length,
187	    models: pack.models.length,
188	  }
189	}
190	
191	export { DEFAULT_MODEL_ID } from './models'
192	export { BROKER_SOURCE_IDS, OFFICIAL_SOURCE_KINDS } from './sources'
193
```

```text
1	/**
2	 * Roofline 纯函数引擎：显存与性能的**简化估算**。
3	 *
4	 * ⚠️ 本文件产出的所有性能数字都是 roofline 示意估算，仅供教学与量级感知，
5	 *    既非实测 benchmark，也不能作为可承诺产能对外报出：
6	 *    - prefill 视为**算力瓶颈**：FLOPs ≈ 2 × 激活参数 × prompt tokens，除以 (算力 × MFU)
7	 *    - decode 视为**带宽瓶颈**：每步读一遍激活权重（batch 内共享）+ 各请求各自的 KV，
8	 *      除以 (显存带宽 × MBU)
9	 *    - MFU/MBU 取保守经验值；真实系统受 kernel、并行切分、调度与 batching 策略影响上下浮动
10	 *    - 不建模：通信开销、流水气泡、投机解码、chunked prefill、goodput/SLA
11	 *
12	 * null 传播纪律（本项目从第一天起就是对的）：任何未知输入都必须让结果变成 null，
13	 * **绝不允许把 null 当 0**——把未知 KV 当 0 会让长上下文吞吐虚高数倍。
14	 * 参考实现 llms-study/src/lib/simEngine.ts 的 `estStepMs` 在 KV 为 null 时按 0 计算，
15	 * 是一个已确认的 bug，本移植版已修正为返回 null。
16	 */
17	import type { KVSpec } from '../data/types'
18	
19	export interface QuantOption {
20	  id: 'fp16' | 'fp8' | 'int4'
21	  label: string
22	  bytesPerParam: number
23	}
24	
25	export const QUANTS: QuantOption[] = [
26	  { id: 'fp16', label: 'FP16/BF16', bytesPerParam: 2 },
27	  { id: 'fp8', label: 'FP8', bytesPerParam: 1 },
28	  { id: 'int4', label: 'INT4/FP4', bytesPerParam: 0.5 },
29	]
30	
31	export const DEFAULT_MFU = 0.4 // prefill 算力利用率（经验值）
32	export const DEFAULT_MBU = 0.6 // decode 带宽利用率（经验值）
33	
34	const KV_BYTES = 2 // KV 按 FP16 存储
35	
36	/** 权重显存：参数量(B) × 每参数字节 = GB（1e9 × bytes ÷ 1e9）。 */
37	export function weightMemoryGB(totalParamsB: number, bytesPerParam: number): number {
38	  return totalParamsB * bytesPerParam
39	}
40	
41	/**
42	 * 每 token 全层合计的 KV 字节数。
43	 * 新型稀疏/线性注意力无公开参数时返回 null（不做伪精确估算）。
44	 */
45	export function kvBytesPerToken(kv: KVSpec): number | null {
46	  switch (kv.kind) {
47	    case 'mha-gqa':
48	      return 2 * kv.kvHeads * kv.headDim * kv.numLayers * KV_BYTES
49	    case 'mla':
50	      // MLA 只缓存压缩后的 latent（如 DeepSeek 512+64=576 维），没有 K/V 两份
51	      return kv.kvLatentDim * kv.numLayers * KV_BYTES
52	    case 'unsupported':
53	      return null
54	  }
55	}
56	
57	export function kvCacheGB(kv: KVSpec, contextTokens: number, batch: number): number | null {
58	  const per = kvBytesPerToken(kv)
59	  if (per === null) return null
60	  return (per * contextTokens * batch) / 1e9
61	}
62	
63	export interface MemoryBreakdown {
64	  weightsGB: number
65	  kvGB: number | null
66	  overheadGB: number
67	  totalGB: number | null
68	}
69	
70	/** 开销：激活/运行时/碎片，简化为权重的 10% + 2GB。 */
71	export function memoryBreakdown(
72	  totalParamsB: number,
73	  bytesPerParam: number,
74	  kv: KVSpec,
75	  contextTokens: number,
76	  batch: number,
77	): MemoryBreakdown {
78	  const weightsGB = weightMemoryGB(totalParamsB, bytesPerParam)
79	  const kvGB = kvCacheGB(kv, contextTokens, batch)
80	  const overheadGB = weightsGB * 0.1 + 2
81	  return {
82	    weightsGB,
83	    kvGB,
84	    overheadGB,
85	    totalGB: kvGB === null ? null : weightsGB + kvGB + overheadGB,
86	  }
87	}
88	
89	/** 最少 GPU 数（默认只按 90% 显存可用，留服务余量）。 */
90	export function minGpus(totalGB: number, gpuMemoryGB: number, usable = 0.9): number {
91	  return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalGB / (gpuMemoryGB * usable)))
92	}
93	
94	/**
95	 * 按所选量化取 GPU 算力口径：仅在官方公布了对应精度算力时切换（INT4/FP4 → fp4Tflops），
96	 * 其余（含 FP16——数据层没有官方 FP16 字段）回退 FP8 口径，`basis` 供 UI 标注「按 FP8 算力口径」。
97	 * 不编造硬件数字：GPU 两个字段都为 null 时原样透传 null。
98	 */
99	export function tflopsForQuant(
100	  gpu: { fp8Tflops: number | null; fp4Tflops: number | null },
101	  quantId: QuantOption['id'],
102	): { tflops: number | null; basis: 'fp8' | 'fp4' } {
103	  if (quantId === 'int4' && gpu.fp4Tflops !== null) return { tflops: gpu.fp4Tflops, basis: 'fp4' }
104	  return { tflops: gpu.fp8Tflops, basis: 'fp8' }
105	}
106	
107	/** TTFT 估算（ms）：prefill FLOPs ≈ 2 × 激活参数 × prompt tokens。算力未知 → null。 */
108	export function estTTFTms(
109	  activeParamsB: number,
110	  promptTokens: number,
111	  gpuTflops: number | null,
112	  gpuCount: number,
113	  mfu = DEFAULT_MFU,
114	): number | null {
115	  if (gpuTflops === null) return null
116	  const flops = 2 * activeParamsB * 1e9 * promptTokens
117	  return (flops / (gpuTflops * 1e12 * gpuCount * mfu)) * 1000
118	}
119	
120	/**
121	 * 每个 decode 步的时长（ms）：读一遍激活权重（batch 内共享）+ batch 份 KV。
122	 *
123	 * ★ null 语义（与参考实现的关键差异）：`kvPerTokenBytes === null` 时**一律返回 null**，
124	 *   即使 `contextTokens === 0` 也返回 null。理由是语义统一——「KV 口径未知 ⇒ 不估算」，
125	 *   而不是「这次恰好算得出所以给个数」。调用方拿到 null 应显示 N/A 并说明缺失哪项官方数据。
126	 */
127	export function estStepMs(
128	  activeParamsB: number,
129	  bytesPerParam: number,
130	  kvPerTokenBytes: number | null,
131	  contextTokens: number,
132	  batch: number,
133	  bandwidthTBs: number,
134	  gpuCount: number,
135	  mbu = DEFAULT_MBU,
136	): number | null {
137	  if (kvPerTokenBytes === null) return null
138	  const weightBytes = activeParamsB * 1e9 * bytesPerParam
139	  const kvBytes = kvPerTokenBytes * contextTokens * batch
140	  return ((weightBytes + kvBytes) / (bandwidthTBs * 1e12 * gpuCount * mbu)) * 1000
141	}
142	
143	/** 集群总吞吐 tokens/s：每步产出 batch 个 token。步长未知 → null。 */
144	export function tokensPerSecond(stepMs: number | null, batch: number): number | null {
145	  if (stepMs === null) return null
146	  return (batch / stepMs) * 1000
147	}
```

```text
4	 * 三条硬规则：

31	export function defaultPlanes(): PlaneFlags {

61	  hover: (assemblyId: string | null) => void

75	/** `prefers-reduced-motion` 作为初始种子；用户之后可以显式覆盖并落盘。 */
76	function prefersReducedMotion(): boolean {

78	  try {

88	  getItem: (name: string): string | null =>
89	    typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage
90	      ? window.localStorage.getItem(name)
91	      : (memoryStore.get(name) ?? null),
92	  setItem: (name: string, value: string): void => {
93	    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) window.localStorage.setItem(name, value)
94	    else memoryStore.set(name, value)
95	  },

98	    else memoryStore.delete(name)

105	  reducedMotion: boolean

111	 * 都不能把界面打崩——一律回落到默认值。
112	 */
113	export function sanitizePersisted(raw: unknown): PersistedSlice {
114	  const fallback: PersistedSlice = {
115	    planes: defaultPlanes(),
116	    reducedMotion: false,
117	    generation: DEFAULT_SYSTEM_ID,
118	  }
119	  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') return fallback
120	  const o = raw as Record<string, unknown>
121	
122	  const planes = defaultPlanes()
123	  if (o.planes && typeof o.planes === 'object') {
124	    const p = o.planes as Record<string, unknown>
125	    for (const key of PLANE_ORDER) {
126	      if (typeof p[key] === 'boolean') planes[key] = p[key]
127	    }
128	  }
129	
130	  const generation =
131	    typeof o.generation === 'string' && FACTORY_PACK.systems.some((s) => s.id === o.generation)
132	      ? o.generation
133	      : DEFAULT_SYSTEM_ID
134	
135	  return {
136	    planes,
137	    reducedMotion: typeof o.reducedMotion === 'boolean' ? o.reducedMotion : false,
138	    generation,
139	  }
140	}
141	
142	export const useFactoryStore = create<FactoryState>()(
143	  persist(
144	    (set) => ({
145	      ...initialDrillState(DEFAULT_SYSTEM_ID),
146	      generation: DEFAULT_SYSTEM_ID,
147	      hoveredId: null,

151	      tourStopIdx: -1,

153	      glStatus: 'unknown',
154	      ready: false,
155	
156	      drillTo: (assemblyId) => set((s) => nextState(s, { type: 'drillTo', assemblyId })),
157	      drillUp: () => set((s) => nextState(s, { type: 'drillUp' })),
158	      jumpTo: (assemblyId) => set((s) => nextState(s, { type: 'jumpTo', assemblyId })),

161	      setLevel: (level) => set({ level }),
162

167	        const planes = defaultPlanes()

169	        set((s) => ({

179	      },

181	
182	      togglePlane: (plane) => set((s) => ({ planes: { ...s.planes, [plane]: !s.planes[plane] } })),
183	      setPlanes: (patch) => set((s) => ({ planes: { ...s.planes, ...patch } })),
184	      setMode: (mode) => set({ mode }),
185	      setFlow: (patch) => set((s) => ({ flow: { ...s.flow, ...patch } })),
186	      setReducedMotion: (reducedMotion) => set({ reducedMotion }),

188	      setReady: (ready) => set((s) => (s.ready === ready ? s : { ready })),

194	          tourStopIdx: -1,
195	          mode: 'explore' as const,
196	        })),
197	    }),
198	    {
199	      name: 'aifactory.ui.v1',

202	      partialize: (s): PersistedSlice => ({
```

```text
1	/**
2	 * 装配树 → 3D 摆位（纯元组数学，零 three 导入）。
3	 *
4	 * 坐标约定
5	 * - 单位：**1 unit = 1 米**。
6	 * - 右手系，+Y 朝上（three.js 默认）。机架正面朝 +Z。
7	 * - 每个 `LayoutItem.slots[i]` 是「该实例中心」在**父装配节点局部坐标系**中的位置；
8	 *   父节点的局部原点 = 父节点几何体的中心。渲染侧因此可以直接嵌套
9	 *   `<group position={slot}>`，不需要在场景里再做一次坐标换算。
10	 * - 一个 `AssemblyNode` 的 `count` 个实例共享同一个 `size`，位置由 `slots` 逐个给出。
11	 *
12	 * rack-U 约定（与 `types.ts` 一致）：`rackU.height` 覆盖该节点**全部 count 个实例**的
13	 * 连续跨度，因此单实例槽高 = height / count。18 个计算托盘（start 11, height 18）
14	 * 于是各占 1U，9 个交换托盘（start 29, height 9）同理。
15	 *
16	 * ⚠️ 所有摆位都是**示意**：NVIDIA 未公布 GB300 NVL72 的逐 U 布局与板级坐标，
17	 *    这里只保证「同层不重叠、数量正确、跨代可比」，不代表真实机械图。
18	 */
19	
20	import { FACTORY_PACK } from '../data'
21	import type { AssemblyNode, FactoryContentPack } from '../data/types'
22	
23	export type Vec3 = [number, number, number]
24	
25	// ─────────────────────────── 物理常量 ───────────────────────────
26	
27	/** 1 机架单位 = 44.45 mm（EIA-310 标准）。 */
28	export const U_METERS = 0.04445
29	/** 机架外形（Oberon/MGX 量级的示意尺寸）。 */
30	export const RACK_WIDTH = 0.6
31	export const RACK_DEPTH = 1.2
32	/** 机架中心间距：0.6 m 机架 + 0.3 m 维护间隙。 */
33	export const RACK_PITCH = 0.9
34	/** rackUnitsForLayout 缺失时的兜底高度。 */
35	export const DEFAULT_RACK_UNITS = 48
36	
37	/** 托盘等 U 位设备相对机架内净空的收缩比（留出导轨与缝隙，视觉上能看出分层）。 */
38	const SLOT_WIDTH_RATIO = 0.9
39	const SLOT_DEPTH_RATIO = 0.86
40	const SLOT_HEIGHT_RATIO = 0.8
41	
42	// ─────────────────────────── 输出类型 ───────────────────────────
43	
44	export interface LayoutItem {
45	  assemblyId: string
46	  /** 单个实例的外形尺寸（米）。 */
47	  size: Vec3
48	  /** 每个实例中心在父节点局部坐标系中的位置，长度恒等于 `AssemblyNode.count`。 */
49	  slots: Vec3[]
50	  /** explode（board 级拆解）视图下的实例位置，长度同上。未参与拆解时与 `slots` 相同。 */

62	//

65	// 只是摆位变成「父节点内均分一排」。

67	interface Placement {
68	  size: Vec3
69	  /** 计算 count 个实例的局部位置。 */
70	  slots: (count: number, ctx: PlacementCtx) => Vec3[]
71	  /** explode 时的抬升高度（米）与 XZ 展开系数。 */
72	  explode?: { lift: number; spread: number }
73	}

75	interface PlacementCtx {

83	function row(count: number, pitch: number, y: number, z: number): Vec3[] {
84	  const out: Vec3[] = []
85	  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) out.push([(i - (count - 1) / 2) * pitch, y, z])
86	  return out
87	}

91	  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) out.push([x, y0 + i * pitch, z])
92	  return out
93	}

101	  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
102	    const uCenter = span.start - 1 + (i + 0.5) * slotU
103	    out.push([0, uCenter * U_METERS - ctx.rackHeight / 2, 0.015])
104	  }
105	  return out
106	}

108	function rackUSize(ctx: PlacementCtx): Vec3 {
109	  const span = ctx.node.rackU
110	  const slotU = span ? span.height / ctx.node.count : 1
111	  return [
112	    RACK_WIDTH * SLOT_WIDTH_RATIO,
113	    slotU * U_METERS * SLOT_HEIGHT_RATIO,
114	    RACK_DEPTH * SLOT_DEPTH_RATIO,

185	      const out: Vec3[] = []
186	      for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {

188	        const k = i < half ? i : i - half

222	    slots: (count) => row(count, 0.05, 0.005, 0.42).map((p) => [p[0] + 0.08, p[1], p[2]] as Vec3),

244	/** 规则表未覆盖的 roleKey：父节点内均分一排，尺寸取父节点的一个小比例。 */
245	function genericPlacement(ctx: PlacementCtx): Placement {
246	  const [pw, ph, pd] = ctx.parentSize
247	  const size: Vec3 = [
248	    Math.max(pw * 0.12, 0.02),
249	    Math.max(ph * 0.12, 0.02),
250	    Math.max(pd * 0.12, 0.02),
251	  ]
252	  return {
253	    size,
254	    slots: (count) => row(count, pw / (count + 1), 0, 0),
255	  }
256	}
257	
258	// ─────────────────────────── 解析 ───────────────────────────
259	
260	function vAdd(a: Vec3, b: Vec3): Vec3 {
261	  return [a[0] + b[0], a[1] + b[1], a[2] + b[2]]
262	}
263	
264	function centerOf(slots: Vec3[]): Vec3 {
265	  if (slots.length === 0) return [0, 0, 0]
266	  const s = slots.reduce<Vec3>((acc, p) => vAdd(acc, p), [0, 0, 0])
267	  return [s[0] / slots.length, s[1] / slots.length, s[2] / slots.length]
268	}
269	
270	function extentOf(slots: Vec3[], size: Vec3): Vec3 {
271	  if (slots.length === 0) return size
272	  const out: Vec3 = [0, 0, 0]
273	  for (let axis = 0; axis < 3; axis += 1) {
274	    let lo = Infinity
275	    let hi = -Infinity
276	    for (const p of slots) {
277	      lo = Math.min(lo, p[axis] - size[axis] / 2)
278	      hi = Math.max(hi, p[axis] + size[axis] / 2)
279	    }
280	    out[axis] = hi - lo
281	  }
282	  return out
283	}
284	
285	/**
286	 * 解析一个系统的完整摆位。纯函数：同 pack + 同 systemId ⇒ 逐位相同的输出。
287	 */
288	export function resolveLayout(
289	  systemId: string,
290	  pack: FactoryContentPack = FACTORY_PACK,
291	): ResolvedLayout {
292	  const out = new Map<string, LayoutItem>()
293	  const root = pack.assemblies.find((a) => a.systemId === systemId && a.parentId === null)
294	  if (!root) return out
295	
296	  const system = pack.systems.find((s) => s.id === systemId)
297	  const rackUnits = system?.rackUnitsForLayout ?? DEFAULT_RACK_UNITS
298	  const rackHeight = rackUnits * U_METERS
299	
300	  const byParent = new Map<string, AssemblyNode[]>()
301	  for (const a of pack.assemblies) {
302	    if (a.parentId === null) continue
303	    const bucket = byParent.get(a.parentId)
304	    if (bucket) bucket.push(a)
305	    else byParent.set(a.parentId, [a])
306	  }
307	  const kidsOf = (id: string): AssemblyNode[] => byParent.get(id) ?? []
308	  const rackCount = pack.assemblies.find((a) => a.systemId === systemId && a.roleKey === 'rack')?.count ?? 1
309	
310	  const walk = (node: AssemblyNode, parentSize: Vec3): void => {
311	    const ctx: PlacementCtx = { parentSize, rackHeight, node }
312	    const rule = PLACEMENTS[node.roleKey] ?? genericPlacement(ctx)
313	
314	    // rack-U 设备的尺寸由槽高推导；机架与机架列的高度跟随 rackUnitsForLayout。
315	    let size = rule.size
316	    if (node.rackU) size = rackUSize(ctx)
317	    else if (node.roleKey === 'rack') size = [RACK_WIDTH, rackHeight, RACK_DEPTH]
318	    else if (node.roleKey === 'rack-row') size = [rackCount * RACK_PITCH, rackHeight, RACK_DEPTH]
319	    else if (node.roleKey === 'dc-busbar' || node.roleKey === 'liquid-manifold')
320	      size = [rule.size[0], rackHeight * 0.86, rule.size[2]]
321	    else if (node.roleKey === 'nvlink-backplane')
322	      size = [rule.size[0], rackHeight * 0.42, rule.size[2]]
323	    else if (size[0] === 0 && size[1] === 0 && size[2] === 0) size = TRAY_SIZE
324	
325	    const slots = rule.slots(node.count, ctx)
326	    const ex = rule.explode
327	    const explodedSlots: Vec3[] = ex
328	      ? slots.map((p) => [p[0] * ex.spread, p[1] + ex.lift, p[2] * ex.spread] as Vec3)
329	      : slots.map((p) => [...p] as Vec3)
330	
331	    out.set(node.id, {
332	      assemblyId: node.id,
333	      size,
334	      slots,
335	      explodedSlots,
336	      pos: centerOf(slots),
337	      explodedPos: centerOf(explodedSlots),
338	      extent: extentOf(slots, size),
339	    })
340	
341	    for (const kid of kidsOf(node.id)) walk(kid, size)
342	  }
343	
344	  // 机房本体：根节点的「父」是世界坐标系。
345	  const rootRule = PLACEMENTS[root.roleKey] ?? genericPlacement({ parentSize: [30, 6, 20], rackHeight, node: root })
346	  walk(root, rootRule.size)
347	  return out
348	}
349	
350	// ─────────────────────────── 记忆化 + 世界坐标 ───────────────────────────
351	
352	const layoutCache = new Map<string, ResolvedLayout>()
353	
354	/** 记忆化版本：内容包是静态的，同一系统只解析一次。 */
355	export function layoutOf(systemId: string): ResolvedLayout {
356	  const hit = layoutCache.get(systemId)
357	  if (hit) return hit
358	  const resolved = resolveLayout(systemId)
359	  layoutCache.set(systemId, resolved)
360	  return resolved
361	}
362	
363	/**
364	 * 把某节点的实例位置累加成世界坐标。
365	 *
366	 * 祖先链上 count > 1 的节点一律取第 0 个实例——B2 的下钻焦点不区分实例序号
367	 * （面包屑与相机只认 assemblyId），这个约定同时保证了相机预设的确定性。
368	 */
369	export function worldPositionOf(
370	  layout: ResolvedLayout,
371	  ancestorChain: readonly string[],
372	  instanceIndex = 0,
373	  exploded = false,
374	): Vec3 {
375	  let acc: Vec3 = [0, 0, 0]
376	  ancestorChain.forEach((id, depth) => {
377	    const item = layout.get(id)
378	    if (!item) return
379	    const idx = depth === ancestorChain.length - 1 ? instanceIndex : 0
380	    const source = exploded ? item.explodedSlots : item.slots
381	    const slot = source[Math.min(idx, source.length - 1)] ?? [0, 0, 0]
382	    acc = vAdd(acc, slot)
383	  })
384	  return acc
385	}
386
```

```text
37	} as const

46	function readVar(name: PaletteToken): string {
47	  if (typeof document === 'undefined' || !document.documentElement) return PALETTE_FALLBACK[name]
48	  const raw = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(`--color-${name}`).trim()
49	  // 变量缺失或被写成 oklch()/color-mix() 这类 three 解析不了的形式时退回常量。
50	  return /^#[0-9a-f]{3,8}$/i.test(raw) || /^rgb/i.test(raw) ? raw : PALETTE_FALLBACK[name]
51	}

54	export function palette(): Palette {

60	}
```

```text
2	 * 语义 LOD 的落地点。

4	 * ★ 「LOD」在这里**不是** `THREE.LOD`（按距离切换网格），而是

6	 *     cluster → 只有机架壳 `<Instances>` + 机房设施 + 地面网格；
7	 *     rack    → 焦点机架的全部 U 位设备（18 计算托盘 + 9 交换托盘 + 8 电源架 + 2 管理交换机
8	 *               + 母排/歧管/背板），邻架用共享材质的 ghost；
9	 *     tray    → 焦点托盘的板级内部；
10	 *     board   → 同一棵子树，位置换成 `explodedSlots`（拆解视图）。
11	 *
12	 *   因此「集群总览里不会挂出 72 张 GPU」不是靠判断距离，而是**结构上就没挂**——
13	 *   这是本项目控制 draw call 的主要手段，也是唯一需要维护的一条不变量。
14	 *
15	 * 层级 → 渲染深度：cluster 只渲染 lodLevel='cluster' 的节点，rack 到 'rack'，
16	 * tray/board 到 'board'。深度截断由 `RENDER_DEPTH` 一处控制。
17	 */
18	
19	import { Grid, Instance, Instances } from '@react-three/drei'
20	import { invalidate } from '@react-three/fiber'
21	import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
22	import { ancestorsOf, assemblyById, childrenOf, componentById } from '../../data'
23	import type { AssemblyNode, LodLevel } from '../../data/types'
24	import { levelIndex, sceneAnchorOf } from '../../lib/drill'
25	import { layoutOf, worldPositionOf } from '../../lib/layout'
26	import type { ResolvedLayout } from '../../lib/layout'
27	import { HIGHLIGHT, SURFACE, palette } from '../../lib/palette'
28	import { useFactoryStore } from '../../store'
29	import ConnectionLayer from './ConnectionLayer'
30	import FlowLayer from './FlowLayer'
31	import { ShapeMesh, ShellMesh } from './GenericShapes'
32	import { Hotspot } from './Hotspot'
33	
34	/** 每级最深渲染到哪一层 lodLevel。 */
35	const RENDER_DEPTH: Record<LodLevel, LodLevel> = {
36	  cluster: 'cluster',
37	  rack: 'rack',
38	  tray: 'board',
39	  board: 'board',
40	}
41	
42	/** 从根到该节点的 ID 链（复用 data 层的 ancestorsOf，不重写树遍历）。 */
43	function chainOf(assemblyId: string): string[] {
44	  return ancestorsOf(assemblyId).map((n) => n.id)
45	}
46	
47	// ─────────────────────────── 递归分支 ───────────────────────────
48	
49	interface BranchProps {
50	  node: AssemblyNode
51	  layout: ResolvedLayout
52	  depth: LodLevel
53	  exploded: boolean
54	  /** 该节点自身是否作为「玻璃罩」渲染（正在被钻入的容器）。 */
55	  asShell?: boolean
56	  /** 只渲染第几个实例；省略则全部渲染。 */
57	  onlyInstance?: number
58	}
59	
60	function AssemblyBranch({ node, layout, depth, exploded, asShell = false, onlyInstance }: BranchProps) {
61	  const item = layout.get(node.id)
62	  const kids = childrenOf(node.id)
63	  const maxDepth = levelIndex(depth)
64	  const component = componentById(node.componentId)
65	
66	  if (!item) return null
67	
68	  const slots = exploded ? item.explodedSlots : item.slots
69	  const indices = onlyInstance === undefined ? slots.map((_, i) => i) : [onlyInstance]
70	  const visibleKids = kids.filter((k) => levelIndex(k.lodLevel) <= maxDepth)
71	  const drillable = kids.some((k) => levelIndex(k.lodLevel) > levelIndex(node.lodLevel))
72	
73	  return (
74	    <>
75	      {indices.map((i) => {
76	        const p = slots[i]
77	        if (!p) return null
78	        return (
79	          <group key={`${node.id}#${i}`} position={p}>
80	            {asShell ? (
81	              <ShellMesh
82	                shape={component?.visual.shape ?? 'rack-frame'}
83	                size={item.size}
84	                color={SURFACE.rack}
85	              />
86	            ) : (
87	              <Hotspot node={node} instanceIndex={i} position={[0, 0, 0]} size={item.size} drillable={drillable} />
88	            )}
89	            {visibleKids.map((kid) => (
90	              <AssemblyBranch
91	                key={kid.id}
92	                node={kid}
93	                layout={layout}
94	                depth={depth}
95	                exploded={exploded}
96	              />
97	            ))}
98	          </group>
99	        )
100	      })}
101	    </>
102	  )
103	}
104	
105	// ─────────────────────────── 集群级 ───────────────────────────
106	
107	/**
108	 * 8 个机架用 drei `<Instances>` 走一次 draw call。
109	 * 代价：instanced mesh 不支持 per-instance emissive，因此高亮改用 per-instance color
110	 * （观感与 Hotspot 的 emissive 高亮对齐，两处都取 palette 的 accent）。
111	 */
112	function RackInstances({ node, layout }: { node: AssemblyNode; layout: ResolvedLayout }) {
113	  const item = layout.get(node.id)
114	  const select = useFactoryStore((s) => s.select)
115	  const drillTo = useFactoryStore((s) => s.drillTo)
116	  const hover = useFactoryStore((s) => s.hover)
117	  const isSelected = useFactoryStore((s) => s.selectedId === node.id)
118	  const [hoveredIdx, setHoveredIdx] = useState<number | null>(null)
119	  const p = palette()
120	
121	  const onOver = useCallback(
122	    (i: number) => () => {
123	      setHoveredIdx(i)
124	      hover(node.id)
125	      if (typeof document !== 'undefined') document.body.style.cursor = 'pointer'
126	      invalidate()
127	    },
128	    [hover, node.id],
129	  )
130	  const onOut = useCallback(() => {
131	    setHoveredIdx(null)
132	    hover(null)
133	    if (typeof document !== 'undefined') document.body.style.cursor = ''
134	    invalidate()
135	  }, [hover])
136	
137	  if (!item) return null
138	  const base = SURFACE.rack
139	
140	  return (
141	    <Instances limit={item.slots.length} range={item.slots.length} frustumCulled={false}>
142	      <boxGeometry args={[item.size[0], item.size[1], item.size[2]]} />
143	      {/* ⚠️ InstancedMesh 的 per-instance color 是**乘**在材质色上的，
144	          所以材质必须留白，否则 base × base 会把机架压成一块黑。 */}
145	      <meshStandardMaterial color="#ffffff" roughness={0.55} metalness={0.2} />
146	      {item.slots.map((pos, i) => (
147	        <Instance
148	          key={i}
149	          position={pos}
150	          // 选中时高亮第 0 架（相机也飞向它），悬停时高亮鼠标下的那一架
151	          color={hoveredIdx === i ? p[HIGHLIGHT.hoveredToken] : isSelected && i === 0 ? p[HIGHLIGHT.selectedToken] : base}
152	          onPointerOver={onOver(i)}
153	          onPointerOut={onOut}
154	          onClick={(e) => {
155	            e.stopPropagation()
156	            select(node.id)
157	            invalidate()
158	          }}
159	          onDoubleClick={(e) => {
160	            e.stopPropagation()
161	            drillTo(node.id)
162	            invalidate()
163	          }}
164	        />
165	      ))}
166	    </Instances>
167	  )
168	}
169	
170	function ClusterScene({ layout, rootId }: { layout: ResolvedLayout; rootId: string }) {
171	  const root = assemblyById(rootId)
172	  if (!root) return null
173	  const clusterKids = childrenOf(rootId).filter((k) => k.lodLevel === 'cluster')
174	
175	  return (
176	    <group>
177	      {clusterKids.map((kid) => {
178	        if (kid.roleKey === 'rack-row') {
179	          const rowItem = layout.get(kid.id)
180	          const rack = childrenOf(kid.id).find((r) => r.roleKey === 'rack')
181	          return (
182	            <group key={kid.id} position={rowItem?.slots[0] ?? [0, 0, 0]}>
183	              {rack ? <RackInstances node={rack} layout={layout} /> : null}
184	            </group>
185	          )
186	        }
187	        return (
188	          <AssemblyBranch key={kid.id} node={kid} layout={layout} depth="cluster" exploded={false} />
189	        )
190	      })}
191	    </group>
192	  )
193	}

195	// ─────────────────────────── 机架级 ───────────────────────────
196	
197	/** 邻架 ghost：共享同一份材质与几何，`raycast=null`，只提供空间参照。 */
198	function GhostRacks({ layout, rackId, focusIndex }: { layout: ResolvedLayout; rackId: string; focusIndex: number }) {
199	  const item = layout.get(rackId)
200	  if (!item) return null
201	  const others = item.slots.map((p, i) => ({ p, i })).filter(({ i }) => i !== focusIndex)
202	  if (others.length === 0) return null
203	  return (
204	    <Instances limit={others.length} range={others.length} frustumCulled={false}>
205	      <boxGeometry args={[item.size[0], item.size[1], item.size[2]]} />
206	      {/* ghost 不设 per-instance color，材质色直接生效 */}
207	      <meshStandardMaterial
208	        color={SURFACE.ghost}
209	        transparent
210	        opacity={HIGHLIGHT.ghostOpacity}
211	        depthWrite={false}
212	        roughness={1}
213	        metalness={0}
214	      />
215	      {others.map(({ p, i }) => (
216	        <Instance key={i} position={p} raycast={() => null} />
217	      ))}
218	    </Instances>
219	  )
220	}
221	
222	function RackScene({
223	  layout,
224	  rackId,
225	  depth,
226	}: {
227	  layout: ResolvedLayout
228	  rackId: string
229	  depth: LodLevel
230	}) {
231	  const rack = assemblyById(rackId)
232	  const chain = useMemo(() => chainOf(rackId), [rackId])
233	  if (!rack) return null
234	  const parentOrigin = worldPositionOf(layout, chain.slice(0, -1))
235	
236	  return (
237	    <group position={parentOrigin}>
238	      <GhostRacks layout={layout} rackId={rackId} focusIndex={0} />

240	    </group>
241	  )
242	}
243	
244	// ─────────────────────────── 托盘 / 板级 ───────────────────────────
245	
246	function TrayScene({
247	  layout,
248	  trayId,
249	  exploded,
250	  depth,
251	}: {
252	  layout: ResolvedLayout
253	  trayId: string

256	}) {

265	  return (
266	    <group position={parentOrigin}>

274	          opacity={0.05}
275	          edges={false}

277	          roughness={1}
278	          metalness={0}
279	          raycast={() => null}
280	        />
281	      ) : null}
282	      <AssemblyBranch
283	        node={tray}
284	        layout={layout}

290	    </group>
291	  )
292	}

294	// ─────────────────────────── 地面 ───────────────────────────
295	
296	function GroundGrid({ visible }: { visible: boolean }) {
297	  if (!visible) return null

299	    <Grid
300	      position={[0, 0.002, 0]}
301	      args={[40, 24]}
302	      cellSize={0.9}
303	      cellThickness={0.6}
304	      cellColor={SURFACE.ground}
305	      sectionSize={4.5}
306	      sectionThickness={1}
307	      sectionColor={SURFACE.edge}

316	// ─────────────────────────── 根 ───────────────────────────
317	
318	export default function SceneRoot() {

339	      ) : null}
```

```text
31	function allClaims(): { where: string; claim: Claim }[] {

33	  for (const s of pack.systems) {
34	    for (const [k, c] of Object.entries(s.keySpecs)) out.push({ where: `system ${s.id}.keySpecs.${k}`, claim: c })

39	  for (const a of pack.assemblies) {
40	    if (a.countClaim) out.push({ where: `assembly ${a.id}.countClaim`, claim: a.countClaim })
41	  }
42	  for (const c of pack.connections) {
43	    if (c.bandwidth) out.push({ where: `connection ${c.id}.bandwidth`, claim: c.bandwidth })
44	  }
45	  return out
46	}
```

# firecrawl scrape

Scrape one or more URLs. Returns clean, LLM-optimized markdown. Multiple URLs are scraped concurrently.

## When to use

- You have a specific URL and want its content
- The page is static or JS-rendered (SPA)
- Step 2 in the [workflow escalation pattern](firecrawl-cli): search → **scrape** → map → crawl → interact

## Quick start

```bash
# Basic markdown extraction
firecrawl scrape "<url>" -o .firecrawl/page.md

# Main content only, no nav/footer
firecrawl scrape "<url>" --only-main-content -o .firecrawl/page.md

# Wait for JS to render, then scrape
firecrawl scrape "<url>" --wait-for 3000 -o .firecrawl/page.md

# Multiple URLs (each saved to .firecrawl/)
firecrawl scrape https://example.com https://example.com/blog https://example.com/docs

# Get markdown and links together
firecrawl scrape "<url>" --format markdown,links -o .firecrawl/page.json

# Ask a question about the page
firecrawl scrape "https://example.com/pricing" --query "What is the enterprise plan price?"
```

## Options

| Option                   | Description                                                      |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `-f, --format <formats>` | Output formats: markdown, html, rawHtml, links, screenshot, json |
| `-Q, --query <prompt>`   | Ask a question about the page content (5 credits)                |
| `-H`                     | Include HTTP headers in output                                   |
| `--only-main-content`    | Strip nav, footer, sidebar — main content only                   |
| `--wait-for <ms>`        | Wait for JS rendering before scraping                            |
| `--include-tags <tags>`  | Only include these HTML tags                                     |
| `--exclude-tags <tags>`  | Exclude these HTML tags                                          |
| `-o, --output <path>`    | Output file path                                                 |

## Tips

- **Prefer plain scrape over `--query`.** Scrape to a file, then use `grep`, `head`, or read the markdown directly — you can search and reason over the full content yourself. Use `--query` only when you want a single targeted answer without saving the page (costs 5 extra credits).
- **Try scrape before interact.** Scrape handles static pages and JS-rendered SPAs. Only escalate to `interact` when you need interaction (clicks, form fills, pagination).
- Multiple URLs are scraped concurrently — check `firecrawl --status` for your concurrency limit.
- Single format outputs raw content. Multiple formats (e.g., `--format markdown,links`) output JSON.
- Always quote URLs — shell interprets `?` and `&` as special characters.
- Naming convention: `.firecrawl/{site}-{path}.md`

## See also

- [firecrawl-search](../firecrawl-search/SKILL.md) — find pages when you don't have a URL
- [firecrawl-browser](../firecrawl-browser/SKILL.md) — when scrape can't get the content, use `interact` to click, fill forms, etc.
- [firecrawl-download](../firecrawl-download/SKILL.md) — bulk download an entire site to local files

```text
16	import { invalidate, useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber'
17	import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react'
18	import * as THREE from 'three'

23	import type { TimelineSegment } from '../../lib/flowTimeline'
24	import { worldPositionOf } from '../../lib/layout'
25	import type { ResolvedLayout } from '../../lib/layout'
26	import { palette } from '../../lib/palette'
27	import { indexRoutesById, routeConnections, sampleAtFraction, visibleAncestorAt } from '../../lib/routing'
28	import { useFactoryStore } from '../../store'
29	
30	/** 单个步骤最多同时画几颗粒子（大多数步骤只有 1 条主路径，留一点余量给多路径步骤）。 */
31	const MAX_PARTICLES = 3
32	const PARTICLE_RADIUS = 0.02
33	
34	export interface FlowLayerProps {

36	  layout: ResolvedLayout
37	  depth: LodLevel
38	}

40	export default function FlowLayer({ systemId, layout, depth }: FlowLayerProps) {
41	  const meshRef = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null)
42	  const progressRef = useRef(0)
43	  const dummy = useMemo(() => new THREE.Object3D(), [])
44	
45	  const episodeIdx = useFactoryStore((s) => s.flow.episodeIdx)
46	  const stepIdx = useFactoryStore((s) => s.flow.stepIdx)
47	
48	  const episode = FACTORY_PACK.flows[episodeIdx]
49	
50	  const segments = useMemo<TimelineSegment[]>(() => {
51	    if (!episode) return []
52	    const routes = indexRoutesById(routeConnections(systemId, layout, depth))
53	    return buildTimeline(episode, routes)
54	  }, [episode, systemId, layout, depth])
55	
56	  // 步骤被改变（无论是本组件自己跨段，还是 FlowBar 的上一步/下一步/点击跳转）都要
57	  // 从段内进度 0 重新起步，否则「点下一步」会从上一段进行到一半的进度接着播。
58	  useEffect(() => {
59	    progressRef.current = 0
60	    invalidate()
61	  }, [stepIdx, episodeIdx])
62	
63	  useFrame((_, delta) => {
64	    const mesh = meshRef.current
65	    if (!mesh || segments.length === 0) return
66	
67	    const state = useFactoryStore.getState()
68	    const idx = Math.min(Math.max(state.flow.stepIdx, 0), segments.length - 1)
69	    const seg = segments[idx]!
70	    const dur = Math.max(seg.durationHint, 0.05)
71	
72	    if (state.flow.playing) {
73	      progressRef.current += delta * state.flow.speed
74	      if (progressRef.current >= dur) {
75	        progressRef.current -= dur
76	        state.setFlow({ stepIdx: (idx + 1) % segments.length })
77	      }
78	      invalidate()
79	    }
80	
81	    const showParticles = !state.reducedMotion && !seg.logicalOnly && seg.paths.length > 0
82	    const frac = Math.min(progressRef.current / dur, 1)
83	
84	    for (let i = 0; i < MAX_PARTICLES; i += 1) {
85	      const path = showParticles ? seg.paths[i % seg.paths.length] : undefined
86	      if (path) {
87	        const p = sampleAtFraction(path.points, path.lengths, frac)
88	        dummy.position.set(p[0], p[1], p[2])
89	        dummy.scale.setScalar(1)
90	      } else {
91	        dummy.position.set(0, -9999, 0) // 藏到视野外，双保险（scale 已经是 0）
92	        dummy.scale.setScalar(0)
93	      }
94	      dummy.updateMatrix()
95	      mesh.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix)
96	    }
97	    mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true
98	  })

100	  const p = palette()

106	    const hbmAssemblyIds = FACTORY_PACK.assemblies

114	  }, [systemId, layout, depth])

116	  return (

119	        <sphereGeometry args={[PARTICLE_RADIUS, 12, 12]} />
120	        <meshStandardMaterial
121	          color={p.accent}
122	          emissive={p.accent}
123	          emissiveIntensity={1.8}
124	          toneMapped={false}
125	        />
126	      </instancedMesh>
127	
128	      {hbmPositions.map((pos, i) => (
129	        <mesh key={i} position={pos} raycast={() => null}>

136	            opacity={0.8}
```

```text
2	 * 下钻状态机（纯函数，零 three 导入）。
3	 *
4	 * 语义 LOD 的四级：cluster → rack → tray → board。
5	 * 「某个装配节点被聚焦时应该处在哪一级」不靠解析 ID，而由装配树结构推导——
6	 * 这样换代（Vera Rubin / Rubin Ultra）时不需要改一行下钻逻辑。
7	 *
8	 * 推导规则（`levelOfFocus`）：
9	 *   - 树根 → cluster；
10	 *   - 叶子节点 → 它自己的 lodLevel（「进不去了，就停在它所在的那一层」）；
11	 *   - 有子节点 → max(自身 lodLevel, 最粗的子节点 lodLevel)
12	 *     （即「至少能展开到子层」，但不会因为个别深层子孙就跳级）。
13	 *
14	 * 代入 GB300 校验：
15	 *   facility→cluster、row→cluster、rack→rack、compute-tray→tray、
16	 *   nvswitch-tray→tray、b300-gpu→board、power-shelf→rack、cdu→cluster。

18	
19	import { FACTORY_PACK, ancestorsOf, assemblyById, childrenOf } from '../data'
20	import type { AssemblyNode, FactoryContentPack, LodLevel } from '../data/types'
21	
22	export const LEVEL_ORDER: readonly LodLevel[] = ['cluster', 'rack', 'tray', 'board']
23	
24	export const LEVEL_LABEL: Record<LodLevel, string> = {
25	  cluster: '集群',
26	  rack: '机架',
27	  tray: '托盘',
28	  board: '板级',
29	}
30	
31	export function levelIndex(level: LodLevel): number {
32	  return LEVEL_ORDER.indexOf(level)
33	}
34	
35	export interface DrillState {
36	  level: LodLevel
37	  /** 从树根到当前焦点的完整 ID 链（含焦点自身）。空数组 = 尚未初始化。 */
38	  focusPath: string[]
39	  selectedId: string | null
40	}
41	
42	export type DrillAction =
43	  /** 双击 / 详情面板「进入 →」：把焦点移到该节点并推进层级。 */
44	  | { type: 'drillTo'; assemblyId: string }
45	  /** 返回上一层（焦点跳到最近的、层级更浅的祖先）。 */
46	  | { type: 'drillUp' }
47	  /** 面包屑点击：直接跳到指定祖先。 */
48	  | { type: 'jumpTo'; assemblyId: string }
49	  /** 单击选中，不改变层级。 */
50	  | { type: 'select'; assemblyId: string | null }
51	  /** 导览场景应用：显式指定层级与焦点。 */
52	  | { type: 'applyScene'; level: LodLevel; focusAssemblyId: string | null }
53	  | { type: 'reset' }
54	
55	// ─────────────────────────── 结构推导 ───────────────────────────
56	
57	interface PackView {
58	  node: (id: string) => AssemblyNode | undefined
59	  kids: (id: string) => AssemblyNode[]
60	  chain: (id: string) => AssemblyNode[]
61	  root: (systemId: string) => AssemblyNode | undefined
62	}
63	
64	function viewOf(pack: FactoryContentPack): PackView {
65	  if (pack === FACTORY_PACK) {
66	    return {
67	      node: assemblyById,
68	      kids: childrenOf,
69	      chain: ancestorsOf,
70	      root: (systemId) => FACTORY_PACK.assemblies.find((a) => a.systemId === systemId && a.parentId === null),
71	    }
72	  }
73	  const byId = new Map(pack.assemblies.map((a) => [a.id, a]))
74	  return {
75	    node: (id) => byId.get(id),
76	    kids: (id) => pack.assemblies.filter((a) => a.parentId === id),
77	    chain: (id) => {
78	      const out: AssemblyNode[] = []
79	      const seen = new Set<string>()
80	      let cur = byId.get(id)
81	      while (cur && !seen.has(cur.id)) {
82	        seen.add(cur.id)
83	        out.unshift(cur)
84	        cur = cur.parentId === null ? undefined : byId.get(cur.parentId)
85	      }
86	      return out
87	    },
88	    root: (systemId) => pack.assemblies.find((a) => a.systemId === systemId && a.parentId === null),
89	  }
90	}
91	
92	/** 聚焦该节点时应处的 LOD 层级。 */
93	export function levelOfFocus(assemblyId: string, pack: FactoryContentPack = FACTORY_PACK): LodLevel {
94	  const v = viewOf(pack)
95	  const node = v.node(assemblyId)
96	  if (!node) return 'cluster'
97	  if (node.parentId === null) return 'cluster'
98	  const kids = v.kids(assemblyId)
99	  if (kids.length === 0) return node.lodLevel
100	  const own = levelIndex(node.lodLevel)
101	  const shallowestKid = Math.min(...kids.map((k) => levelIndex(k.lodLevel)))
102	  return LEVEL_ORDER[Math.max(own, shallowestKid)] ?? node.lodLevel
103	}
104	
105	/** 该节点是否还能再往里钻（存在子节点且子节点会推进层级）。 */
106	export function canDrillInto(assemblyId: string, pack: FactoryContentPack = FACTORY_PACK): boolean {
107	  const v = viewOf(pack)
108	  const kids = v.kids(assemblyId)
109	  if (kids.length === 0) return false
110	  const here = levelIndex(levelOfFocus(assemblyId, pack))
111	  return kids.some((k) => levelIndex(levelOfFocus(k.id, pack)) > here)
112	}
113	
114	/**
115	 * 场景挂载锚点：3D 侧按它决定挂哪一棵子树（语义 LOD = React 挂载/卸载）。
116	 * - cluster：只挂机架壳与机房设施；
117	 * - rack：挂焦点机架的全部 U 位设备；
118	 * - tray：挂焦点托盘的板级内部（board 级额外应用 explode 偏移）。
119	 */
120	export type SceneAnchor =
121	  | { kind: 'cluster' }
122	  | { kind: 'rack'; rackAssemblyId: string }
123	  | { kind: 'tray'; trayAssemblyId: string; exploded: boolean }
124	
125	/** 最深的「其子节点里有 rack 层设备」的祖先或自身——GB300 里就是机架节点。 */
126	export function rackContainerOf(
127	  assemblyId: string,
128	  pack: FactoryContentPack = FACTORY_PACK,
129	): string | null {
130	  const v = viewOf(pack)
131	  const chain = v.chain(assemblyId)
132	  for (let i = chain.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
133	    const n = chain[i]!
134	    if (v.kids(n.id).some((k) => k.lodLevel === 'rack')) return n.id
135	  }
136	  return null
137	}
138	
139	/** 最深的「自身处于 rack 层且有内部结构」的祖先或自身——即计算/交换托盘。 */
140	export function trayContainerOf(
141	  assemblyId: string,
142	  pack: FactoryContentPack = FACTORY_PACK,
143	): string | null {
144	  const v = viewOf(pack)
145	  const chain = v.chain(assemblyId)
146	  for (let i = chain.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
147	    const n = chain[i]!
148	    if (n.lodLevel === 'rack' && v.kids(n.id).length > 0) return n.id
149	  }
150	  return null
151	}
152	
153	export function sceneAnchorOf(
154	  state: DrillState,
155	  pack: FactoryContentPack = FACTORY_PACK,
156	): SceneAnchor {
157	  const focusId = state.focusPath[state.focusPath.length - 1]
158	  if (!focusId || state.level === 'cluster') return { kind: 'cluster' }
159	  if (state.level === 'rack') {
160	    const rackId = rackContainerOf(focusId, pack)
161	    return rackId ? { kind: 'rack', rackAssemblyId: rackId } : { kind: 'cluster' }
162	  }
163	  const trayId = trayContainerOf(focusId, pack)
164	  if (trayId) return { kind: 'tray', trayAssemblyId: trayId, exploded: state.level === 'board' }
165	  const rackId = rackContainerOf(focusId, pack)
166	  return rackId ? { kind: 'rack', rackAssemblyId: rackId } : { kind: 'cluster' }
167	}
168	
169	// ─────────────────────────── 面包屑 ───────────────────────────
170	
171	export interface Crumb {
172	  assemblyId: string
173	  label: string
174	  level: LodLevel
175	  /** 当前焦点本身。 */
176	  current: boolean
177	}
178	
179	/** focusPath → 面包屑（复用 data 层的 ancestorsOf，不重写树遍历）。 */
180	export function crumbsOf(focusPath: readonly string[], pack: FactoryContentPack = FACTORY_PACK): Crumb[] {
181	  const focusId = focusPath[focusPath.length - 1]
182	  if (!focusId) return []
183	  const v = viewOf(pack)
184	  const chain = v.chain(focusId)
185	  return chain.map((n, i) => ({
186	    assemblyId: n.id,
187	    label: n.label,
188	    level: levelOfFocus(n.id, pack),
189	    current: i === chain.length - 1,
190	  }))
191	}
192	
193	// ─────────────────────────── 状态转移 ───────────────────────────
194	
195	export function initialDrillState(
196	  systemId: string,
197	  pack: FactoryContentPack = FACTORY_PACK,
198	): DrillState {
199	  const root = viewOf(pack).root(systemId)
200	  return { level: 'cluster', focusPath: root ? [root.id] : [], selectedId: null }
201	}
202	
203	function focusTo(assemblyId: string, pack: FactoryContentPack, prev: DrillState): DrillState {
204	  const v = viewOf(pack)
205	  const node = v.node(assemblyId)
206	  if (!node) return prev // 非法 ID：状态不变（深链参数写错时不该把界面打崩）
207	  const chain = v.chain(assemblyId)
208	  return {
209	    level: levelOfFocus(assemblyId, pack),
210	    focusPath: chain.map((n) => n.id),
211	    selectedId: assemblyId,
212	  }
213	}
214	
215	export function nextState(
216	  state: DrillState,
217	  action: DrillAction,
218	  pack: FactoryContentPack = FACTORY_PACK,
219	): DrillState {
220	  const v = viewOf(pack)
221	  switch (action.type) {
222	    case 'drillTo':
223	      return focusTo(action.assemblyId, pack, state)
224	
225	    case 'jumpTo': {
226	      const next = focusTo(action.assemblyId, pack, state)
227	      // 面包屑回跳不应该顺手改选中项之外的东西；选中项跟随焦点是刻意的（右栏立刻有内容）。
228	      return next
229	    }
230	
231	    case 'drillUp': {
232	      const focusId = state.focusPath[state.focusPath.length - 1]
233	      if (!focusId) return state
234	      const here = levelIndex(state.level)
235	      if (here <= 0) return state // 已在 cluster：无处可退
236	      const targetLevel = LEVEL_ORDER[here - 1]!
237	      const chain = v.chain(focusId)
238	      // 优先回到「恰好是上一级」的祖先。从根往下找 ⇒ 命中最外层的那个，
239	      // 例如从 rack 退出时落到「机房」而不是中间的「机架列」（两者同为 cluster 级）。
240	      for (let i = 0; i < chain.length - 1; i += 1) {
241	        if (levelOfFocus(chain[i]!.id, pack) === targetLevel) return focusTo(chain[i]!.id, pack, state)
242	      }
243	      // 树形不规则时兜底：退到最近的更浅祖先。
244	      for (let i = chain.length - 2; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
245	        if (levelIndex(levelOfFocus(chain[i]!.id, pack)) < here) return focusTo(chain[i]!.id, pack, state)
246	      }
247	      return state
248	    }
249	
250	    case 'select': {
251	      if (action.assemblyId === null) return { ...state, selectedId: null }
252	      return v.node(action.assemblyId) ? { ...state, selectedId: action.assemblyId } : state
253	    }
254	
255	    case 'applyScene': {
256	      if (action.focusAssemblyId === null) return { ...state, level: action.level }
257	      const next = focusTo(action.focusAssemblyId, pack, state)
258	      if (next === state) return state
259	      // 导览场景显式声明层级（例如「一个计算托盘里有什么」要求 board 级拆解视图），
260	      // 它优先于结构推导出的层级。
261	      return { ...next, level: action.level }
262	    }
263	
264	    case 'reset': {
265	      const focusId = state.focusPath[0]
266	      const node = focusId ? v.node(focusId) : undefined
267	      return node ? initialDrillState(node.systemId, pack) : state
268	    }
269	
270	    default:
271	      return state
272	  }
273	}
274
```

```text
17	import { Edges } from '@react-three/drei'

25	// ─────────────────────────── 共享几何体 ───────────────────────────
26	
27	/** 单位立方体（边长 1，中心在原点）：所有箱体形状靠 scale 得到实际尺寸。 */
28	const UNIT_BOX = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1)
29	/** 单位圆柱（直径 1、高 1，轴向 +Y）：管路/母排用。 */
30	const UNIT_CYLINDER = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.5, 0.5, 1, 14, 1)
31	
32	const CYLINDER_SHAPES: ReadonlySet<VisualShape> = new Set<VisualShape>(['pipe'])
33	
34	export function geometryForShape(shape: VisualShape): THREE.BufferGeometry {
35	  return CYLINDER_SHAPES.has(shape) ? UNIT_CYLINDER : UNIT_BOX
36	}
37	
38	/**
39	 * 圆柱的轴向固定是 +Y，但管路不一定竖着走（机架歧管竖向、机房一次侧水管沿 Z 横向）。
40	 * 这里按 `size` 的最长边把圆柱转到对应轴上，并相应交换 scale 分量，
41	 * 否则横向水管会被压成一个扁圆盘。

43	function cylinderOrientation(size: Vec3): { rotation: Vec3; scale: Vec3 } {
44	  const [x, y, z] = size
45	  if (z >= y && z >= x) return { rotation: [Math.PI / 2, 0, 0], scale: [x, z, y] }
46	  if (x >= y && x >= z) return { rotation: [0, 0, Math.PI / 2], scale: [y, x, z] }
47	  return { rotation: [0, 0, 0], scale: size }
48	}

80	  if (token) return paletteColor(token, 'accent')

97	  if (!component) return 1
98	  return SHAPE_OPACITY[component.visual.shape] ?? 1
99	}

103	export interface ShapeMeshProps extends Omit<ThreeElements['mesh'], 'scale' | 'geometry' | 'ref'> {
104	  shape: VisualShape
105	  size: Vec3
106	  color: string
107	  /** 自发光色（高亮用）；不传则不发光。 */

121	export function ShapeMesh({

123	  size,
124	  color,
125	  emissive = null,
126	  emissiveIntensity = 0,
127	  opacity = 1,
128	  wireframe = false,
129	  edges = true,
130	  edgeColor,

132	  metalness = 0.16,

136	}: ShapeMeshProps) {

143	  }, [size, shape])
```

```text
2	 * 可交互部件。
3	 *
4	 * 交互约定
5	 * - 单击 = 选中（右栏出详情），双击 = 下钻一层；
6	 * - `stopPropagation()` 让**最近命中**（= 视觉上最深的那一件）独占事件，
7	 *   否则点 GPU 会连带选中它外面的托盘；
8	 * - 装饰物（地面网格、邻架 ghost、容器玻璃罩）一律 `raycast={() => null}`，
9	 *   既避免误点，也把 raycast 的候选集压到最小；
10	 * - 每次视觉变化后显式 `invalidate()`——frameloop 是 demand，不主动请求就不会重绘。
11	 */
12	
13	import { invalidate, type ThreeEvent } from '@react-three/fiber'
14	import { useCallback } from 'react'
15	import { componentById } from '../../data'
16	import type { AssemblyNode } from '../../data/types'
17	import type { Vec3 } from '../../lib/layout'
18	import { HIGHLIGHT, palette } from '../../lib/palette'
19	import { useFactoryStore } from '../../store'
20	import { ShapeMesh, colorForComponent, opacityForComponent } from './GenericShapes'
21	
22	/** 光标计数：多个热点交替进出时不会把 cursor 卡在 pointer 上。 */
23	let hoverCount = 0
24	
25	function setCursor(active: boolean): void {
26	  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return
27	  hoverCount = Math.max(0, hoverCount + (active ? 1 : -1))
28	  document.body.style.cursor = hoverCount > 0 ? 'pointer' : ''
29	}
30	
31	export interface HotspotProps {
32	  node: AssemblyNode
33	  /** 同一装配节点的第几个实例（18 个托盘里的第几个）。 */
34	  instanceIndex?: number
35	  position: Vec3
36	  size: Vec3
37	  /** 覆盖组件默认色（例如 ghost）。 */
38	  colorOverride?: string
39	  opacity?: number
40	  /** 双击是否下钻。叶子件（已到板级）关掉，避免「双击了但什么都没变」。 */
41	  drillable?: boolean
42	}
43	
44	export function Hotspot({
45	  node,
46	  instanceIndex = 0,
47	  position,
48	  size,
49	  colorOverride,
50	  opacity,
51	  drillable = true,
52	}: HotspotProps) {
53	  const select = useFactoryStore((s) => s.select)
54	  const drillTo = useFactoryStore((s) => s.drillTo)
55	  const hover = useFactoryStore((s) => s.hover)
56	  const isSelected = useFactoryStore((s) => s.selectedId === node.id)
57	  const isHovered = useFactoryStore((s) => s.hoveredId === node.id)
58	
59	  const component = componentById(node.componentId)
60	  const base = colorOverride ?? colorForComponent(component)
61	  const p = palette()
62	
63	  const onPointerOver = useCallback(
64	    (e: ThreeEvent<PointerEvent>) => {
65	      e.stopPropagation()
66	      hover(node.id)
67	      setCursor(true)
68	      invalidate()
69	    },
70	    [hover, node.id],
71	  )
72	
73	  const onPointerOut = useCallback(
74	    (e: ThreeEvent<PointerEvent>) => {
75	      e.stopPropagation()
76	      hover(null)
77	      setCursor(false)
78	      invalidate()
79	    },
80	    [hover],
81	  )
82	
83	  const onClick = useCallback(
84	    (e: ThreeEvent<MouseEvent>) => {
85	      e.stopPropagation()
86	      select(node.id)
87	      invalidate()
88	    },
89	    [select, node.id],
90	  )
91	
92	  const onDoubleClick = useCallback(
93	    (e: ThreeEvent<MouseEvent>) => {
94	      e.stopPropagation()
95	      if (drillable) drillTo(node.id)
96	      else select(node.id)
97	      invalidate()
98	    },
99	    [drillTo, select, node.id, drillable],
100	  )
101	
102	  const emissive = isSelected
103	    ? p[HIGHLIGHT.selectedToken]
104	    : isHovered
105	      ? p[HIGHLIGHT.hoveredToken]
106	      : null
107	  const emissiveIntensity = isSelected ? HIGHLIGHT.selectedEmissive : HIGHLIGHT.hoveredEmissive
108	
109	  return (
110	    <ShapeMesh
111	      shape={component?.visual.shape ?? 'tray-slab'}
112	      size={size}
113	      position={position}
114	      color={base}
115	      opacity={opacity ?? opacityForComponent(component)}
116	      wireframe={component?.visual.wireframe === true}
117	      emissive={emissive}
118	      emissiveIntensity={emissiveIntensity}
119	      edgeColor={isSelected ? p[HIGHLIGHT.selectedToken] : undefined}
120	      onPointerOver={onPointerOver}
121	      onPointerOut={onPointerOut}
122	      onClick={onClick}
123	      onDoubleClick={onDoubleClick}
124	      userData={{ assemblyId: node.id, instanceIndex }}
125	    />
126	  )
127	}
128
```

```text
1	/**
2	 * URL 参数 → store 的**一次性**播种。
3	 *
4	 * 两个用途合一：
5	 * 1. 深链——`/?level=board&focus=asm.gb300.b300-gpu` 直接把人送到某一屏，
6	 *    汇报时不用现场点五下；
7	 * 2. 截图/E2E 的确定性入口——`?motion=off&gl=off` 可以关掉相机动画与 WebGL，
8	 *    让 B5 的 Playwright 基线不受动画时序影响。
9	 *
10	 * 「一次性」很重要：播种之后用户的手动操作不应该被 URL 覆盖，
11	 * 因此这里不做双向同步（URL ← store 的回写留给后续批次按需加）。
12	 */
13	
14	import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
15	import { assemblyById } from '../data'
16	import type { LodLevel, NetworkPlane } from '../data/types'
17	import { LEVEL_ORDER } from '../lib/drill'
18	import { PLANE_ORDER } from '../lib/palette'
19	import { detectWebGL } from '../lib/webgl'
20	import { useFactoryStore } from '../store'
21	import type { PlaneFlags } from '../store'
22	
23	export interface ShotParams {
24	  level: LodLevel | null
25	  focus: string | null
26	  planes: NetworkPlane[] | null
27	  motionOff: boolean
28	  glOff: boolean
29	}
30	
31	/** 纯解析，不碰 store。 */
32	export function parseShotParams(search: string): ShotParams {
33	  const q = new URLSearchParams(search)
34	  const rawLevel = q.get('level')
35	  const level = rawLevel && (LEVEL_ORDER as readonly string[]).includes(rawLevel)
36	    ? (rawLevel as LodLevel)
37	    : null
38	
39	  const rawPlanes = q.get('planes')
40	  const planes = rawPlanes
41	    ? rawPlanes
42	        .split(',')
43	        .map((s) => s.trim())
44	        .filter((s): s is NetworkPlane => (PLANE_ORDER as readonly string[]).includes(s))
45	    : null
46	
47	  return {
48	    level,
49	    focus: q.get('focus'),
50	    planes,
51	    motionOff: q.get('motion') === 'off',
52	    glOff: q.get('gl') === 'off',
53	  }
54	}
55	
56	export function useShotParams(): void {
57	  const seeded = useRef(false)
58	
59	  useEffect(() => {
60	    if (seeded.current) return
61	    seeded.current = true
62	
63	    const search = typeof window === 'undefined' ? '' : window.location.search
64	    const params = parseShotParams(search)
65	    const store = useFactoryStore.getState()
66	
67	    // WebGL：显式关闭优先，否则跑一次能力探测。
68	    store.setGlStatus(params.glOff ? 'none' : detectWebGL(search))
69	    if (params.glOff) store.setReady(true) // 没有 Canvas 就没有首帧回调
70	
71	    if (params.motionOff) store.setReducedMotion(true)
72	
73	    if (params.planes) {
74	      const flags = PLANE_ORDER.reduce((acc, p) => {
75	        acc[p] = params.planes!.includes(p)
76	        return acc
77	      }, {} as PlaneFlags)
78	      store.setPlanes(flags)
79	    }
80	
81	    // 焦点先于层级：层级由焦点的结构位置推导，显式 level 再覆盖一次。
82	    if (params.focus && assemblyById(params.focus)) store.drillTo(params.focus)
83	    if (params.level) store.setLevel(params.level)
84	  }, [])
85	}
86
```

```text
1	/**
2	 * 每级 LOD 的相机预设（纯数学，零 three 导入）。
3	 *
4	 * 产出的是 `CameraControls.setLookAt(...)` 需要的六个数 + 距离 clamp，
5	 * 3D 侧只负责把它们喂给控制器，不做任何取景计算——这样「取景对不对」可以在
6	 * node 环境里断言（距离 ≥ fit 距离、逐级收紧、确定性）。
7	 */
8	
9	import { FACTORY_PACK } from '../data'
10	import type { FactoryContentPack, LodLevel } from '../data/types'
11	import { levelOfFocus, rackContainerOf, trayContainerOf } from './drill'
12	import type { ResolvedLayout, Vec3 } from './layout'
13	import { worldPositionOf } from './layout'
14	
15	export const CAMERA_FOV = 45
16	export const DEFAULT_ASPECT = 16 / 9
17	
18	export interface CameraPreset {
19	  position: Vec3
20	  target: Vec3
21	  minDistance: number
22	  maxDistance: number
23	  /** 刚好把包围盒装满视野所需的距离；`position` 到 `target` 的距离恒 ≥ 它。 */
24	  fitDistance: number
25	}
26	
27	/** 每级的机位方位角（绕 Y 轴，自 +Z 起算）与仰角，单位度。 */
28	export const LEVEL_ANGLES: Record<LodLevel, { azimuthDeg: number; elevationDeg: number; margin: number }> = {
29	  cluster: { azimuthDeg: 38, elevationDeg: 26, margin: 1.35 },
30	  rack: { azimuthDeg: 30, elevationDeg: 12, margin: 1.5 },
31	  tray: { azimuthDeg: 34, elevationDeg: 40, margin: 1.3 },
32	  board: { azimuthDeg: 26, elevationDeg: 46, margin: 1.45 },
33	}
34	
35	const DEG = Math.PI / 180
36	
37	/**
38	 * 把包围盒装进视野所需的最小距离（用包围球，避免旋转到某个角度时露馅）。
39	 * 竖直视场角比水平的小（aspect > 1），所以竖直方向是约束项。
40	 */
41	export function fitDistance(
42	  extent: Vec3,
43	  fovDeg: number = CAMERA_FOV,
44	  aspect: number = DEFAULT_ASPECT,
45	  margin = 1.3,
46	): number {
47	  const radius = 0.5 * Math.hypot(extent[0], extent[1], extent[2])
48	  const vFov = fovDeg * DEG
49	  const hFov = 2 * Math.atan(Math.tan(vFov / 2) * Math.max(aspect, 0.2))
50	  const d = Math.max(radius / Math.sin(vFov / 2), radius / Math.sin(hFov / 2))
51	  return d * margin
52	}
53	
54	export interface FitBox {
55	  center: Vec3
56	  extent: Vec3
57	}
58	
59	/**
60	 * 该级该焦点应该「装进画面」的盒子。
61	 *
62	 * - cluster：整排机架（再放宽一点，把 CDU / 交换层带进画面），而不是整个机房地面；
63	 * - rack：单个机架外形；
64	 * - tray：单个托盘外形；
65	 * - board：焦点板级件的**单个实例**（放大 4 倍留上下文，刚好带上它周围的 HBM/邻居）；
66	 *   焦点不是板级件时退回整托盘的 explode 包络。
67	 */
68	export function fitBoxFor(
69	  level: LodLevel,
70	  focusPath: readonly string[],
71	  layout: ResolvedLayout,
72	  pack: FactoryContentPack = FACTORY_PACK,
73	): FitBox {
74	  const focusId = focusPath[focusPath.length - 1]
75	
76	  if (level === 'cluster' || !focusId) {
77	    const rack = pack.assemblies.find((a) => a.roleKey === 'rack')
78	    const item = rack ? layout.get(rack.id) : undefined
79	    if (rack && item) {
80	      const parentChain = chainTo(rack.id, pack).slice(0, -1)
81	      const base = worldPositionOf(layout, parentChain)
82	      return {
83	        center: [base[0] + item.pos[0], base[1] + item.pos[1], base[2] + item.pos[2]],
84	        extent: [item.extent[0] * 1.45, item.extent[1] * 1.6, item.extent[2] * 3.2],
85	      }
86	    }
87	    return { center: [0, 1, 0], extent: [12, 3, 8] }
88	  }
89	
90	  if (level === 'rack') {
91	    const rackId = rackContainerOf(focusId, pack) ?? focusId
92	    const item = layout.get(rackId)
93	    const center = worldPositionOf(layout, chainTo(rackId, pack))
94	    return { center, extent: item ? item.size : [1, 2, 1] }
95	  }
96	
97	  const trayId = trayContainerOf(focusId, pack) ?? focusId
98	  const trayItem = layout.get(trayId)
99	  const trayCenter = worldPositionOf(layout, chainTo(trayId, pack), 0, level === 'board')
100	
101	  if (level === 'tray') {
102	    return { center: trayCenter, extent: trayItem ? trayItem.size : [0.6, 0.05, 1.1] }
103	  }
104	
105	  // board：优先框住焦点件本身
106	  if (levelOfFocus(focusId, pack) === 'board') {
107	    const item = layout.get(focusId)
108	    if (item) {
109	      const center = worldPositionOf(layout, chainTo(focusId, pack), 0, true)
110	      // 单实例尺寸 × 4：框住这一件 + 它周边（例如 GPU 两侧的 HBM 堆栈），
111	      // 而不是把它的全部 count 个兄弟实例都塞进画面（那会比整个托盘还大）。
112	      return {
113	        center,
114	        extent: [
115	          Math.max(item.size[0], 0.02) * 4,
116	          Math.max(item.size[1], 0.012) * 4,
117	          Math.max(item.size[2], 0.02) * 4,
118	        ],
119	      }
120	    }
121	  }
122	  const s = trayItem ? trayItem.size : [0.6, 0.05, 1.1]
123	  // explode 后托盘在 Y 方向展开到约 0.35 m（冷板抬升 0.17 + 各层）
124	  return { center: trayCenter, extent: [s[0] * 1.3, 0.36, s[2] * 1.15] }
125	}
126	
127	function chainTo(assemblyId: string, pack: FactoryContentPack): string[] {
128	  const byId = new Map(pack.assemblies.map((a) => [a.id, a]))
129	  const out: string[] = []
130	  const seen = new Set<string>()
131	  let cur = byId.get(assemblyId)
132	  while (cur && !seen.has(cur.id)) {
133	    seen.add(cur.id)
134	    out.unshift(cur.id)
135	    cur = cur.parentId === null ? undefined : byId.get(cur.parentId)
136	  }
137	  return out
138	}
139	
140	export function cameraPresetFor(
141	  level: LodLevel,
142	  focusPath: readonly string[],
143	  layout: ResolvedLayout,
144	  opts: { aspect?: number; pack?: FactoryContentPack } = {},
145	): CameraPreset {
146	  const pack = opts.pack ?? FACTORY_PACK
147	  const aspect = opts.aspect ?? DEFAULT_ASPECT
148	  const angles = LEVEL_ANGLES[level]
149	  const box = fitBoxFor(level, focusPath, layout, pack)
150	  const d = fitDistance(box.extent, CAMERA_FOV, aspect, angles.margin)
151	
152	  const az = angles.azimuthDeg * DEG
153	  const el = angles.elevationDeg * DEG
154	  const position: Vec3 = [
155	    box.center[0] + d * Math.sin(az) * Math.cos(el),
156	    box.center[1] + d * Math.sin(el),
157	    box.center[2] + d * Math.cos(az) * Math.cos(el),
158	  ]
159	
160	  return {
161	    position,
162	    target: box.center,
163	    minDistance: Math.max(d * 0.2, 0.02),
164	    maxDistance: d * 5,
165	    fitDistance: d,
166	  }
167	}
168	
169	/** 相机与目标的距离，测试与 clamp 用。 */
170	export function distanceOf(preset: CameraPreset): number {
171	  return Math.hypot(
172	    preset.position[0] - preset.target[0],
173	    preset.position[1] - preset.target[1],
174	    preset.position[2] - preset.target[2],
175	  )
176	}
177
```

```text
39	## Seven New Chips, One AI Supercomputer
40	
41	NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 unifies leading-edge technologies from NVIDIA—72 Rubin GPUs, 36 Vera CPUs, NVIDIA ConnectX™-9 SuperNICs, and BlueField™-4 DPUs. It scales up intelligence in a rack-scale platform with the NVIDIA NVLink™ 6 switch and scales out with [NVIDIA Quantum-X800 InfiniBand](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/networking/products/infiniband/quantum-x800/) and Spectrum-X™ Ethernet to power the AI industrial revolution at scale. When deployed with NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX racks, Vera Rubin NVL72 delivers a new class of inference performance for trillion-parameter models and million-token contexts.
42	
43	Vera Rubin NVL72 is built on the third-generation [NVIDIA MGX™ NVL72 rack](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/gb200-nvl72/) design, offering a seamless transition from prior generations. It delivers AI training with one-fourth the GPUs and AI inference at one-tenth the cost per million tokens versus NVIDIA Blackwell. Featuring cable‑free modular tray designs and support from over 80 MGX ecosystem partners, the rack-scale AI supercomputer delivers world‑class performance with rapid deployment.
44	
45	### NVIDIA Vera Rubin Ramps Into Full Production to Power Agentic AI Factories Worldwide
46	
47	The NVIDIA Vera Rubin is ramping into full production, with Taiwan’s top server makers and global supply chain leaders manufacturing at scale and shipping Vera Rubin-based systems, powering AI labs, cloud providers, and hyperscalers to build tomorrow’s intelligence.
48	
49	[Read the Press Release](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/vera-rubin-full-production-agentic-ai-factory)
50	
51	### Japan Government, Industrial Leaders and NVIDIA Launch the World’s First National AI Infrastructure
52	
53	NVIDIA is working with Noetra Corp. to launch an NVIDIA Vera Rubin AI factory with 13,750 NVIDIA Vera CPUs and 27,500 NVIDIA Rubin GPUs for national physical AI.
54	
55	[Read the Press Release](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/japan-government-industrial-leaders-and-nvidia-launch-the-worlds-first-national-ai-infrastructure)

74	NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 delivers up to 10x more tokens per megawatt than NVIDIA GB200 NVL72, scaling intelligence within the same power footprint.

88	NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 trains mixture-of-experts (MoE) models with one-fourth the number of GPUs compared to NVIDIA GB200 NVL72.

92	### 35x Higher Throughput for Trillion-Parameter Models
93	
94	Agentic systems consume up to 15x more tokens than traditional AI applications. AI factories must deliver on token volume and massive context windows with low latency and efficient economics. When paired with LPX, Vera Rubin NVL72 delivers up to 35x higher throughput per megawatt for trillion-parameter models.

105	## The Vera Rubin Platform
106	
107	![NVIDIA Vera Rubin Platform Seven Chips](https://www.nvidia.com/content/nvidiaGDC/us/en_US/data-center/vera-rubin-nvl72/_jcr_content/root/responsivegrid/nv_container_1969668944/nv_image.coreimg.100.1290.jpeg/1781783427048/vera-rubin-platform-2560x480.jpeg)
108	
109	The Vera Rubin platform opens the next frontier of agentic AI with five racks to scale the world’s AI factories—NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, NVIDIA Vera CPU, NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX, NVIDIA Vera BlueField-4 STX, and NVIDIA Spectrum-6 SPX Ethernet. Designed to operate together as one incredible AI supercomputer, the racks power every phase of AI—from massive-scale pretraining, post-training and test-time scaling to real-time agentic inference.

117	Rubin GPUs with HBM4 and 50 PF NVFP4 Transformer Engine made for the next generation of AI.

123	### NVIDIA Vera CPU
124	
125	Vera CPUs are purpose-built for data movement and agentic reasoning, delivering high-bandwidth, energy-efficient compute with deterministic performance.

127	[Learn More](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/vera-cpu/)

131	### NVIDIA NVLink 6 Switch
132	
133	NVLink 6 switches feature 3.6 terabytes per second (TB/s) of all-to-all, scale-up bandwidth per GPU, enabling high-speed GPU-to-GPU communications for AI.
134	
135	[Learn More](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/nvlink/)

140	
141	ConnectX‑9 SuperNICs deliver 1.6 terabits per second (Tb/s) of per-GPU bandwidth, with programmable remote direct-memory access (RDMA) for low‑latency, GPU‑direct networking at massive scale.

143	[Learn More](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/networking/products/ethernet/supernic/)
144

148	
149	BlueField-4 DPUs accelerate data processing across storage, networking, cybersecurity, and elastic scaling in AI factories.

151	[Learn More](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/networking/products/data-processing-unit/)
152

155	### NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet Co-Packaged Optics
156	
157	Spectrum‑X Ethernet scale‑out switches with integrated silicon photonics deliver 5x better power efficiency, 10x higher network resiliency, and up to 5x more uptime over traditional networking with pluggable transceivers.
158	
159	[Learn More](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/networking/products/silicon-photonics/)

161	![NVIDIA Groq 3 LPU](https://www.nvidia.com/content/nvidiaGDC/us/en_US/data-center/vera-rubin-nvl72/_jcr_content/root/responsivegrid/nv_container_1969668944/nv_container/nv_teaser_37819894.coreimg.100.1290.jpeg/1781783427280/nvidia-groq-3-lpu.jpeg)
162	
163	### NVIDIA Groq 3 LPU
164	
165	This is the inference accelerator for NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, designed to meet the low-latency and large-context demands of agentic systems. The NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX rack features 256 LPUs with 128 GB SRAM, 40 PB/s memory bandwidth, and 640 TB/s scale-up bandwidth per rack. It is co-designed with Vera Rubin NVL72 to deliver 35x inference performance per watt and up to 10x more revenue opportunity for trillion parameter models relative to Blackwell.
166	
167	[Learn More](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/lpx/)
168	
169	## NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL4
170	
171	NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL4 delivers revolutionary performance through four NVIDIA Rubin GPUs interconnected by a second-generation NVLink bridge running sixth-generation NVIDIA NVLink, paired with two NVIDIA Vera CPUs over NVLink-C2C. Compatible with liquid-cooled NVIDIA MGX™ modular servers, it delivers up to 4x the performance for scientific computing simulation, 6x for AI-for-Science training, and 8x for AI-for-Science inference versus Grace Hopper.
```

```text
The Vera Rubin Ultra NVL576 will combine eight separate MGX NVL racks, each with 72 Rubin Ultra GPUs, all in a single 576-GPU NVLink domain with copper and direct optical connections.

It will be built using the same MGX rack-scale ecosystem for fastest time to production.

Additionally, NVIDIA Kyber — the successor to NVIDIA Oberon — will house a high-density platform of 576 NVIDIA Rubin Ultra GPUs by 2027.

The NVL576 represents NVIDIA's flagship multi-rack GPU domain, designed to scale the Vera Rubin platform to massive proportions for extreme-scale AI computing.
```
